subject: Wisconsin Election Integrity Newsletter
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY THE REPUBLICAN PARTY OF WISCONSIN NOT AUTHORIZED BY ANY CANDIDATE OR CANDIDATE'S COMMITTEE
body:
President Trump Needs YOU to Help Secure WI Elections
No images? [Click here](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail19.com/t/y-e-fsjlll-didthutlhu-z/) [](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail19.com/t/y-l-fsjlll-didthutlhu-r/) Patriot,**_Election Integrity Update_** Wisconsin elections will depend on committed citizens stepping up this year, and we're asking you to be one of them.The Wisconsin Protect the Vote Program is actively recruiting election observers and poll workers for the upcoming Primary and General Elections. By serving, you'll help ensure election laws are followed, increase transparency, and strengthen confidence in the electoral process.As President Trump noted in his national address last week ([_See Here_](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail19.com/t/y-l-fsjlll-didthutlhu-y/)), **the radical Left are attempting to steal the Election in November. President Trump is counting on you to help maintain the House or the Democrats will spend the next two years impeaching him and blocking his agenda.** Ensuring Wisconsin's elections are secure by volunteering with the Protect the Vote team will allow you to be part of the national effort working to support our local Wisconsin candidates and President Trump.If you're interested in volunteering as an election observer or are already a poll worker, you can **[create your account here](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail19.com/t/y-l-fsjlll-didthutlhu-j/) **or click below. [Sign Up For A Volunteer Account](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail19.com/t/y-l-fsjlll-didthutlhu-t/) **_Upcoming Training Sessions_ - Election Observers/Workers**Election observers and workers fill vital roles in ensuring election integrity. They receive the training they need to identify Election Day irregularities and support our rapid-response team of legal professionals.Election observers and workers primarily oversee **early vote and election day processes.** All observers participating in the Protect the Vote election observer program are _required to attend one training session._ Below are training sessions offered statewide. The statewide schedule of training sessions for election observers or poll workers can be found below:**7/21: Zoom, 6:00pm-7:30pm**. If you are interested in this session, you can [**_RSVP here._**](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail19.com/t/y-l-fsjlll-didthutlhu-i/)**7/22: Zoom, 12:00pm-1:30pm**. If you are interested in this session, you can [**_RSVP here._**](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail19.com/t/y-l-fsjlll-didthutlhu-d/)**_Upcoming Training Sessions_ - ****Special Monitors** Special monitors serve similar goals as election observers/workers, but across a broader range of situations. They receive the training they need to oversee machine testing, view absentee ballot processing, and post-election canvasses.Special monitors primarily observe **pre- and post-election processes.** Like election observers, all volunteers participating in the Protect the Vote special monitor program are _required to attend one training session._ The statewide schedule for training sessions for special monitors can be found below:7/23: 6:00pm-7:30pm. This is more than a concert. It's a community gathering where artists, organizers, candidates, and voters come together to strengthen our democracy and encourage the next generation to make their voices heard at the ballot box.

## Trump Vows Revenge as Iran War Widens
President Trump vowed harsh retaliation against Iran after a [ninth night](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOozAURb_GdEbmATZbuNiGLttuiWz8HN7I4Mh-BGW-fpT8wnRHutK50vl_W26OEh33f25HyzEvB141ITOWhcu5P575qgXZJXJM-SjZZ15AgZbKSOiW4Ci9lqEJNiIC9g3azkyDhqmHqdlsrz2OvcGo1djroEe3euNgRW9UMMo3ZN82ZaDrlBrBtMYNMI0hxj8-dHroxaAwEOfSfmU6eMOYXvmJpV3z3iS7MT-q6P8KmAXM13W16-HX9yhgfqsFzMp8WMB8VknFHbJyccQyR7nlsp_fcsuVKRETVrm6err0wXbjPTXFhsdFKVHVRgzqvjtKn3v-VbOnhZ8AAAD__zbTgUc) of U.S. strikes, warning that each American soldier killed would be avenged "many times over." At least 17 U.S. service members have died in the war, including two at a Jordanian air base struck by Iran. Trump passed the directive to Secretary of War Pete Hegseth. Tehran escalated further, with the Revolutionary Guard claiming two [oil tankers exploded](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGOqzAQheGnMR2RGRsMhYvb0OW2WyID4zC7g43MbLJ5-1XyClsf6ZPO_3GdroGY0u1_2NFLzFPCx8kogmWS8r0f9_w4C0pgCkI5lTxnmUBDV2tXQzOtgfg52Wr1ERHQVOgb19sOegN9tXk7Y-OWdgjdYLCJeobezOtsTW8gWr1U5F-adtA0WrfgLi5Y6Ns1xmFem84aZTWuJLlcPjMl2TDyM9-xXJa8V-w3keNU5p-CUcEoG27E_NoUjEdmWp4KRkqCJb0fBFYwtoNzPdiaym2pM3EtIX1hqfHn4HxSTqeCsSp-PR7ETGfnlNW3PdBbruRPqe4efgMAAP__EYh-bQ) in the Strait of Hormuz. Iran-backed Houthis declared a naval blockade on Saudi Arabia. Qatar has floated a [10-day ceasefire](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLHupCAQxp8GOzY4i6AFxTV2e-2VBmRc5w7BAKvx7S_uK_y7SWbmy-_3_XlNL0uB4vu33dDUJU0RzxKwVsxTzZ9tP9JZMlYbyFZKMSeX6gQCFBeaQzt5S-GaZOPNggj4bNC0upcK-if0zWrU7OTgukHJ2bVSDtAJ5ZR2XS-XBSQ2ZO40oaFthehAP7SV0Hd-WQbnWyWfTAr0VFN-_E0U64pLuNKB-TGnrQlmrXUv7PmLwchgjNeeSr1XDMY7mMEo9HdmMH4Kv_0YjBizfaPnX0d-2hwLp2wjRzuv_FN4ScETZv6PQkDPTwqBO-T2wHj_bTZevNKGhd8sDMYmG7_fZ1SUZlK8N0vhy1h_VOxh4H8AAAD__9UmjYM) to de-escalate. Trump will attend a dignified transfer of the fallen troops Tuesday.
## New York School Hires a Robot Teacher
A rural western New York school district will become one of the first in the country to [put a humanoid robot](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LHSmzAQBOCngU4MnPQjpVCRhs5pUzJndDKXCI6RZBPePmO_wl_vzM5--_s235AT749fuJGvUeadzpKoVspzzc_teMlZMlVMjJVlz3KXOkMPo-qtgmEOyOmaTRt8JALSLfnBOjOC0-Da1RsDTuNiEUYkgxbMsrjBatROOzPGlv27rbcwDH3_BbazaMB9hRh_3MMwGt2YngJXyd0f4b2uFNMlL8rdIlub_FrrURr9s4Gpgek8zy7Kv7finTcwbRQYG5h2OtUl-a8qyyqSVOBSMy9VBTqSXGp9brgLB_UhqiVhKVlkKypiSm324Tg5JS6jbUz_2JDTZ0H91m0vD_8DAAD___G3hOY) in the classroom this fall, starting in its high school AI and robotics classes on the Seneca Nation reservation. The robot costs $57,590, is named Sally, and has silicone skin, long brown hair, facial expressions, and upper-body movements. The company that built her, Realbotix, also has a history of making lifelike dolls designed for intimacy. [See a photo here](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLFyqzAQRb9GdGLEgoVcqHgNnV-bkhFoZTYRkkdaQ_z3GecXUt87Z86cj9t8cxQp3f-7HS2HPCc8a0RmLDOX5_448lkLsovkmHIqeck8gwIt1Sihm72j-JqHxtuACNg3aLvRDBpMD6bZ7LiGzmuvL6CubkGzBNcbo1Gb6-AR1obsm6ZG6DqlLjC2oxvAXHwI18V3eujFoNAT59J-Zkq8YYivfGBp17w30W7Mjyr6fwImAdN5nq3Hbyyc37uACRNjYUdpx8QCprpuOUdZ8EAXq4wUMNIXyu25u5TJS0a3blgkb47lSTHKBSUluUZXK1Z5YHnJmnOSfW-MMkbA1BTrH-8vVT2KQd13R_FXkP9U9bDwEwAA__85A49w). Sally stays permanently seated and tutors students who log in with a unique code, letting her pick up where each left off. According to the World Gold Council, central banks bought more gold in 2022, 2023, and 2024 than in any three-year period in over half a century. China, India, Russia, Turkey, and Poland are leading the pace.

All while:
• The BRICS bloc has expanded and is developing alternatives to dollar-based trade
• Russia and China are settling bilateral trade in their own currencies, not dollars
• Major emerging economies are reducing their U.S. Treasury holdings

The dollar's strength has long been supported by global demand. If that demand softens, every dollar-denominated asset in your retirement account could feel the effect. And the countries doing the buying? They're loading up on gold, not Treasuries.

| | **A 10-Day Ceasefire Would Reopen the Strait. Brent Would Drop $10–15. Asian LNG Spot Prices Would Fall. Gasoline Would Stop Rising. Here Is the Energy Math of a Pause.**
---
| | If the 10-day ceasefire proposal floating through mediators today is accepted, the energy market impact would be immediate and significant. The previous ceasefire experience — April 8 to July 8 — produced a Brent decline from approximately $107/barrel at the April peak to $68/barrel by July 1, a $39 decline in 84 days, or roughly $0.46/barrel per day. The June 17 MOU signing alone caused Brent to drop $22/barrel in one month (May to June average, per EIA). A 10-day pause accepted today would not replicate that full decline — too much structural damage has been done to the Strait's operational reliability and to market confidence in the MOU framework. But even a partial recovery of Strait traffic would likely pull Brent from $90+ toward the mid-$80s as risk premium deflates. Every $5 decline in Brent translates to approximately 12 cents off retail gasoline. The Republican midterm calculation is straightforward: the faster the war pauses, the lower the pump price in October.
---
| | Asian LNG spot prices, up 10% this week to their highest since March, would also soften on ceasefire news — as Qatari, UAE, and other Gulf LNG carriers could resume Hormuz transits. The Pakistani emergency LNG purchases, the South Korean Red Sea rerouting, and the European emergency storage top-up programs all become less urgent in a pause environment. The IEA's July OMR recovery scenario — 7.5 mb/d of new supply in 2027 "if transit volumes improve" — becomes plausible again. The EIA's August 11 STEO, now 21 days away, would be written with sharply different assumptions if a 10-day pause begins this week. The energy market is not waiting for the ceasefire to be announced — it is pre-pricing the possibility. Brent's behavior in the next 24 hours will tell you whether traders think the 10-day proposal is real or noise.
---

The IEA's July OMR recovery scenario — 7.5 mb/d of new supply in 2027 "if transit volumes improve" — becomes plausible again. The EIA's August 11 STEO, now 21 days away, would be written with sharply different assumptions if a 10-day pause begins this week. The energy market is not waiting for the ceasefire to be announced — it is pre-pricing the possibility. Brent's behavior in the next 24 hours will tell you whether traders think the 10-day proposal is real or noise. | | Sources: CNN Live — 10-day ceasefire proposal floated; White House downplays, July 20–21, 2026 · EIA July STEO — Brent –$22 May→June on MOU signing; $74 Q3 forecast · IEA July OMR — +7.5 mb/d 2027 contingent on transit improvement · EIA July STEO Global Oil — next release August 11, 2026 | | | dpwillis67@gmail.com is on list because you opted in before the crowd caught on. ## Texas Shifts from Response to Recovery
Gov. Greg Abbott said Monday that Texas is shifting from emergency response to recovery after last week's floods [damaged about 490 homes](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0LvSmzAQBeCnEZ08umAuhYo0dH_alMzCLngTgRhpg-23z-AiL_B3W-yc-c759TV-AUfe15-wUZDXksadniWSCOVR6AWlpIhM-Q_HSMj775QRRmdco02rnR0ROL7HusIwGextRcG2Xd1423ZN9Qh2xh6oN95RD0vT-qlbrMf5vtydoRkqDleYaZ211njjbx7qO04Ouxlq5xujakPIkvJNHvQhLfGdTsq3OW1VDA-Royj_Q7lBuaHADvtKMUU-6fpQbrgqKTccKbLwfJ3__Ua5YU2nhmlKIvrI6WSkov8eCEIaFqGsTy4svK96iSmhRthgJdSQCUqVAx5PjpFL06rarBtw_Mjke3uewf0LAAD__8ibjCA) across the state. Abbott surveyed the Kerrville area by helicopter before meeting with state and local emergency officials on cleanup, debris removal, and infrastructure repairs. He was joined by Texas Division of Emergency Management Chief Nim Kidd and Adjutant General Thomas Suelzer. "_I want to thank all the first responders, volunteers, and our fellow Texans for the swift and effective response to the floods_ ," Abbott said, pointing donors to the [Rebuild Texas Fund](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykjzFywjAQAF9jd3hOJ0UyhYo0dKRNqZF9Z7jkQIysYPh9JnwhD9id3c9jOmZRuZ4-8oVjeywlXXlblVvjmho_8roWJeH6LapMcv0qlXJCQL-DsEOTKIs-k-spTkB703M0YXTemjD6_hxHRxaWEcHujYdlYspzwCV7nA3v3dRL_JNBQGMMWLCDze6NJqRxzg6th84Bk7RSh3bmV9Kiz3LnOszl0ms8t3ZbO_ve4aHDw7ZtQ-XpR5TaYyj11OGhr5Fum6jK6kPn4HTJoi-6_e_5HvE3AAD__1yja1k). First responders [rescued more than 500 people](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkD2upDAQhE9jMiO7-TETONjE2dt0Q9TgfuB9HozsHpi5_QqusFlJJVV9VX--xi8MMWzLb3yS5fd3Gjc6SyRmyiPTG0tJ0QfKPyFG8mH7m7LHERT0UhkJevQY4mdsK28n5R-6IqvN0PaNNkNfrbbzExLprutnwGnqB6Meih5eg25mMLoK9gpTBrTWqlFN3WDb-Qn8MGMLTa9Eq8gHTrnmlW6k7_hJB-V6Ts8q2pV5L6L5JcAJcOd51j8F-TIFuGuNABfTjFGAu6oEOGVuLcAt6ZBLpkXiNCVmyUnuOR3Bk3ztHplk2mRJL17lTBtnjPJGkIUOyiRPQl4py0xlT1shAa7K1u9niDGU3ohWLU8M8Wbl_3v4sPAvAAD__zyvkPI) during the flooding, which killed two: a 74-year-old man in Uvalde and John Mark Steward, who was swept several miles downstream. Abbott declared a major disaster in at least 28 counties on Friday.
## Carrollton Soldier Killed in Jordan
The Department of War on Monday identified Pvt. Isabella Gonzales, 19, of Carrollton, as one of two soldiers killed in Iranian missile and drone attacks in Jordan. Gonzales died July 17 [at Muwaffaq Salti Air Base](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2O2zAQhJ-G6mjw70i7YJFG3aVNKay0qxNzK_JALXz22wdyqtQpFzsYfN_8ep_eoXCpHz9hpyyPtU2Vvg8mEeqT0AOOozEW6p-FmbDU360jTM64qE3Szk4IhZ9TGDDPBm92oGzTNURv0zUOW454CwG9e4sx0hpiWGk20SCsa0Jwt6Hks8wkZ6013viLh_CGs8PrAsH5aFQwhEVav8hGL6SVn-1O_bK0feC8iXwdyv9QblRuPAQ6twV4JyxwRpQbF-i9MUurTIDUlRtPzX8-uoKUO-m_orpUTZX2pwYRWD7P-6VelRuhS1mYJsKbj9EmDesSdPDg9RVT0rM3Pia0IcJ82WTnoWf8-i7M5YhJBfOxQ-EXvvzf6Pfs_gQAAP__xNGXqg) while supporting Operation Inherent Resolve. She was assigned to an air defense artillery battalion based in Ansbach, Germany. The second soldier, 1st Lt. Tyler James Feehan, 25, of Ewa Beach, Hawaii, was killed a day later. Their deaths [raise the U.S. military toll](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0L1yqzAQBeCngU6M_izsQsVt3Pm2KZlFuxjFQvJIisFvn4HkDVJts3PmfOfjNtzABx_v_2EhW7cpDZHWEqhWykOlDUpJAT3lhw-B0MfPlBEGyaVhvGdSDAg-vAfdoh05XkRLVvRnbZToz6adrVDApcZROejdBY0xMF1G7gCFhBO41ts9jPdSCMEVV50CfcJR4tmBlsrwRnNCX1Pu6kxHpSm804ty59LSBjvX-iyN-tfIayOv67p2U9qkmdNXqSnuT4287qr9pFxndoSwXxiDJcU7q2tihfLLO2ILLSPlwn7M7CBHhjlFYqVm_6A2W3yuPgRfTN9ofl_Ah6NP_duKLyu_AwAA___hHYsC) in the conflict with Iran to 17. A pilot escaped with minor injuries Monday morning after his small plane came down on the roof of a house near Fulshear in Fort Bend County. The Texas Department of Public Safety said the pilot was [trying to land](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0LuO2zAQheGnoboxeNPFBYs06jZtSmEkjleMRyJBDtartw_Wr5D6AAcf_j8fywcmTufnbzwoyPcjLye9GpMI1UXoG1vLHBPVZ2KmmM6_uUZcrLYD6BGsWSImvhbfxbDqeDcdBTNOfnBmnIZuD7Ru62ZXtCaafuv9NPb91E_GTJO_u153Kfyc6dEaY7TT7ubQ93G1cdrQWzdo5TXFJLneZKc36cFX_qJ62_LRcdhFSlPul7KzsjOum3E_i7JzyU2UnduBzFAYTwLGMzaQXKCmbT_yGQErIez5IMiPBzyTyAU7vp7QpBIJlMRZQPBJJ-y5lSTI8HZALA0aXk3Z2dx77-7jqOzc1RDLKzGnNozK688DE7-x8n-Jv4L9FwAA__9QPJF2) at the neighborhood's airstrip and was the only person aboard. He was taken to Memorial Hermann Katy. It's unclear whether anyone was inside the home. The FAA said it will investigate.

Greg Abbott said Monday that Texas is shifting from emergency response to recovery after last week's floods across the state. He was joined by Texas Division of Emergency Management Chief Nim Kidd and Adjutant General Thomas Suelzer. "I want to thank all the first responders, volunteers, and our fellow Texans for the swift and effective response to the floods ," Abbott said, pointing donors to the . Isabella Gonzales, 19, of Carrollton, as one of two soldiers killed in Iranian missile and drone attacks in Jordan. Gonzales died July 17 while supporting Operation Inherent Resolve. body:
Could this have come at a better time or in a more important place? This November, Nebraska is home to two races that could decide control of the U.S. House AND Senate.
| | | | | [](https://eeuwd7hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001f7IuYSo9FNWf364h2S_cqbRKZ2OFEbTu4_BeVz_nNnWilePcQAC3E3lW_sV9BfnerBig-SOCDRvBKoYpU7BbjelFbU2yNKbinFvKB-muu5g3tMLUjtZuo9JOaIJzIPJjKqokYjAq7ej4BaOprp0ZDuewg5oqrts9jBh0NggIkN6aiYk3b7bYRfNLFMJgLO4pmdtUg3G2ZY9pjefs83f593FZmnj3ZIt6&c=jH6ftYnxS4ql9Y79XGL7NmplWFbOLjzE0Ki7pU56e9hxYJsthsn3JA==&ch=ba3ZIMD6rFvrAbeWWMbOYeDiXo2upJDbLdlaK5RrObaN9uRQHw0FZw==)
---
Peter,
For the first time in over 30 years, Nebraska Democrats out-voted Republicans.
You read that right. In May's primary, Democratic turnout beat Republican turnout in Nebraska. That hasn't happened since 1990.
While Republican enthusiasm collapses under the weight of Trump's broken promises, skyrocketing costs, and foreign wars, Nebraska Democrats are fired up.
---
| [](https://eeuwd7hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001f7IuYSo9FNWf364h2S_cqbRKZ2OFEbTu4_BeVz_nNnWilePcQAC3E3lW_sV9BfnerBig-SOCDRvBKoYpU7BbjelFbU2yNKbinFvKB-muu5g3tMLUjtZuo9JOaIJzIPJjKqokYjAq7ej4BaOprp0ZDuewg5oqrts9jBh0NggIkN6aiYk3b7bYRfNLFMJgLO4pmdtUg3G2ZY_zt2omP2bpursPv9K5gTEO&c=jH6ftYnxS4ql9Y79XGL7NmplWFbOLjzE0Ki7pU56e9hxYJsthsn3JA==&ch=ba3ZIMD6rFvrAbeWWMbOYeDiXo2upJDbLdlaK5RrObaN9uRQHw0FZw==)
---
And it couldn't come at a better time, in a more important place.
Because this November, Nebraska is home to two races that could decide control of the U.S. House AND Senate: Denise Powell's fight to flip Nebraska's 2nd Congressional District, which could tip the balance of the U.S. House, and Dan Osborn's challenge to Pete Ricketts, which could break MAGA's grip on the U.S. Senate.
The blue wave starts right here in Nebraska.
But a promising primary doesn't mean an easy win in the general election. Now we need to double down. We need to register new voters. Knock more doors. Make more calls. Hire more organizers to hit the pavement, having face-to-face conversations with voters.
That work isn't cheap. So we're asking Democrats everywhere to pitch in and keep this momentum going: [Peter, the blue wave starts here in Nebraska. Can we count on you to rush a donation of $25, $15, or whatever you could spare to help the Nebraska Dems capitalize on the historic momentum and flip the U.S. House and Senate?](https://eeuwd7hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001f7IuYSo9FNWf364h2S_cqbRKZ2OFEbTu4_BeVz_nNnWilePcQAC3E3lW_sV9Bfne4qM1oIaAlv-djH3uzoTzo66v68IeMp_jXPFQYeUfHdrU9blGTEx35aXecefYlc3QDh4i_69Xe0_FUQdmwXGFJODEM34RgQNLdQD36BnSvYZa7NNmfLEfNNOoAveQ5YRJBUr4e2bSh4zGdfyTIvumt-dSqIhEoOBJSo6mCy3vLnk=&c=jH6ftYnxS4ql9Y79XGL7NmplWFbOLjzE0Ki7pU56e9hxYJsthsn3JA==&ch=ba3ZIMD6rFvrAbeWWMbOYeDiXo2upJDbLdlaK5RrObaN9uRQHw0FZw==)

I am really proud of the career I had before I got into politics. I spent 30 years serving my country in the Army and the Intelligence Community. I completed three deployments to Baghdad, Iraq; Bagram Air Base, Afghanistan; and Kabul, Afghanistan.
Mike Rogers has been a politician his entire life. There's nothing inherently wrong with that, but Mike's main goal seems to be to prove his loyalty to his party and its leader. Rogers voted for or stood silently by as this government moved in a direction that is having a devastating effect on the people of his district.
If I were just running against Mike Rogers, it would be so simple. But I'm not running against Mike Rogers. I'm running against 150 years of single-party rule and the expectation that the opposition party in Alabama doesn't have a chance. You can help us defy expectations...

Ambulance service has resumed in Greene County after state and local officials secured funding for two replacement vehicles, but county leaders say the temporary solution does not address the long-term financial challenges facing rural emergency medical services. The situation highlights the need for sustainable government funding as many rural Alabama counties continue to struggle with ambulance shortages and limited emergency care access.

📰 [Alabamians are facing more debt collections lawsuits than ever, says report](https://swo5c8hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0013o_EpsqaNYW9RjA5zxahByFMAtJuDIn5CcinSfx8F0TIPJ3D7bLO9tvJDyWQ3-KWRyTA63VAv2MQSb_6Wph2bSRyF8SzVESW220vKFnVAW3wm58zOzgDyc-Q8Ha4PtQeoVkb1QOV3K6HdRataltnZcSfJ0xWB5UO3W_izLJCSbpMvwxbVWMri0MZsocTanup-ZudneN72UlWbfrIh74nsjMBsTUOHwJ1DqxUQ1qex6L3295BIDmObmmG-b6NnCg5w109_R1O6StovZ-81Q2OPQ==&c=PzbItLYK8NqLTPAnUGsX-6iOLgvGpoqSUabPFOZ0GJk7DSBR5K1W4w==&ch=j-irhObgorUtJgUDiA9JO3ZYvNkm6xt7mpmIcTdu1JtAO24eTu_FCg==)
A new report found that Alabama saw a record 108,308 debt collection lawsuits in 2025, with cases surging since 2023 and disproportionately affecting vulnerable residents, including many in majority-Black counties. The report recommends stronger consumer protections and highlights that broader economic policies to improve income security are needed to reduce the growing burden of debt.

Alabama's expanded back-to-school sales tax holiday raises the price limits on tax-free items to better reflect inflation, allowing more school supplies and other purchases to qualify. While families welcome the savings, many say rising costs for essentials like groceries, gas, and school supplies continue to strain household budgets.

# One Last Thought Until Next Week
---
| | |
---
This is a dark time in America. Our economy is more skewed in favor of the rich than it has been since the 19thcentury's Gilded Age.

Everywhere, we see our democratic institutions under attack. People who push back against the government can find themselves under criminal investigation for no other reason than that they exercised their right to free speech.
And yet, across the state, we see candidates step up to fight for the people who don't have a voice in Alabama politics.
And we see individuals making an effort to improve their communities.
It gives me hope for the future.
We are 105 days away from the general election.

We'll talk soon,

Lee

clean_body: You Don't Want to Miss This | | | | | == | | | CAMPAIGN UPDATE | | | | | | == | MAKING HISTORY | | THE WEEK AHEAD | | Community Meeting on Coosa Graphite Mine Hosted by the Coosa River Keepers 🗓️ July 20 🕓 8 A.M. 📍E911 Bldg Rockford, AL | | Lee County Democratic Party Monthly Meeting 🗓️ July 20 🕓 6 P.M. 📍 Lee County Courthouse Opelika, AL | | | Sign Waving Event Outside Mike Rogers' Office 🗓️ July 21 🕓 3 - 5 P.M. 📍 Oxford City Hall, 145 Hamric Dr E | | Coosa River Keeper Movie 🗓️ July 21 🕓 5:30 P.M. 📍Pitman Theater, Gadsden, AL | | | Doug Jones Fundraiser 🗓️ July 23 🕓 5:30 - 7:00 P.M. 📍Moore's Mill Country Club Auburn, AL | Beer call with Verterans 🗓️ July 28 🕓 6 - 7:30 P.M. 📍Resting Pulse Brewery Opelika, AL | | | THE WEEK BEHIND | | | | | | | | | Most Democratic candidates for office in Alabama gathered in Montgomery. It was a chance for us all to meet, exchange ideas, and hear one another speak. It was truly something to see the party's diversity; to hear the ideas that are reaching the public; and to see the candidates' passion. The second event was a meeting of the FLM Alumni. They're a group of people from Five Points, LaFayette, and Mill Town in Chambers County who are working together to improve quality of life in their community. They're not getting paid a nickel; they receive very little recognition; yet they keep showing up for meetings and organizing events simply out of love for their community. | | | | | | | | | In Case You Missed It | | BLOG POSTS | == I am really proud of the career I had before I got into politics. I spent 30 years serving my country in the Army and the Intelligence Community. I completed three deployments to Baghdad, Iraq; Bagram Air Base, Afghanistan; and Kabul, Afghanistan. Mike Rogers has been a politician his entire life. There's nothing inherently wrong with that, but Mike's main goal seems to be to prove his loyalty to his party and its leader. Rogers voted for or stood silently by as this government moved in a direction that is having a devastating effect on the people of his district. If I were just running against Mike Rogers, it would be so simple. But I'm not running against Mike Rogers. I'm running against 150 years of single-party rule and the expectation that the opposition party in Alabama doesn't have a chance. You can help us defy expectations... | == | A Few Things to Think About | | | ALABAMA IN THE NEWS | 📰 == Ambulance service has resumed in Greene County after state and local officials secured funding for two replacement vehicles, but county leaders say the temporary solution does not address the long-term financial challenges facing rural emergency medical services. The situation highlights the need for sustainable government funding as many rural Alabama counties continue to struggle with ambulance shortages and limited emergency care access. | 📰 == A new report found that Alabama saw a record 108,308 debt collection lawsuits in 2025, with cases surging since 2023 and disproportionately affecting vulnerable residents, including many in majority-Black counties. The report recommends stronger consumer protections and highlights that broader economic policies to improve income security are needed to reduce the growing burden of debt. | 📰 == Alabama's expanded back-to-school sales tax holiday raises the price limits on tax-free items to better reflect inflation, allowing more school supplies and other purchases to qualify. While families welcome the savings, many say rising costs for essentials like groceries, gas, and school supplies continue to strain household budgets. | | A CALL TO ACTION | Volunteer: We're building a strong volunteer team to power the campaign through the general election, and we need your help. Sign up below to help move this campaign forward. | == | Follow Us: We need you to like, comment on, and share our social media posts. We also need you to talk to your friends about the campaign. We need you to come to any events we have in your area so your friends can see they're not alone. | == == == | | | Donate: Your contribution helps us keep our campaign moving by funding outreach, events, and voter engagement efforts across the district. | | == | | One Last Thought Until Next Week | | | This is a dark time in America. Our economy is more skewed in favor of the rich than it has been since the 19thcentury's Gilded Age. Everywhere, we see our democratic institutions under attack. People who push back against the government can find themselves under criminal investigation for no other reason than that they exercised their right to free speech. And yet, across the state, we see candidates step up to fight for the people who don't have a voice in Alabama politics. And we see individuals making an effort to improve their communities. It gives me hope for the future. We are 105 days away from the general election. Friend,

A Los Angeles mayoral candidate, Nithya Raman, recently proposed banning backyard barbecues.

No, this is not satire.

A candidate for mayor of America's second-largest city looked at her constituents cooking dinner in their own backyards and saw a problem that needed a government solution.

This is what Ayn Rand described decades ago.

She wrote, _" We are fast approaching the stage of ultimate inversion: the stage where the government is free to do anything it pleases, while the citizens may act only by permission."_

While she was not talking about barbecues, Ayn Rand was talking about the mindset that eventually gets around to barbecues, because **once the state believes it owns your judgment** -- and your property -- your grill is just the next line item.

Friend, this is exactly the kind of small, absurd, telling moment that shows young people what collectivism actually looks like when it runs out of bigger things to control.

I'm Jennifer Anju Grossman, CEO of The Atlas Society, the largest organization in the world dedicated to bringing Ayn Rand's ideas to a new generation. We create graphic novels, animated videos, a hit podcast, and a growing slate of educational programs, all designed to meet young people exactly where they already are, on the platforms they already use, in formats built to actually hold their attention.

A candidate for mayor of America's second-largest city looked at her constituents cooking dinner in their own backyards and saw a problem that needed a government solution. This is what Ayn Rand described decades ago. She wrote, " We are fast approaching the stage of ultimate inversion: the stage where the government is free to do anything it pleases, while the citizens may act only by permission." While she was not talking about barbecues, Ayn Rand was talking about the mindset that eventually gets around to barbecues, because once the state believes it owns your judgment -- and your property -- your grill is just the next line item. Friend, this is exactly the kind of small, absurd, telling moment that shows young people what collectivism actually looks like when it runs out of bigger things to control. I'm Jennifer Anju Grossman, CEO of The Atlas Society, the largest organization in the world dedicated to bringing Ayn Rand's ideas to a new generation. We create graphic novels, animated videos, a hit podcast, and a growing slate of educational programs, all designed to meet young people exactly where they already are, on the platforms they already use, in formats built to actually hold their attention. You can put Rand 's ideas in front of more young minds this week, at the exact moment they need to see the pattern, by chipping in $10 or more right now. A councilwoman proposing to regulate your summer cookout is not a fluke. It is what happens downstream of a generation raised to believe that ordinary freedom is itself the emergency. Recent polling has found that 62% of young Americans view socialism favorably, not as a historical curiosity but as a live option. This is not an accident. It is the product of a curriculum that treats achievement as suspect, treats the builders as villains, and treats envy as a form of justice. The Atlas Society is interrupting that pipeline before it finishes the job. We are reaching young people where they already are, on the platforms they already use, with content sharp enough to actually compete for their attention. Our digital reach now stands at 3.5 million. # The Return of Misinformation: Back-to-School Edition
| |
---
|
---
Every back-to-school season, parents deserve clear, accurate information about their legal rights. _Instead, many are met with messaging that obscures those rights._ TFVC has been exposing misleading public school communications through our **Wall of Shame** campaign for more than a decade. After a few years of incremental improvement, we've seen **a troubling increase this year** in district websites and enrollment materials that omit exemption information, misrepresent Texas law, or **falsely imply** that submitting vaccination records is the only path to enrollment. Whether intentional or not, this kind of messaging creates confusion and discourages families from exercising rights protected under Texas law. **Don't let confusing school communications convince you that you don't have a choice.** Texas parents have the legal right to claim exemptions from public/charter school vaccine requirements. No website, enrollment checklist, or back-to-school packet changes that. Better yet, thanks to TFVC-backed legislation, **exemption affidavits can now be printed from home**. If you plan to submit an exemption, [download your affidavit](https://xdzgmz.clicks.mlsend.com/tj/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEyMDEyNjAsXCJsXCI6MTkzNjA0OTk0MzY5MzI0Nzg4LFwiclwiOjE5MzYwNTAzMDg5NDM3MTg1N30iLCJzIjoiMmRhZDYzZjFlNjA3N2JhNyJ9) today so you're ready for enrollment deadlines. We've also created **[this Know Your Rights graphic](https://xdzgmz.clicks.mlsend.com/tj/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEyMDEyNjAsXCJsXCI6MTkzNjA0OTk0Mzc2NjY0ODI4LFwiclwiOjE5MzYwNTAzMDg5NDM3MTg1N30iLCJzIjoiM2VjMThlNzUzNzQ4NzEwNSJ9)** to help parents recognize and respond to common misinformation. Feel free to download, share, and post it to help ensure other Texas families know their rights. Until Texas law requires every school district to transparently inform parents of all their legal options, **TFVC will continue exposing misleading communications** , holding districts accountable, and ensuring Texas families have the details they need to make informed decisions.****

Please remind friends to vote to re-elect John McGuire in the Republican primary Tuesday, August 4th.

Virginia Democrats still don't understand the simple words of the Second Amendment: "shall not be infringed."

* Voted for the Veterans 2nd Amendment Protection Act to safeguard veterans' gun rights.

* Supported legislation to protect privacy in firearm purchases and preserve 2A rights for all Americans.

* Consistently declared that our Second Amendment is non-negotiable.

Election Day is August 4th. Early voting is underway right now. I'm asking for your vote so I can keep fighting for our constitutional rights, conservative principles, and Virginia values in Washington.
Every vote counts. Please make a plan to vote and help re-elect me to Congress.

# **▶️: Blaming California Won't Fix Texas...**
Someone recently commented on one of my videos and said America started going downhill when we became "Californicated."[**_Watch the video below to hear my response and why I believe Texans deserve facts—not political talking points._**](https://1xz3r.mjt.lu/lnk/AWEAAKBCvXYAAc7Tu4gAA-Neh6MAAYKKXNoAoUWGADIMFwBqX2gZEG_1H7G2SxWapxILximKpQAtq28/2/DkFYB7if7c27q9LeP3YeYQ/aHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYWN0Ymx1ZS5jb20vZG9uYXRlL2NhbGlmb3JuaWNhdGlvbg)

Here's the reality: Texas has been under Republican control for more than two decades. During that time, we've seen a power grid that failed millions, rising property taxes, one of the highest maternal mortality rates in the nation, and an education system that continues to leave too many children behind.**At some point, we have to stop blaming someone else and start asking who's been making the decisions.** Texans deserve leaders who take responsibility, focus on solving problems, and put working families ahead of political rhetoric.**That's why I'm running for Congress.** I'm not interested in pointing fingers. I'm interested in lowering costs, strengthening our schools, investing in infrastructure, and building an economy that works for the people who keep this state running.**_We can't bring accountability and real leadership to Congress without supporters like you. If you're able, please consider making a donation today to help us continue growing this movement across Texas's 8th District._**

name: Justin Story
subject: Justin Story Calls for Full TSA Privatization as TSA Gold+ Expands and Urges Greater Orlando Aviation Authority to Lead
body:
As a retired U.S. Marine Corps F/A-18 fighter pilot and current Boeing 787 pilot with over two decades of aviation experience,

| | | | | [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/tIuZO7EsW1m?e=90ad5fc3c5&c2id=d60c3f7cebee07fc4dcb3011da999329)
| | | | | |
**PRESS RELEASE**

**Justin Story Calls for Full TSA Privatization as TSA Gold+ Expands and Urges Greater Orlando Aviation Authority to Lead**

**"Privatization protects jobs in aviation and tourism while****delivering the world-class experience our visitors expect.” - Justin Story**
---
|
---
| | July 21, 2026Contact: [Justin@VoteJustinStory.com](mailto:justin@votejustinstory.com?subject=&body=)
---
| | **ST. CLOUD, FL** — As a retired U.S. Marine Corps F/A-18 fighter pilot and current Boeing 787 pilot with over two decades of aviation experience, FL-09 candidate for U.S. Congress Justin Story today renewed his call to fully privatize the Transportation Security Administration (TSA).Months before the TSA launched its “TSA Gold+” public-private partnership program, Story publicly advocated for moving airport security screening to the private sector. While other candidates in the FL-09 race remain silent on the issue, Story has consistently argued that privatization is the proven way to deliver faster, more efficient, and more reliable security while protecting Florida’s critical tourism and aviation economy.
“TSA Gold+ is a step in the right direction, but we must go further,” said Story. “As a pilot who flies in and out of our major hubs regularly, I’ve seen the frustration, delays, and inefficiency firsthand. Privatized models already operating successfully at airports across the country prove that private contractors, under strong oversight, can maintain or exceed security standards while avoiding the disruptions caused by federal budget battles and shutdowns.”
Story specifically called on the Greater Orlando Aviation Authority (GOAA) to move quickly and opt into TSA Gold+, or pursue even bolder privatization, to protect Central Florida’s tourism-driven economy.
“MCO is the gateway to our theme parks, beaches, and business community. Delays and dysfunction at security checkpoints hurt families, workers, and businesses. Our screeners should not have to worry about putting food on the table or paying a mortgage every time Congress cannot get its act together. Not to mention Florida’s budget relies heavily on our tourism as well. We should do all within our power to make it easier for our visitors to come and go,” Story stated. “Privatization protects jobs in aviation and tourism while delivering the world-class experience our visitors expect.”
Story emphasized that TSA reform is part of a larger imperative: shrinking wasteful federal spending to address America’s $39+ trillion national debt.
“These are exactly the type of common-sense reforms that must occur throughout the federal government. By moving non-core functions like airport screening to the private sector, we put actual stakeholders in charge, airport authorities, airlines, and communities who depend on efficient operations, instead of a disinterested federal bureaucracy. This approach reduces deficit spending, cuts bureaucracy, and delivers better results for the American people. As your next Congressman, I will fight to expand successful privatization models and restore fiscal sanity in Washington.”
**Background** Justin Story is a sixth-generation Central Floridian, retired Marine combat pilot, and commercial airline pilot running for Florida’s 9th Congressional District. He has long championed aviation security reform based on his firsthand experience in the cockpit.
For more information or to get involved, visit [http://votejustinstory.com ](https://us.list-manage.com/3DkiHxfFxZ7?e=90ad5fc3c5&c2id=d60c3f7cebee07fc4dcb3011da999329)or [email Justin.](mailto:justin@votejustinstory.com?subject=I%20want%20to%20get%20involved!&body=)

* Conversion and faith
* Prayer and the Bible

subject: CA Democrats vs. Nick Shirley
body:
California Democrats are fast-tracking a bill called the “Stop Nick Shirley Act” that threatens everything Nick and LMF are doing.

| [View in Web Browser](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e753895/VaHR0cHM6Ly93cm8ubnVjbGV1c2VtYWlsLmNvbS9hbXBsaWZ5L3YvSkJOQlQ5NVJ3SA/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNjA3MjE/LbmNsWE1BU3BwbQ/qP2hpZHM9bmM2dndTMzMxaTVsZGFscw/gal9yzw/s7if27055f5)
| | | [](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
| | |
# Friend,
---
Just days ago, independent journalist **Nick Shirley** walked into the California State Capitol with a camera and confronted the Democrat lawmakers who are trying to silence him. Most of them scattered. The few who stayed had no real answers. _Why the panic?_ Because California Democrats are fast-tracking **AB 2624** — already being called the **“Stop Nick Shirley Act.”** This bill would make it a **crime** for citizen journalists like Nick to film or post videos of publicly funded facilities — exactly the kind of on-the-ground investigative work Nick has been doing in California and Minnesota. If this bill passes, Nick’s ability to expose taxpayer fraud in government programs could be severely crippled — or even criminalized — with fines up to $10,000 and forced content removal. Think about what that means:
---
* Nick’s explosive Minnesota daycare fraud investigation that forced Congress to take notice?
* His on-the-ground reporting in California exposing waste and abuse in government programs?
* Future investigations into hospice fraud, voter roll issues, or any other taxpayer-funded facility?

---
**All of it could be criminalized under this new law.** The message from Sacramento Democrats is crystal clear: **“Stop exposing the fraud...**** _or we’ll make sure you can’t.”_** And the ultimate irony? The same lawmakers who authored and voted to advance this bill watched Nick Shirley walk right up to them in their own Capitol building, microphone in hand, and ask them point-blank why they’re trying to criminalize investigative journalism. They had no good answer. **That’s why Lincoln Media Foundation exists — and why we’re asking for your help again today.** LMF is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit that **directly funds** independent journalists like Nick Shirley. We cover the real costs of his work — travel, filming, editing, distribution, and security — so he can keep investigating stories the mainstream media refuses to touch. Right now, your tax-deductible donation to LMF will go **toward supporting Nick Shirley** and protecting his ability to continue this critical work in the face of this new threat.
---
[ **HELP LMF SUPPORT NICK SHIRLEY** ](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
[_**Your gift of $10, $25, $50, or more will help us:**_](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
* Keep Nick in the field investigating government waste and fraud
* Amplify videos so millions more Americans see the truth
* Fight back against attempts to criminalize independent journalism

---
Nick doesn’t have corporate backing or political protection. He has the truth — and the support of people like you through Lincoln Media Foundation. If you believe taxpayers deserve to know where their money is really going... If you believe citizen journalists should not be threatened with jail time for asking tough questions... [**Then please make a tax-deductible donation today through Lincoln Media Foundation.**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.) Your support will go **toward powering Nick Shirley’s next investigations**.
---
For the Truth, Alex Avetoom
Lincoln Media Foundation
---
**P.S.** Lincoln Media Foundation is **funding** Nick Shirley’s work. With Democrats in Sacramento trying to make his investigations illegal, your donation right now is more important than ever. [_**Every dollar is 100% tax-deductible and will help ensure Nick can keep exposing the truth despite this blatant attempt to silence him.**_](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)

subject: 2 Weeks to Go. See You on the Beach.
body:
The boats are in the water. Brace for landing. Come on, citizens! Do you want to live forever??

| | | | | |
---
| | | | | [Donate now! If you want. No pressure. It’s fine. But, you know, think about it.](https://us.list-manage.com/_HQKI05RHUn?e=8c62ac7f38&c2id=fabe48e824e4f1229d0a62f6a8279ab0)
---
| |
Friends, Romans, fellow believers in The Republic,
‘Tis I, Adam Dunigan, your candidate for Congress in Virginia’s 8th District. No staff, no AI. Just me. And as you can tell, these emails are getting sillier as the primary gets closer. This shall be no exception.
So! You’ve heard of the 12 Days of Christmas, but there’s a new “oddly specific number of days associated with a thing” taking the country by storm! It’s the 14 Days of Virginia’s 8th Congressional District Primary. They’re here and they’re counting down... fast.
As of today, we are literally two weeks out from the biggest day of my lil life. We launched this campaign 6 months ago on a hope and a prayer, and wouldn’t you know it? We actually have a shot.
This is when I need you more than ever. But not because things are going badly; quite the contrary. Word on the streets of VA-08 is...
---
| |
# Polls are in and it’s looking good!
---
| | This isn’t the back of a menu a friend is holding at a local bar, it’s the actual results of a straw poll conducted on July 11th in Arlington.
---
|
---
| | And to put it into numbers, [here are the Q2 reports](https://us.list-manage.com/9tjyIqWbXxR?e=8c62ac7f38&c2id=fabe48e824e4f1229d0a62f6a8279ab0) from VA-08. If you don’t like clicking links:TLDR: We did good, y’all.
With no disrespect to my competitors, these two images paint a bigger picture: Our race is now a run-off between two candidates. It’s down to the incumbent and me. Some are calling it the David and Goliath fight of our generation. Rocky versus Drago for a new generation. Or, possibly, a modern day Kevin left _home alone_ to fend off the Corporate Political Machine.
Our traction is catching some attention. And that is all thanks to _your_ support, _your_ generosity, _your_ desire for change, and _your_ faith in the resilience of our country. _
_So, thank you.
But we aren’t done yet. Far from it. We have just started the most critical two weeks of the campaign. It’s the final countdown. SkyNet comes online in T-minus 14 days unless we can stop it. We have signs to put up, door hangers to hang, rooms to fill, and votes to earn! And based on recent warnings from the Fairfax County Dems about the DOJ’s plans to send election “monitors” (read: Trump’s goon squad), we need every bit of support and funding we can muster.
---
| [DONATE $50 TODAY Help us surpass a quarter million!](https://us.list-manage.com/VcU4VCObFOy?e=8c62ac7f38&c2id=fabe48e824e4f1229d0a62f6a8279ab0)
---
| |
# How to Vote & Things You Must Know
---
| |

Do not let the ploys about “election fraud” and a strong-handed DOJ demotivate you. WE GOT THIS. The best thing you can do to counter Trump’s intimidation tactics is to vote. Follow what’s below and share it with everyone you know to empower them as well.
* VA Voting Registration cutoff is 11 days before the election (Aug 4). That means t**his Friday, July 24** is the last day to register officially.

* If you miss the 24th cutoff, when there’s a will there’s a way: You can still get a provisional ballot and register same day on Aug 4th. Only drawback on this method is that it takes a bit longer day-of.

* Btw, Virginia has an _Open_ Primary. You can vote for either party in August 4th’s primary. So, hypothetically, if you were a Republican looking to register your dissent with the Trump administration, you could vote for a Democrat (me, vote for me) without having to change parties or jeopardize your vote in the general election. Food for thought.

* One of our awesome volunteers loves democracy so much that he built this to help the community: [VA-08 Voting Tool](https://us.list-manage.com/MAkFHZ7JdIP?e=8c62ac7f38&c2id=fabe48e824e4f1229d0a62f6a8279ab0). Check it out, it’s a handy tool for all of your voting needs.

If you’re still confused or have any other concerns, just reply to this email. I see everything that comes into this inbox. I will respond personally if it helps people participate in our shared democracy. The team is always here for our fellow citizens.
And speaking of the team...

---
| |

# **We’re hitting it hard!**
---
| |
[_****_](https://us.list-manage.com/tHPm1g1hpxG?e=8c62ac7f38&c2id=fabe48e824e4f1229d0a62f6a8279ab0)
Just look at these rock stars. I cannot express how much it moves me to see people devoting so much of their free time, sharing so many bright ideas, and literally working around on the clock for this campaign. From making pins to T-shirts, from yard signs to car wrappings, to keeping my hair from going rogue when I’m on camera. Our crew has grown from a ragtag handful to nearly 120 people today. I would not have made it this far without them.
And I cannot let them do this much for free. Or worse, even at times, paying out of their own pockets. Unfortunately, after 7 months on the grind, I’m out of cash. Please help me pay our awesome team a fair wage.
Even if you don’t have the capacity to volunteer in-person, you can still support them through a donation. __
---
| [DONATE $50 TODAY Help us print more yard signs and door hangers!](https://us.list-manage.com/JVuIcpORfPD?e=8c62ac7f38&c2id=fabe48e824e4f1229d0a62f6a8279ab0)
---
|
---
| |
We’re having a field day, every day. Even when it’s 100o, rain or shine, Team Adam - the fearless warriors battling for the soul of this great republic, are out putting in the hard work, one door hanger and one sign at a time.

---
| |
# Lights, Camera...Ads and Media
---
| |
I’m truly on a mission to restore accountability and sanity back to government. I cannot do everything myself, but I can serve as an example for others. And for me, that starts with my personal ethics pledge. Term limits, rejecting wealth, sacrificing for my district. Learn more in the video below. And share with everyone you think might want to see this mentality return to the halls of power.
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/14cxWuGullf?e=8c62ac7f38&c2id=fabe48e824e4f1229d0a62f6a8279ab0)
| [DONATE $50 TODAY! Help us get our media in front of VA-08 voters](https://us.list-manage.com/HnzLeQ7R0_Q?e=8c62ac7f38&c2id=fabe48e824e4f1229d0a62f6a8279ab0)
---
| | | | | | Two weeks y’all. Because if not now? When?
I can still barely believe it. But we’re really doing this.
---
| |
Fighting for you in the field,**Adam Dunigan**
Congressional Candidate, Virginia's 8th District
[@adamduniganVA8](https://us.list-manage.com/ujENR_eCfUh?e=8c62ac7f38&c2id=fabe48e824e4f1229d0a62f6a8279ab0)
[adam4congress.com](https://us.list-manage.com/so2wChIvCfI?e=8c62ac7f38&c2id=fabe48e824e4f1229d0a62f6a8279ab0)
---

[update your preferences](https://adam4congress.us15.list-manage.com/profile?u=338019d71815bdab7363b2f42&id=b93cd38192&e=8c62ac7f38&c=ba9a0bcf38) or [unsubscribe](https://adam4congress.us15.list-manage.com/unsubscribe?u=338019d71815bdab7363b2f42&id=b93cd38192&t=b&e=8c62ac7f38&c=ba9a0bcf38)

Last week, while the country's attention was fixed on Trump's primetime address on elections, senior White House official Stephen Miller delivered a speech that should send shivers down the spine of every American.
At a gathering branded the "Resurgence of Political Terrorism," Miller said Democrats are a "cancer" that must be "rooted out" before it can "destroy society." He painted a picture of the "perfect family that goes to church every Sunday" under siege, and he claimed that our courts and legal systems have grown too "soft" to deal with the threat:

Trump's election speech laid out the manufactured pretext for contesting the midterm election results. NSPM-7 and Miller's rhetoric are the machinery to criminalize the opposition and rig the election. And it's already in motion. Just weeks ago the FBI raided the liberal voting rights organization the Ohio Organizing Collaborative. America Votes is also under investigation. The persecution of Democratic organizations has already begun.
We need to make this election too big to rig. That means every Democrat in the streets--protesting, rallying, registering freedom-loving Americans to vote, and getting them to the polls. And it means courts strong enough to hold the line against Trump's fascist takeover of our elections.

subject: I’m running for Governor of Kentucky

body:
Rocky for Kentucky [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP05/1/72103/images/29116e41-cc4b-4806-80ca-ee13275ddf2b.png]
Hi Peter,

Today, I'm proud to announce that I'm running to be the next governor of Kentucky.

I'm running because I believe that nobody should ever have to leave their corner of Kentucky to build a better life for their family. Ever.

That's the Kentucky I believe in.

A Kentucky where all can build a career, raise a family, afford a home, and know your kids have a future without leaving behind the place they love.

I've spent my life fighting for that Kentucky.

Now I'm ready to continue that work as Kentucky’s next governor.
Will you join my team as a Founding Donor? We’re trying to reach 250 Founding Donors this week. I would be so honored to have your support right from the start. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rocky_launch?amount=25]
If you’ve saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:
DONATE $25 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rocky_launch?amount=25&express_lane=true]
DONATE $50 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rocky_launch?amount=50&express_lane=true]
DONATE $100 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rocky_launch?amount=100&express_lane=true]
DONATE OTHER [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rocky_launch?]

I started as a teacher before serving in both the Kentucky House and the private sector, including nearly 14 years as majority leader. For these last six and a half years, I've been proud to serve as senior advisor to Governor Andy Beshear. Kentucky is better because of his leadership, and it's been an honor to work beside him.

But this job was never about getting the credit. It was about getting the work done.

When floods hit Eastern Kentucky, when tornadoes devastated the West, when a community needed jobs or a county needed help rebuilding, the governor sent me. I was on the ground in those communities and in the budget rooms, making sure what was promised actually got delivered.https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rocky_launch?amount=25 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rocky_launch?amount=25]

I've always believed public service is about getting up every day and finding a way to help somebody who needs it. That's what my parents taught me, and it’s what I’ve taught my kids and grandkids. That’s how I've aimed to serve Kentucky my entire career, and it's how I'll lead as governor.

But a lot of what’s squeezing folks right now isn’t being decided in Kentucky at all. It’s being decided in Washington — in the White House, in Congress — by people who will never have to live a single day with what they do to us.

One thing is clear from my work with Governor Beshear: The governor of Kentucky is the last line of defense this state has got. We deserve a government that shows up, keeps its word, and never forgets who it works for.

That's why I'm asking you to be here from the very beginning.

The media will be using what we raise right at launch to determine our momentum. This can shape the early state of this race, and that's why I hope to have you by my side right now.

Will you become one of the first supporters of our campaign by making a contribution today? Help us reach 250 Founding Donors this week. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rocky_launch?amount=25]BECOME A FOUNDING DONOR [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rocky_launch?amount=25&express_lane=true]

I’m a cancer survivor and so is my wife, Leah. There was a time I didn’t know if I’d see another morning, let alone announce a run for governor. So when I tell you I know what it is to get knocked flat — to feel the sting of it, to wonder if you’ve got anything left — I’m not reading you a line off a consultant’s talking point. I’m telling you about my life.

I'm battle-tested, I'm ready to hit the ground running, and I know real leadership takes both toughness and compassion.

I hope you'll join this campaign. I need people like you on my team.

Thank you,

Rocky

Rocky headshot. [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP05/1/72103/images/Screenshot%202026-07-20%20at%2011.07.10%E2%80%AFAM-modified.png]
Rocky Adkins has spent his life fighting for Kentucky. As a longtime Democratic leader in the Kentucky House of Representatives and Senior Advisor to Governor Andy Beshear, he's stood up for teachers, workers and families when it mattered most. When bad policies threatened Kentucky, Rocky took those fights head-on — and won.
Now he's running for Governor to lower costs, protect our schools and hospitals, defend our rights and keep fighting for Kentucky families. If you're ready for a governor who will always stand up for Kentucky, chip in today. Every dollar helps us reach voters across the commonwealth and build the grassroots campaign it will take to win. ### July 21, 2026 Newsletter

| | Faith, Farms & Freedom

---
| | As America celebrates 250 years of freedom, we had the privilege of sitting down with Secretary of Agriculture Brooke Rollins for a special live interview from the Great American State Fair on the National Mall in Washington, D.C. Secretary Rollins shares her heart as a mom, the faith that has guided her journey into public service, and the importance of strong families in building a strong nation. She also offers a powerful reminder that America's farmers are essential to our freedom and why supporting them matters for future generations. Recorded with the U.S. Capitol behind us during this historic celebration, this conversation is filled with hope, gratitude, and encouragement for every mom who wants to leave a lasting legacy. I know you'll be inspired by Secretary Rollins' love for faith, family, and country. Full episode available now on [YouTube](https://momsforamerica.us/so/65P_2h18S/c?w=f2eIdK5O3SpSaTyTOoP123MGko1pqUsnlgfWNOOOwZc.), [Rumble](https://momsforamerica.us/so/65P_2h18S/c?w=yTgsjtkhOcWDfuWtqj9RokXYDu3QT70egb9grpGQNfc.), [Spotify](https://momsforamerica.us/so/65P_2h18S/c?w=D-jlHBVdaF4Ys3-rLYTnIjsLDpMohQNhdNWQYW47WSs.) and [Apple](https://momsforamerica.us/so/65P_2h18S/c?w=Z8xk5P6fmHzbVsaxq0RxAmH0v1Q3BYwJYsKJb1lwKKs.).

## Cultural Shift - Having Children Later
---
| | [](https://momsforamerica.us/so/65P_2h18S/c?w=vtCkYeUDKr5YniugKkGr8hJzH6wG5qZ02kxtF1FdzWo.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cubW9tc2ZvcmFtZXJpY2EudXMvYmxvZyIsInIiOiJmZTllN2I1ZS0yNTk1LTRmYmItYmYzMS1iNmEyMjhmZTA3NWIiLCJtIjoibWFpbCIsImMiOiJiMzgzOGJmOC1mYWIwLTQxYjktOTY3My1lOGM2YmVmYjY1NzcifQ)
---
| | More women than ever are waiting until their 40s to have children. In fact, birth rates for women over 40 have more than tripled since 1990 and have now surpassed the teen birth rate. There are many reasons behind this cultural shift. Women are marrying later, pursuing careers, facing financial pressures, or simply waiting for what feels like the "right time." While every family's story is unique, biology doesn't always wait. Fertility naturally declines with age, making it more difficult for many couples to conceive later in life. As moms, we know there is no perfect timeline for welcoming a child. Every baby is a precious gift from God, whether born when you're 22 or 42. But as our culture increasingly encourages delaying motherhood, it's worth asking what we may be losing along the way. In this week's blog, we explore the cultural trends behind delayed motherhood, what the science says about fertility, the challenges many couples face, and why children remain one of God's greatest blessings for families and for our nation. Read the [full article](https://momsforamerica.us/so/65P_2h18S/c?w=dXMWLBR95iVgctA7VzQYLVM9hSU5XYVgU2ZE9CQ0FII.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cubW9tc2ZvcmFtZXJpY2EudXMvYmxvZyIsInIiOiIwNWQ5YmNlZS1kMWU5LTQxNmQtYjM1OS05MDcyNWQ3OGVlYmIiLCJtIjoibWFpbCIsImMiOiJiMzgzOGJmOC1mYWIwLTQxYjktOTY3My1lOGM2YmVmYjY1NzcifQ): Cultural Shift: More Women Waiting Until 40+ to Have Children.

_**by Cliff Schecter**_
Mitch McConnell has been missing for thirty-six days.
Not missing in the manner his conscience has been on hiatus roughly 1984--that's a cold case, folks; we stopped canvassing the neighborhood searching for any signs of life there a long time ago. No, Mitch McConnell as in that turtle shell of a body that should contain an essence, is literally missing.
The senior senator from Kentucky--the man who perfected minority rule as performance art, who stole one Supreme Court seat from Barack Obama and jammed another through after millions of ballots had already been cast the next presidential election. A guy who stood on the Senate floor and told us Donald Trump was "practically and morally responsible" for January 6th and then voted to acquit him anyway, because Mitch's outrage has always been strictly decorative--fell at his Washington home on June 14. Hit his head. Briefly unconscious. Pneumonia after that. _Allegedly_.
And then? Nothing. For nearly a month, the longest-serving Senate party leader in American history, and the first corporation to prance around in a human suit just... wasn't.
No video. No press availability. No colleague who'd say he'd taken a real call. Though CNN's resident pissant, Scott Jennings, kept assuring anyone with a camera that Mitch was sharp as ever, but you know the drill by now. If Scott's lips are moving, he's lying.
Then, on July 12--the same day we were burying Lindsey Graham in this very newsletter--McConnell's office finally coughed up _the proof-of-life photo_ : written statement, newspaper in hand, the universal format of hostage negotiations everywhere. He intends to finish his term, we're told, which ends in January. He says men of his generation hesitate to discuss vulnerability. (Men of his generation also used to look back on a long career infused with job stability, affordable healthcare and benefits to take care of them if they fell unceremoniously in their house--Mitch killed all that).
Meanwhile--and this is crucial to our plot--Lindsey Graham died, and South Carolina will have a replacement Republican seated before the sympathy cards stop arriving. Henry McMaster appoints a warm body (in this case, Lindsey's sister). That warm body flies to Washington. There's already a special primary on the calendar for August 11th. Done. That's how it works almost everywhere in America.
That's how it's supposed to work in America.
That's how it doesn't work in Kentucky, because of Mitch fucking McConnell. Democracy's pestilence.
If McConnell's seat comes open, Kentucky gets nothing. An empty chair. For months. On purpose. We'll get to why.
Which brings us to the man with the biggest megaphone in the Commonwealth: Governor Andy Beshear. Two-time statewide winner in a state Trump carried by 30 points. The party's favorite proof that decency still polls. And a man who is running for president whether he's said so yet or not.
**On July 8, Beshear sent McConnell a letter.**
## **A Letter Is Not a Plan**
It was a good letter! Firm, respectful, correct: Kentuckians deserve to know whether their senator can actually do the job. And when the proof-of-life photo surfaced four days later, Beshear called it "a step in the right direction."
Governor. Andy. Buddy. A letter is not a plan. We've been through this in Congress. Every time Trump bites another chunk outta the Constitution like it's a hamberder he ordered for a winning sports team that declines to show up at the White House. Then a Schumerian letter arrives via courier.
Nothing. Happens.
"A step in the right direction" is what you say when you're directionless.
Now, a few things before the _well-actually_ caucus starts shooting emails my way: I very much like Andy Beshear. He's been at the top of my list for potential 2028 candidates, as a man with conviction and political talent--he won reelection by 5% in a state more MAGA than The Epstein Files. Though one caveat: I'm just old enough _to know what I don 't know_. Which is who'll comprise the three or four--maybe half dozen--shiny new objects to score surprise victories or win much bigger ones than expected and come outta 2026 with a head full of steam.
But back to Beshear.
I know what Beshear can't do, and so does he. He cannot declare McConnell incapacitated. Nobody can. There is no mechanism in federal law, Kentucky law, or the collective statutes of humankind for removing a senator who has stopped functioning but won't leave. Somehow the Magna Carta--or in this case, U.S. Constitution--didn't think that one up in a country still beset by malaria with an average lifespan of 35-40 years in 1787.
That's by design--the Senate is an institution built by and for men who intend to die at their desks. Carter Glass of Virginia was too sick to show up for roughly four years in the 1940s, while chairing the Appropriations Committee. Karl Mundt of South Dakota had a stroke in 1969 and held his seat, silent, until 1973.
Hell, I'm not sure we can technically still call Chuck Grassley a living creature, and _he 's been in the U.S. Senate long enough to have voted against Martin Luther King Day_. (No, I'm not kidding. About the MLK Day part). Scarier? Because of another ridiculous flaw in our system--he's third in the line of succession to the presidency, which we award by tenure, not popularity or sentience.
But I digress.
The Senate's response, both times, was a shrug. So no--Beshear cannot conjure a vacancy, and any pundit demanding he "just appoint someone" this afternoon is selling you outrage lacking a legal basis.
But here's what the well-actually caucus never gets to: the list of things Beshear can do--this week, legally, loudly--is long.
**And he hasn 't done any of them.**
## **The Vacancy Machine They Built**
First, understand the trap Kentucky Republicans constructed, because it is a masterpiece of cynical craftsmanship. In 2024, the GOP supermajority in Frankfort passed House Bill 622, stripping the governor--this specific Democratic governor; let's not insult each other by pretending otherwise--of the power to appoint an interim senator. Passed over Beshear's veto, naturally. And nobody in Frankfort is even shy about the rest: the moment a Republican moves back into the governor's mansion, watch that appointment power wander home like a cat that heard the can opener for the chunky tuna.
Under their law, a Senate vacancy can be filled only by special election, which needs roughly 63 days of runway. Which produces an arithmetic everyone in Frankfort can do and nobody in Frankfort will say out loud: if McConnell's seat comes open on or after August 3--two weeks from now--no special election can happen before the regular one in November. The seat would sit empty until January. Kentucky--4.5 million people, Fort Knox to Fort Campbell, flood counties still waiting on recovery money, some of my favorite bars in Covington--would have half a damn voice in the United States Senate through a government-shutdown fight.
They looked at that particular outcome. They wrote it down. They passed it into law. Kentucky Republicans decided they would rather the Commonwealth have one senator than risk a Democrat signing the paperwork for a second.
A tribute to the stuff that makes up the modern GOP.
When Lindsey died, I told you Republicans were playing Weekend at Bernie's with this seat--propping up the calendar, not the man--_**because they 'd rather take their chances on November's ballot than face a special election in their worst political environment of my lifetime**_. That's all still true. But there's a part of the movie they haven't thought through. We're getting there.
Oh, and the punch line: Kentucky's own constitution--Section 152--says the governor fills vacancies for statewide office. Whether a statute can override that has never been tested in any courtroom, ever. You can bet your arse, though, Republicans would test it in a heartbeat.
Beshear has called HB 622 unconstitutional. He has threatened--there's that word again--to challenge it.
**So here is what** _**doing it**_**looks like. Five moves. One press conference. No sternly-worded letters in sight.**
They're betting Beshear won't do any of it--and betting harder that you'll never hear what "it" even is. Below the line: the binder, the pledge, the forgotten 1972 precedent, and the one date on the calendar that turns their own law into a bear trap on their own leg. Prove them wrong twice.

body:
[ https://act.jocelynbenson.com/go/9514?t=1001&akid=1734%2E181023%2EW6rcOz ][IMG]

Hi there, it’s
Jocelyn.

One of my favorite things about this campaign has been the chance to
travel across Michigan to speak to folks about the challenges they’re
facing and their hopes for the future.

From Detroit to Grand Rapids, to Petoskey to Bay City, I keep hearing
about the same tough choices far too many Michiganders are battling.

Moms who have to choose between their grocery bill and paying for
childcare.

Seniors on a fixed income not sure how to cover the cost of lifesaving
medicine.

Small business owners who are worried about how they can keep the lights
on while electricity costs skyrocket.

I know right now it’s easy to feel like we are in a broken system, and no
one is going to do something about it. That’s exactly why I’m running for
governor.

This campaign is about not only listening to the struggles of families
across our state, but doing something about it.

I know how to fix a broken system. I’ve done it as Secretary of State, and
I’m ready to roll up my sleeves and get to work on Day One as your
governor.

But I can’t do it alone. This race is going to be extremely close, and
we’re up against a Trump-endorsed MAGA loyalist who's accepted $5 million
from the DeVos family funneled into a shady super PAC. I’m running to fix
problems for everyday Michiganders — and that’s exactly whose support I

# **Treasury Blocks $100 million in payments destined for dead people**
The Treasury Department has intercepted **[nearly $100 million in federal payments headed to deceased individuals](https://substack.com/redirect/e3d2c2c6-70f8-4491-ba97-aba0b182c2a0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** since launching a government-wide payment verification system in March 2025. The agency reviewed 885 million transactions totaling roughly $2.7 trillion and flagged more than 4,900 disbursements tied to deceased payees -- more than triple the amount discovered going to dead recipients before Trump took office.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e3d2c2c6-70f8-4491-ba97-aba0b182c2a0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **The screening relies on the federal Do Not Pay program combined with expanded verification tools** and permanent access to the Social Security Administration's death records database, secured after Trump signed the Ending Improper Payments to Deceased People Act in February. Flagged payments are returned to the originating federal agencies for review before any funds are released.
* **While the $100 million represents just 0.0036% of total payments reviewed** , Treasury projects the program will generate $330 million in net benefits over time through reduced improper payments. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent credited the effort as fulfilling a core Trump administration mandate to eliminate federal waste and fraud.

body:
It starts w/ dehumanizing rhetoric, escalates to institutionalization, and ends with extermination. MAGA is dehumanizing and stripping disabled people of their rights to prime their base to accept and

|
Peter,
One of the least discussed yet most terrifying aspects of Project 2025 agenda is the effort to dehumanize disabled Americans and strip them of their rights. An endeavor that is bordering dangerously close to genocidal.
When Trump used the "R-word", a deeply offensive term used to degrade and dehumanize members of our community with intellectual disabilities, to describe Governor Tim Walz and Joe Biden, use of the term surged. The slur is now becoming renormalized and prolific on the right.
---
| [](https://eub669hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001iOIBB-0nPPKVhDJ88_BW_tNTzw5TguRYImz3-u9zEourZA-UNEDYmfXBAA0xjfUcUfzpqF6rU573h56pWY5m0v3zQmu-X4pwgKsYs9zs-m1KV9x4kV52O5kO_uaOb-9XcbYGzHGXKJLvdi07h5JbNIfywF7tBv_082iY5gnr3NtXC0NiyxwhQOBbTpDJPoqG1u8ZI5VVLLdZMAt_EuJsydPTirVRBw3ox962YK0WtMFoRWOzknkdkQ==&c=MSydWa8aYE7uBcpQwV2q3VxJVqQaAC3fLZo0AEWs8zgeWEyL2wOzqg==&ch=yM_q0RL3SIRd2VodE-cHnzduWn1ZBWzeVYZZrP-cvR1H4e6BLo12aw==)
---
The reason why Trump and MAGA are trying to renormalize this troubling word is because it dehumanizes disabled people and primes their base to accept and participate in violence committed against them.
Case in point, the Department of Justice has cleared the way to institutionalize people with disabilities en masse -- the kind of stain on our country that we thought was long past.
The last time people with disabilities were stripped of their rights, rounded up, and institutionalized was during the reign of the Third Reich. It started with dehumanizing rhetoric, escalated to institutionalization, and ended with extermination.
---
| [](https://eub669hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001iOIBB-0nPPKVhDJ88_BW_tNTzw5TguRYImz3-u9zEourZA-UNEDYmfXBAA0xjfUcUfzpqF6rU573h56pWY5m0v3zQmu-X4pwgKsYs9zs-m1KV9x4kV52O5kO_uaOb-9XcbYGzHGXKJLvdi07h5JbNIfywF7tBv_082iY5gnr3NtXC0NiyxwhQOBbTpDJPoqG1u8ZI5VVLLdZMAt_EuJsydPTirVRBw3oU7KZ29mbdVaZ3YHzQj8twA==&c=MSydWa8aYE7uBcpQwV2q3VxJVqQaAC3fLZo0AEWs8zgeWEyL2wOzqg==&ch=yM_q0RL3SIRd2VodE-cHnzduWn1ZBWzeVYZZrP-cvR1H4e6BLo12aw==)
---
I understand the gravity of these developments more than most. My mom is one of nine. When her youngest sister was born with Down Syndrome, her parents were told that she wouldn't live past three, and that she should be institutionalized. They refused, and with the support of their family, my aunt lived for almost 60 healthy and happy years.
The story of my aunt and my family that cared for her, is how I ended up as a special education teacher. I know firsthand that it's possible for people with disabilities to live full, enriched lives, surrounded by and living in a community that cherishes them.
And that leads to my Congressman, Steve Scalise (R-LA). He proudly calls himself "David Duke without the baggage" -- Duke is the former head of the KKK and an adherent to the Nazi eugenic theory that disabled people are "genetic burdens" who must be sterilized and eliminated from the gene pool.
Scalise proudly spoke at one of Duke's pro-eugenics white-supremacy rallies, voted to gut the Americans w/ Disabilities Act, and voted to cut Medicaid programs that help disabled people stay in their homes.
My name is Lauren Jewett, my family taught me that we never give up on the most vulnerable members of our society, that's why I'm proud to be the Democrat challenging Steve Scalise. Scalise needs to be stopped before people start dying.
I'm running for Congress because I believe that every person deserves the kind of life my family was able to provide for my aunt. To be safe. To be cared for. To live freely in their community.
I'm never going to stop fighting for people like my aunt. Or my students. That's why I'm ringing the alarm and need your help. MAGA is dehumanizing and stripping disabled people of their rights to prime their base to accept and | | | | | == | Peter, One of the least discussed yet most terrifying aspects of Project 2025 agenda is the effort to dehumanize disabled Americans and strip them of their rights. An endeavor that is bordering dangerously close to genocidal. When Trump used the "R-word", a deeply offensive term used to degrade and dehumanize members of our community with intellectual disabilities, to describe Governor Tim Walz and Joe Biden, use of the term surged. The slur is now becoming renormalized and prolific on the right. | == The reason why Trump and MAGA are trying to renormalize this troubling word is because it dehumanizes disabled people and primes their base to accept and participate in violence committed against them. Case in point, the Department of Justice has cleared the way to institutionalize people with disabilities en masse -- the kind of stain on our country that we thought was long past. The last time people with disabilities were stripped of their rights, rounded up, and institutionalized was during the reign of the Third Reich. It started with dehumanizing rhetoric, escalated to institutionalization, and ended with extermination. | == I understand the gravity of these developments more than most. My mom is one of nine. When her youngest sister was born with Down Syndrome, her parents were told that she wouldn't live past three, and that she should be institutionalized. They refused, and with the support of their family, my aunt lived for almost 60 healthy and happy years. The story of my aunt and my family that cared for her, is how I ended up as a special education teacher. I know firsthand that it's possible for people with disabilities to live full, enriched lives, surrounded by and living in a community that cherishes them. And that leads to my Congressman, Steve Scalise (R-LA). He proudly calls himself "David Duke without the baggage" -- Duke is the former head of the KKK and an adherent to the Nazi eugenic theory that disabled people are "genetic burdens" who must be sterilized and eliminated from the gene pool. Scalise proudly spoke at one of Duke's pro-eugenics white-supremacy rallies, voted to gut the Americans w/ Disabilities Act, and voted to cut Medicaid programs that help disabled people stay in their homes. My name is Lauren Jewett, my family taught me that we never give up on the most vulnerable members of our society, that's why I'm proud to be the Democrat challenging Steve Scalise. Scalise needs to be stopped before people start dying. I'm running for Congress because I believe that every person deserves the kind of life my family was able to provide for my aunt. To be safe. To be cared for. To live freely in their community. I'm never going to stop fighting for people like my aunt. Or my students. That's why I'm ringing the alarm and need your help. == If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | == | == | == | | | == | == | == | == | Thank you for standing with me, and with the members of our community who need our support, care, and protection. Your trust matters, and we work diligently to ensure every email you receive meets these requirements. If you need further clarification on our compliance policies or legal obligations, please feel free to ask. Whether it’s through social media, a direct call, or another channel, we’re open to finding the most effective way to share information with you. Thank you for allowing us to stay in touch with you. This footer was designed to ensure transparency, provide essential information, and give you full control over your communication preferences. | | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/9a0b11760e1d/stand-up-against-the-shameful-gop-power-grab-7363750?e=dc5f639d62)
