Iran U.S. strikes Iran for tenth straight night: The U.S. continued its bombing campaign in Iran on Monday and Tuesday, hitting several cities in the country's south and claiming "disruptions" to shipping in the Strait of Hormuz as justification. U.S. airstrikes on Monday hit Chabahar and Konarak in the southeastern Sistan and Baluchistan province, according to Iranian state media. Explosions were on Monday evening in the southern cities of Sirik, Bandar Abbas, and Bandar-Lengh as well as on Qeshm Island. Two explosions were also heard in the central city of Isfahan. Iranian retaliatory attacks: Iran launched attacks on U.S. military bases in the Gulf in response, claiming that it had successfully targeted U.S. missile-defense radar systems, air defense infrastructure and fighter planes, and units used to house U.S, military personnel. Iran's military that a Monday strike on a U.S. base in Jordan destroyed a F-15 fighter jet and a radar system, and that a separate attack struck a complex housing U.S. troops. This attack reportedly killed several American servicemembers, though the IRGC did not provide an estimate. Iran three successful attacks on U.S. bases in Kuwait on Monday, including Camp Arifjan, the Al-Adhari military camp, and a barracks at the Ahmed Al-Jaber base. The attack on Camp Arifjan reportedly struck an HIMARS missile systems, according to the Iranian Army. This attack comes one day after U.S. Central Command posted a photo of HIMARS systems deployed in the Middle East. Iranian hit and destroyed defense technology at bases near Manama, Bahrain, including a Patriot system, its military reported. Iranian missiles also struck what the Iranian military characterized as "the central data infrastructure" used by Amazon in Bahrain, according to a Monday statement. On Tuesday, Kuwait's Energy Ministry that Iranian strikes had damaged its power and desalination plants, causing fires at several sites. Nearly 100 U.S. service members wounded this month, CBS reports : Iranian strikes have wounded nearly 100 U.S. service members on American bases across the Middle East since July 7, U.S. officials CBS News. Pentagon spokesperson Sean Parnell maintained that most suffered minor concussions and said that about 96% had already returned to duty. IRGC says it will repel any U.S. incursion into Iran: The deputy commander of the IRGC's ground forces on Monday that his troops would "immediately" repel any U.S. incursion into Iranian territory, describing them as at "the highest level of readiness." Attacks in the Strait of Hormuz: At least two ships were struck in the Strait of Hormuz on Monday, with the U.S. blockade of Iran still ongoing and with Iran insisting vessels pass through the Strait through its northern route. A tanker was by an unknown projectile about eight nautical miles northeast of Oman on Monday evening, forcing the vessel's crew to abandon ship, according to the UKTMO. Another vessel was on Tuesday morning by a projectile about 17 miles east of the United Arab Emirates. The projectile, also of uncertain provenance, reportedly damaged the vessel's steering gear, according to the UKTMO, but resulted in no crew casualties. These attacks followed a statement from Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) that "massive fires" have broken out on two oil tankers that attempted to "pass through the unsafe southern route in the Strait of Hormuz." Shipowners offering bonuses to crews transiting Hormuz: Sinokor, the world's largest supertanker owner, has six months' extra pay for a roughly month-long round trip which would involve a transit through the Strait of Hormuz, Bloomberg reported on Monday. For the lowest paid crew members, this could total as much as $9,000, and for captains, it could equal $90,000. Shipowners often earn millions of dollars per Hormuz voyage, according to Bloomberg. Iran confirms Turkey helped block Kurdish insurgency plan : Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi in a Sunday interview that Turkey played an "effective" role in preventing an alleged U.S.- and Israeli-backed Kurdish insurgency from being launched against Iran from Iraqi Kurdistan earlier in the war. Araghchi's remarks corroborate earlier claims by President Donald Trump that Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan persuaded him to abandon the plan. Smotrich says Israel has "no interest" in joining Iran war: Israeli Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich on Tuesday that Israel has "no interest in joining the campaign" against Iran, speaking at a conference. "The current situation is good for us, and we have no interest in pushing ourselves into it," he said, adding that Israel is "prepared for any scenario." Lebanon Israeli attacks continue in Lebanon despite U.S.-backed "ceasefire": Israeli forces the Ali Al-Taher hills near Nabatieh Al-Fawqa on Tuesday, according to Lebanon's National News Agency. The Israeli army carried out two rounds of demolitions in Majdal Zoun, while citizens reported large explosions near the towns of in Bint Jbeil district, and the town of in Nabatieh. Israeli forces also a "massive demolition operation" in the town of Mays Al-Jabal, the NNA reported. On Monday, Israel the outskirts of Al-Mansouri, shelled Nabatieh Al-Fawqa and Kfartebnit, and demolished homes and infrastructure in Beit Yahoun, Deir Seryan, Tyri, Kfartebnit, Taybeh, and Zawtars, according to Press TV correspondent Hadi Hodeit. Israeli forces also toward Haddatha, Majdal Zoun, Zawtar Al-Gharbiyeh, and Buyout Al-Sayyad on Monday, Hoteit reported. " Pilot zone" operations begin in Lebanon: The U.S. State Department said that operations in the southern Lebanese villages of Froun, Srifa, and Zawtar al-Gharbiya were scheduled to begin on Monday, under the U.S.-brokered trilateral framework between Lebanon and Israel. The Lebanese Army on Tuesday a deployment to the town of Zawtar Al-Gharbiyeh in Nabatieh, after coordinating with the "Military Coordination Group for Lebanon," established under the framework, advising citizens to avoid returning to the town. Israeli forces opened fire near Lebanese troops as they were deploying in the town on Tuesday, according to a from the Lebanese Army. The army warned the incident could "hinder the implementation of deployment steps" in the pilot zones. The trilateral framework calls for the Lebanese Army to take control in designated "pilot zones," and for the disarmament and dismantling of Hezbollah and other armed groups' infrastructure. It also urges Israel to withdraw from southern Lebanon, but holds Israel, which has indicated it has no intention to leave the "security zone," to no concrete commitments. Palestine Killed and wounded: Over the past 24 hours, 10 Palestinians were killed, one due to wounds sustained in earlier attacks, and 42 were injured in Israeli attacks across Gaza, according to the Palestinian Ministry of Health. The total recorded death toll since October 7, 2023 has risen to 73,293 killed, with 173,906 injured. Since October 11, the first full day of the so-called ceasefire, Israel has killed at least 1,168 Palestinians in Gaza and wounded 3,798, while 802 bodies have been recovered from under the rubble. Israel continues escalated assault on Gaza: Israeli attacks on Gaza on Monday killed at least eight Palestinians and wounded more than 20 others. An Israeli drone a civilian vehicle near Al-Ghafri Junction in Gaza City, wounding up to 14 people, including children, according to local reports. Drop Site correspondent Mohamed Ahmed spoke to eyewitnesses to an attack on a makeshift shelter inside a hospital building, with a man describing its initial stages by noting that "children [were] having fun and playing football, and suddenly they started screaming." The attack killed four Palestinians and wounded at least 16 others, according to WAFA. Video of that reporting is available. In Khan Younis, a separate Israeli drone strike hit a civilian vehicle near the British Hospital in al-Mawasi, killing three Palestinians and wounding others. Israeli forces an entire family of six, including three children, in an overnight strike on a home in Gaza City as families slept. The house, which was engulfed in flames, was reportedly struck at least three times, hampering efforts to rescue survivors. "From 13 to 20 July alone, our office has recorded that the Israeli military killed at least 57 Palestinians, including six children and eight women," UN human rights office spokesperson Thameen Al-Kheetan Tuesday, addressing Israel's escalating attacks on Gaza. Israeli attacks in the occupied West Bank: Israeli settlers set to olive trees in the town of Beit Ilyan, northwest of occupied Jerusalem, as part of a series of attacks on Palestinians on Monday. Israeli settlers also to raid the village of Al-Mughir, northeast of Ramallah, storming homes in the area. Three Palestinians were after settlers attacked a home in the town of Raba, east of Jenin, assaulting a man and two of his sons. France urges EU to ban imports from illegal Israeli settlements: France is on the European Union to halt all imports of products from illegal Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank, Foreign Minister Jean-Noel Barrot said Monday. A European Commission options paper has floated an import licensing system, higher tariffs, and even an outright ban on products from the West Bank, though the bloc remains split over whether and which measures to enact. France, Spain, Sweden, Belgium, and Ireland have been pushing for the EU to restrict settlement trade, while Germany, Austria, the Czech Republic, Hungary, and others oppose EU-wide action. A 2024 International Court of Justice opinion said states must avoid trade that sustains the settlements, which are illegal under international law. Abbas reportedly planning election law change that could block Barghouti from PLO leadership : Palestinian President Mahmoud Abbas is to amend election law to restore the Palestinian Legislative Council to 132 seats while allocating 68 additional Palestinian National Council seats to be filled by "consensus," widely understood to mean appointment, The New Arab reported, citing two Palestinian officials. Constitutional law expert Rashad Tuam said the change would likely be used to keep imprisoned Fatah leader Marwan Barghouti from becoming PLO chairman even if elected Palestinian Authority president, since only National Council members could seek the PLO's top post. U.S. News By Julian Andreone, with Ryan Grim. Have a tip on Capitol Hill? Email Andreone at. Man killed fleeing ICE in Florida was on valid tourist visa : Juan Jairo Coronilla Duran , the 28-year-old Mexican man killed by a semi-truck while fleeing an ICE traffic stop in St. Augustine, Florida, on July 14, was in the U.S. on a had been in the country for just three weeks, his wife Y esica Alamilla Lopez told Spectrum News. Coronilla Duran was days away from a planned return flight to Mexico when he died, according to farmworker advocate Isaret Jeffers , who has been assisting Duran's family in the wake of his killing. DHS revives rule tying immigrant benefit use to green card eligibility : The Department of Homeland Security a new "public charge" policy Monday that restores the ability for immigration officers to weigh immigrants' use of Medicaid, CHIP, and SNAP when deciding green card eligibility, Axios reported, reversing Biden-era limits that largely restricted such determinations to cash welfare benefits. A KFF-New York Times survey found that 11% of adult immigrants said they stopped participating in public benefit programs in 2025 due to immigration-related concerns. Public health groups, including the president of the American Academy of Pediatrics, warned the rule could deter immigrant families from seeking health coverage even for citizen children. Judge temporarily blocks Paramount 's $111 billion Warner Bros. Discovery deal: A federal judge a 14-day temporary restraining order Monday halting Paramount's $111 billion purchase of Warner Bros. Discovery while she weighs a lawsuit brought by 12 states arguing the merger violates antitrust law, The New York Times reported. Judge Araceli Mart inez-Olguin of the Northern District of California said the states made "a strong showing" the deal would substantially lessen competition and set an early August hearing on a possible injunction. DOJ sought phone records of NYT journalists, relatives in leak probe : The Trump administration subpoenas to third-party providers seeking phone and text records of several New York Times journalists and their relatives, including one reporter's mother, as part of an effort to unmask sources for reporting on security concerns with Trump's new Air Force One jet, according to a motion unsealed Monday by Judge Arun Subramanian of the U.S. District Court in Manhattan. The Times, seeking to quash the subpoenas, argued the Justice Department violated its own guidelines for media subpoenas and sought records dating back to January, well before the disputed articles, calling it a "bad-faith effort to intimidate the journalists." A hearing is scheduled for Thursday. Judge dismisses DOJ challenge to Minnesota immigration laws A federal judge nominated by President Trump with Minnesota on Monday, dismissing the Justice Department's lawsuit challenging state and local laws that limit cooperation with federal immigration authorities, according to the New York Times. The Trump administration filed the lawsuit before federal agents flooded Minnesota last year. During the crackdown, Trump and his allies repeatedly accused Minnesota of subverting federal authority by insufficiently cooperating with immigration agents. New Orleans police briefly published policy allowing weaponized drones : A draft version of the New Orleans Police Department's drone operations manual, live on its website in June, would have allowed the department to arm quadcopter drones with the police superintendent's written approval, before being replaced July 1 with language again banning weaponized drones, 404 Media . NOPD said the weaponization language was an early draft that was never adopted, though the department did not explain how or why it was published. Trump-linked 'Freedom Fuel' gas chain tied to operators with history of fraud: The "Freedom Fuel Network," a chain of discounted gas stations launched in Philadelphia and promoted by the White House as delivering a 50-cent-per-gallon discount in Trump's honor, is run by brothers Syed and Shamikh Kazmi , who have a history of unpaid debts, default judgments and failed business deals, Maureen Tkacik of the The American Prospect reports. The company's incorporation documents name energy trader Yonatan Gontownik , whose family has deep ties to pro-Israel lobbying group NORPAC. Gontownik's trading firm, Mercuria, has seen its profits skyrocket in the wake of the U.S.-Iran War. Read Tkacik's full piece for TAP . Trump says Netanyahu will not be arrested: In response to New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani's comments that an arrest of Israeli Prime Minister in New York remains "in active consideration," President Trump in a Truth Social post on Monday that Netanyahu, would "not be arrested, in any way, shape, or form" while in the United States. The ICC issued an arrest warrant for Netanyahu on November 21, 2024; he is accused of war crimes, including using starvation as a method of warfare and intentionally directing attacks against civilians. State Department releases report accusing Cuba of "infiltrating" American left-wing: The State Department a 100-page report on Monday purporting to show connections between the government of the island nation and various figures on the American left, including the national Democratic Socialists of America, Reps. Ilhan Omar and Ayanna Pressley (as well as Omar's daughter), Los Angeles Mayor Karen Bass , the Black Lives Matter Movement, CODEPINK founder Medea Benjamin , and streamer Hasan Piker. The report alleges that Cuba has "infiltrated the highest reaches of the U.S. government" and "cultivated generations of American activists," citing a visit to March 2026 junket to Cuba, then as now under a crippling fuel blockade, as its primary evidence. Benjamin told Drop Site that CODEPINK is now under Treasury Department investigation for bringing medical supplies to Cuban children's hospitals. "The people delivering medicine are under investigation, not the officials enforcing policies that deprive Cubans of medicine, food, fuel, and electricity," she said. "Why is the State Department naming American citizens in their Cuba report where they seemingly complain about our opinions on US sanctions policy?" Piker wrote. "This is absolutely protected by the 1st Amendment. They are trying to chill speech through intimidation." On Tuesday, Rep. Pramila Jayapal an outline of the effects of Washington's decades-long blockade, calling the policy one of "collective punishment" and noting how it chokes off access to food, medicine, fuel, and other basic necessities. Other International News Israel shoots two children in southern Syria: Israeli forces shot and two Syrian children on Monday during a raid into the southern village of Jamla, Syria's state news agency SANA reported. Syrian authorities gave no further detail on the children's condition. Jamla is part of the Yarmouk basin, a border region into which Israeli troops have expanded their presence since the fall of Bashar al-Assad's government in 2024. Syria says that these operations violate the 1974 disengagement agreement, which Israel unilaterally declared void upon the fall of Assad's government. U.S. hits Canada with new 50% tariffs: President Trump on Monday that the U.S. would impose 50% tariffs on roughly $20 billion worth of Canadian goods, alleging that these tariffs are a response "discriminatory treatment" of American cars, alcohol, and dairy exports by Canada. Trump invoked Section 338 of the Tariff Act of 1930 to justify his newest series of tariffs, a largely untested provision which some Democratic lawmakers attempted to appeal last year, anticipating Trump's future use of it and its potential economic effects. The tariffs take effect August 19 and cover goods ranging from wine and hockey sticks to cement, as well as goods that had previously been protected from import taxes by the U.S.-Mexico-Canada Agreement. Energy products, potash, and critical minerals are among the exemptions. Police clash with 'Cockroach' movement protesters in India: Police tear gas and used batons on more than 10,000 protesters from India's youth-led "Cockroach" movement as they marched on the New Delhi parliament on Monday, the group's largest demonstration yet. The "Cockroach" movement, which is focused on corruption in the country's education system, is demanding the resignation of Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan, after his role in exam leaks that forced more than 2 million prospective medical students to retake their exam. Activist Sonam Wangchuk, who has been on hunger strike for three weeks in solidarity with the movement, was forcibly hospitalized on Saturday, adding to the anger of the protesters. Flash floods kill at least 20 in eastern Afghanistan : Flash floods in eastern Afghanistan's Nuristan province on Monday at least 20 people and left 80 more wounded, Afghan officials said, with more than 100 people still missing. The worst-hit area was Parun, the province's capital, where floodwaters destroyed a municipal center, hotels, and dozens of shops, according to AFP. The missing include the Parun's mayor and several government employees. The death toll is expected to rise. Floods and landslides kill at least 25 across northern India: At least 25 people were over the weekend in floods and landslides across Indian-administered Kashmir and in the state of Nagaland following days of torrential monsoon rain, local officials said Monday. Kashmir's Poonch, Rajouri, and Doda districts saw at least 15 deaths and reported several people missing, while nine died in landslides in the northeastern Nagaland. One person also died in Assam. The flooding prompted authorities to suspend the Amarnath and Vaishno Devi pilgrimages, the first of which drew over 400,000 people last year. India's weather office warned active monsoon conditions are expected to persist for weeks. Saudi coalition responds to Ansarallah maritime blockade, Saudi-backed government announces resumption of oil exports: The Saudi-led coalition in Yemen, a military alliance assembled by Riyadh in 2015 to fight Ansarallah, on Monday it was taking steps to shield vessels in the Red Sea and would respond "decisively and forcefully" after Ansarallah's recent declaration of a naval blockade on Saudi Arabia. A spokesperson for the coalition also dismissed claims that Yemeni ports and airports had been closed as "misinformation," and denied accusations from Ansarallah that Saudi Arabia was "besieging" the Yemeni people. Rashid al-Alimi, the head of Yemen's Saudi-backed government, also the resumption of oil exports from the country, suspended since late 2022, in a televised address on Monday. Al-Alimi said the government would seek to resume exports "by all available means" starting July 20, but did not detail how. Yemen's exports of oil, which were minor but steady prior to a rapid decrease during the war, were halted after Ansarallah struck oil terminals in southern Yemen. On Tuesday, Yemeni Defense Minister Taher al-Uqaili that his armed forces were prepared with "the highest level of combat and morale to end the Houthi coup," calling the conflict a "war for freedom." Militants kill at least 50 soldiers in Mali: Al-Qaeda-linked and Tuareg separatist fighters a Malian army convoy on Saturday in the northern Gao region, killing at least 50 soldiers and capturing more than 20 others, according to the AFP. The al-Qaeda affiliate JNIM and the Tuareg separatist Azawad Liberation Front (FLA) claimed responsibility for the assault, which they characterized as a joint operation, saying they inflicted "great human losses" and destroyed army vehicles. The army said its partners, likely a reference to Russia's Africa Corps mercenaries, were also hit. UN: Nearly 400,000 face emergency food insecurity in North Kordofan : The United Nations on Monday that nearly 400,000 displaced people across North Kordofan's Sheikan, Bara and Gharb Bara districts face emergency levels of acute food insecurity, citing estimates from the World Food Programme. UN spokesperson Stephane Dujarric noted the body's particular concern about conditions in El Obeid, where thousands have been displaced as a result of fighting in the region, and where humanitarian conditions have sharply deteriorated. Ortega says Nicaragua will no longer hold elections: Nicaraguan President Daniel Ortega supporters on Sunday that Nicaragua will stop holding elections, framing the move as necessary to block a U.S.-backed opposition from seizing power, Reuters reported. Ortega, who has held power since 2007, made the announcement at an event commemorating the 1979 Sandinista revolution. Ortega's government has been accused by the UN Human Rights Council of "arbitrary detentions, torture, extrajudicial executions [and the] persecution of civil society and the media". Nicaragua's last elections were held in 2021, with Ortega being elected co-president alongside his wife, Rosario Murillo. UN official: Haitian children jailed for years without trial : UN Special Representative for Children and Armed Conflict Vanessa Frazier the Security Council on Monday that some children in Haiti have been jailed up to eight years without appearing before a judge. Frazier said these child detainees are often held in overcrowded cells designed for minors, but mostly housing adults. She called the situation "amongst the most alarming anywhere in the world," and pleaded that these children, who are often arrested for their gang ties, be treated primarily as victims and be released. Eduardo Bolsonaro secures U.S. green card : Eduardo Bolsonaro, the son of former Brazilian President Jair Bolsonaro and an ally of Trump, Reuters on Monday he had received permanent U.S. residency. Eduardo, who has lived in the U.S. since early 2025, was sentenced in June to four years and two months in prison in Brazil for soliciting U.S. interference in his father's trial. He claimed that he was approved under the EB-1A category, which permits "individuals with extraordinary abilities" to move to the U.S. Senator Flavio Bolsonaro, brother of Eduardo Bolsonaro, is currently the leading right-wing candidate in Brazil's presidential election scheduled for October. Ed Miliband appointed UK foreign secretary : Ed Miliband, who led Britain's Labour party until its defeat in the 2015 general election, was foreign secretary Monday by new Prime Minister Andy Burnham, whose recent ascent he reportedly helped to engineer. Miliband, who had served as "energy security secretary" under Prime Minister Keir Starmer, pledged in a letter to strengthen ties with the EU and Washington. He also vowed to work towards a "sustainable peace" between Israelis and Palestinians. He has been at times critical of Israel, especially during its 2014 assault on Gaza, but has tempered this with condemnations of Hamas, opposition to the BDS movement, and, following party guidance, abstaining on a ceasefire vote in 2023. Japan protests China live-fire drills : Japan a diplomatic protest against China on Tuesday over live-fire drills, also involving Russian vessels, held near Okinotori Island in what Tokyo says is its exclusive economic zone, Reuters reported. China's foreign ministry called the concerns "completely unreasonable," and disputed Japan's territorial claim over Okinotori, which it claims is a reef, not an island. | | | Friend,He was trusted with the most precious thing in the world. _Other people's children._ For 27 years, Dennis Jutras walked the halls of Baltimore City schools. He taught history. He mentored students. In 2005, he was named **Teacher of the Year.** **Parents trusted him.** **Children ****trusted him.** And then came the moment that revealed what was hiding beneath that trusted title.
---
[](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=6f3df7275fb84f58ad1cd38a4b9489c6&_e=pIpe2GA_0Gj_0dbr10PeI8AMreGnwondGjb-N1jv5-EnW2FMwooT7NTrHHb1tY6Fho2aXgMb18eCl03UfjKiL8mKUd2ZLRkPtjiO9q0BTegEVgpql4-SV8sHl0lAxPp7pkwsmzEASC6IKX74ZGS_lIbJYo6d9b5PsWqAbjbKgo-VGYesGw25FjHHKuND7LG_yV_GjoHoJ8X7ttui565mY8qIwabIPLVCVZCpEebPHKivV9gBTyhg94yPNdfEbcgjmIK7eeyBrmshRau9NY3iGzbvVhwDnAS_Q_-6tlAK6ctd4BV9j9JE4zKJX6Y6OCwgr0RPSxKXbeEWHdlzc4BYOXhVCimCTw59h9cGpsZAxEoyZdhE6XJKhEEZbRsSw8beLnE1K-70ValaJr06i0iqw4vnzhT-6SQkVQzOQcm-3GibKP2WOQRn8kFOrS7319epbMDKBzTmo6IHT6cC5ow1jW2eDkpms23eELGutaZ83oMKtzfDuxxbEGlsEQBY7xkLDksgt8D5KXxmSNvt8YQZJY0FunugNnmRtCnSVXs6501W1KM1T3Lex_FXO6My0sJW_nQowwI48NZDWBAhZ-rQN3QICPJ2PjIXC5HOvaxpUMrT8IqI_rF-f4SIDQ6fgMOeuOKKeWRUgpWopV7MycvBLV9JtRQ3CBTMfqDclyOP0ppHQLwg6xzZiFevv6NL5RhBmDgVaLvvnuzfe7qOkSaDmw%3D%3D)

But he did not meet a child. _He met law enforcement._ Thanks to a brave undercover detective and a sting operation organized by the Harford County Sheriff's Office, Jutras was taken into custody on the spot. He is now behind bars, held without bail. Friend, my name is Eduardo Verastegui. I produced the film _Sound of Freedom_ because I believe that exposing the evil of child exploitation is one of the most urgent callings of our time. And what happened in Baltimore is exactly why **the fight has never been more urgent.** Because this predator was not lurking in the shadows.

He was standing at the front of a classroom. He visited multiple schools every single day. **He had direct access to children** **And no one suspected a thing.** That is the terrifying truth about child exploitation that _Sound of Freedom_ tried to show the world: _evil does not always look like evil. _ It hides behind titles. Behind smiling faces in school hallways. Behind trust. Sheriff Jeffrey Gahler said it plainly after the arrest: _"Someone's child, boy or girl, underage, is going to be criminally assaulted by these people if we're not out there intercepting them."_ **He is right. **And that is exactly why the **Sound of Freedom Foundation exists. **

**Greetings, Fellow Alaskans and Friends: **
**I'm going to share with you what my team just shared with the media. That way, you won't get a spin. You'll hear it straight from the horse's mouth. And in this case, we are that horse. We are the dark horse that came out of the gate, few bet on, the media dismissed, and the polls disregarded. Yet we have steadily gained ground, our pace has dramatically picked up, and Alaskans are no longer ignoring our ticket. "Undecideds" are deciding on Hughes/Gettys. Supporters of other candidates are switching to the Hughes camp. We are grateful! Enjoy our press release below, and please tell everyone you know to "Choose Hughes . . . and Gettys too!"**

**Candidate for Governor With An Actual Plan: ****Why Shelley Hughes is Different**
---
**Team Hughes/Gettys is the best leadership team with a PLAN! It’s easy for politicians to make lots of promises for votes, but without a plan, they’re all empty. Shelley and Blake are committed Alaskans ready to serve their state with integrity, wisdom and determination to take Alaska to the next level and make Alaska the best place in our nation to raise children, own a business, and strengthen communities to thrive with opportunities for all.**
**"I am committed to ensuring Alaska remains not only a great place to live for this generation and the next, but an even greater one — with abundant opportunity, a thriving economy, safe and vibrant communities, and strong families.**
**With a clear vision and practical solutions, I will lead and work with others to unlock the wealth beneath our feet and the wealth within the people of Alaska.**
**My priorities are clear: put our fiscal house in order, secure affordable energy, diversify our economy, defend Alaska’s rights and lands, expand transportation infrastructure, open doors to good paying jobs, ensure student learning, and build a skilled workforce. These challenges are significant, but they must be met. And I will be ready at the helm. Together, we can do this."**** -** **Shelley Hughes**

name: Dave Beckwith for Congress
subject: Loudoun residents used their voices to stop the powerlines

body:
Now it's your turn to use your voice and vote Dave Beckwith for congress in VA-10
| | | | Good morning Friend,
On June 29, state regulators approved a route for the Golden to Mars transmission line that puts towering monopoles behind homes in Ashburn's Loudoun Valley Estates neighborhood and near Rock Ridge High School.
Two weeks later, the Loudoun County School Board met and voted to appeal that decision and to ban future power lines on school property. That is local government standing up for families, and it is exactly why voting early and voting for Dave in this election matters.

**Vote early. Vote in person. Vote Dave Beckwith.**
This is exactly the type of issue Dave will continue to fight for in Congress, and early voting is open right now! __Find your county's location at the end of this email,__ and make your plan to get out and vote.

Virginia now hosts the largest concentration of data centers _on earth_ , and the power lines needed to feed them are being routed through neighborhoods and school property because the grid was never built for this kind of demand. The School Board did what it could within its authority, and the State Corporation Commission is a state body. **But neither one controls the federal energy policy that created this crunch in the first place.**

**My vision for Virginia is to produce more of its own power instead of importing it across the state on massive transmission lines** , and I will support a National Institutes of Health study on the health effects of high-voltage lines near homes and schools. In Congress, **I will push federal investment in reliable, American-made power, including nuclear, so families in Ashburn are not the ones absorbing the cost of a grid that cannot keep up.**

This month, Loudoun families packed a school gymnasium to fight for their neighborhood, proof that showing up counts. Now it's your turn to vote early and make your voice count too.
If you do cast your vote early, respond to this email! I'd love to hear about your experience.
---
| | | God Bless, Dave Beckwith
**Beckwith for Congress** _Restoring Faith in the American Dream_
---
|
---

* **Electricity rates climb sharply:** Since the Climate Leadership and Community Protection Act passed, New York electricity rates have risen at three times the national pace and now stand 44% higher than the U.S. average.
* **Cuomo blasts tax policies:** Former Governor Andrew Cuomo told Fox Business that Mamdani's demonization of the rich and corporations is chasing wealth and jobs to southern states such as Texas and Florida.
* **Socialism aids Republicans most:** Cuomo stated socialism has not worked anywhere, free everything is a utopia that someone always pays for, and this socialist movement is the best thing the Republicans have going for them.

# [Trump just hit Canada with 50% tariffs on cars, dairy and booze](https://substack.com/redirect/f4208d66-ac41-43a1-8d48-44a710a5ce39?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
President Trump signed three proclamations on Monday **[imposing 50% tariffs on Canadian automobiles, dairy and alcohol products](https://substack.com/redirect/14a6a433-c093-4874-be7b-794d67248f12?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** in response to continued discrimination against U.S. commerce, with the duties set to take effect after 30 days.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f4208d66-ac41-43a1-8d48-44a710a5ce39?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Wide range of goods:** The tariffs cover a broad array of Canadian products ranging from wine to hockey sticks to cement, with the automobile proclamation alone listing 18 pages of eligible goods.
* **Section 338 authority used:** The duties are levied under Section 338 of the Tariff Act of 1930 and will apply even to goods previously exempted under the US-Mexico-Canada Agreement.
* **Key exemptions listed:** Oil, potash, fish, critical minerals, steel and many auto parts facing national security tariffs are excluded from the new measures.
* **Canadian chamber seeks talks:** The Canadian Chamber of Commerce called the escalation regrettable and urged both sides to use the 30-day window for meaningful progress on formal talks.

# [The biggest share unlock in history hits two days after SpaceX earnings](https://substack.com/redirect/f4208d66-ac41-43a1-8d48-44a710a5ce39?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
SpaceX stock **[rose more than 5% on Tuesday after the company set Aug. 4](https://substack.com/redirect/03e0b238-8fe6-47ae-b983-a18b2d095de8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** as the date for its first quarterly earnings report, which triggers the initial lock-up expiration allowing insiders to sell up to 911.5 million shares.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f4208d66-ac41-43a1-8d48-44a710a5ce39?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **First earnings trigger unlock:** The Aug. 4 report enables insiders to sell 20% of eligible locked-up stock, with an additional 10% possible if shares close at least 30% above the IPO price for five of the prior ten trading days.
* **Shares well below peak:** SpaceX stock has fallen nearly half its value from the June 16 intraday high of $225.64 and 43% from the all-time closing high of $211.39.
* **Heavy short interest builds:** Short sellers have increased bets against the stock, which recently reached about one-third of the public float as the limited share supply has constrained trading.
* **Starship launch planned:** SpaceX aims to fly its Starship rocket on Thursday after an earlier abort caused by engines that failed to ignite, while also launching Falcon 9 Starlink missions.

# [Boeing and Airbus gear up for a battle customers aren't ready for yet yet](https://substack.com/redirect/f4208d66-ac41-43a1-8d48-44a710a5ce39?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Boeing and Airbus are **[preparing next-generation narrow-body aircraft programs,](https://substack.com/redirect/acaa1068-6db7-43ba-b33c-0fe30bc36109?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/acaa1068-6db7-43ba-b33c-0fe30bc36109?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)but both CEOs say airline customers remain focused on receiving current jets rather than pressing for all-new models amid ongoing production constraints.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f4208d66-ac41-43a1-8d48-44a710a5ce39?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Boeing needs more time:** CEO Kelly Ortberg said the company requires a couple more years to get its financial house in order before launching a new commercial aircraft program.
* **Airbus targets 2030 launch:** Airbus CEO Guillaume Faury is aiming to launch a next-generation single-aisle program around 2030 with entry into service in the second half of the following decade.
* **Customers prioritize existing fleets:** Airlines are telling manufacturers to focus on maturing current product lines and improving delivery reliability before considering new airplanes.
* **Production remains primary focus:** Investors are concentrating on Boeing's 737 Max output ramp, Max-7 and Max-10 certification progress, and Airbus A320-family delivery growth rather than future programs.

# [Consumers rejected EVs so Cadillac is building new gas cars and its working](https://substack.com/redirect/f4208d66-ac41-43a1-8d48-44a710a5ce39?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
General Motors **[beat second-quarter expectations and raised full-year guidance](https://substack.com/redirect/f23177cd-b282-446b-adca-79d055575b34?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/f23177cd-b282-446b-adca-79d055575b34?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)while announcing **[new gas-powered Cadillac models](https://substack.com/redirect/160e53d5-7c5b-4780-9e48-bfd7166ecb55?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** starting next spring as the company continues its pullback from all-electric vehicles.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f4208d66-ac41-43a1-8d48-44a710a5ce39?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Strong Q2 results posted:** Adjusted earnings reached $3.57 per share versus $3.20 expected and revenue hit $48.03 billion against $47.01 billion estimates, driven by North American operations.
* **Full-year forecasts lifted:** GM raised adjusted EBIT guidance to $14 billion to $16 billion and adjusted EPS to $12 to $14 while lowering net income expectations to $8.4 billion to $9.8 billion.
* **New ICE Cadillacs planned:** CEO Mary Barra said next-generation gas versions of the CT5 sedan, XT5 midsize SUV and previously discontinued XT6 three-row SUV will launch starting next spring through 2028.
* **EV charges largely complete:** The company has recorded $10.9 billion in EV-related charges since the second half of last year and has paid $4.5 billion of an expected $7.2 billion in related cash charges.

# [The Nvidia 9.3% filing that sent this AI stock soaring today](https://substack.com/redirect/f4208d66-ac41-43a1-8d48-44a710a5ce39?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Nebius shares[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/9ec21c2c-0b65-4679-b465-1fbd64b127fc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[surged 6% on Tuesday after Nvidia disclosed a 9.3% stake](https://substack.com/redirect/9ec21c2c-0b65-4679-b465-1fbd64b127fc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** in the Amsterdam-based AI cloud provider through an SEC filing, extending the stock's nearly 250% gain over the past 12 months.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f4208d66-ac41-43a1-8d48-44a710a5ce39?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Nvidia stake confirmed:** The chipmaker's filing revealed the 9.3% ownership position following its earlier announced $2 billion investment in the company.
* **AI infrastructure deals grow:** Nebius has signed multiple agreements with tech giants, including a long-term Meta commitment of up to $27 billion for AI infrastructure.
* **Market value reaches $46 billion:** The stock's strong performance has pushed Nebius's market capitalization to $46 billion as of Tuesday morning.
* **Debt facility secured:** Nebius recently raised $775 million in its first senior secured debt facility backed by deployed GPU infrastructure and contracted cash flows.

Peter,
I know that the endless corruption and chaos coming out of this White House can feel overwhelming and distracting, and frankly, can make it hard to stay hopeful.
Let me tell you: this is all part of their strategy, and we can’t let it work on us.
Donald Trump ran on making things more affordable, but instead of solving our affordability crisis, he’s been busy creating a whole new host of problems instead. While Americans are struggling to pay for groceries, prescriptions, and rent, this administration is building a ballroom, redesigning the Reflecting Pool, and putting Trump’s face on our money.
Instead of passing policies to make our lives better, this administration is engaging in blatantly corrupt schemes and enriching themselves at our expense.
Instead of creating a better future for our children, they’re destroying our public education systems, cutting nutrition assistance for millions of kids, and spreading vaccine misinformation.
Instead of making our communities safer, this administration is tearing them apart with their aggressive and violent ICE tactics and reversing historic progress on gun safety.
The fact is that Donald Trump and his administration have no plan to make life better for everyday American families because they only care about themselves and their wealthy friends and donors.
But here’s what I know to be true: a safer, more affordable, more just America is possible — and it’s worth fighting for.
To get there, we have to flip the House in November — and that work starts right now.
Wednesday night is our last pre-primary FEC fundraising deadline of this election, which means that every dollar we raise before then makes a big difference in what we can accomplish before November. I could really use your help right now, so will you chip in before tomorrow night to help us keep this fight going? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/morrison-em-26]
CHIP IN [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/morrison-em-26]
We don’t have to buy what the Trump administration is selling us.
Access to affordable, quality healthcare is possible. An economy that works for all of us — not just the wealthiest among us — is possible. An immigration system grounded in safety, dignity, and justice is possible. Electing leaders who put the people over profits is possible.
We can protect women's bodily autonomy and our right to access safe, science-backed reproductive care. We can address Trump’s affordability crisis and deliver real relief for working families. We can defend our democracy and the constitutional checks and balances this administration has been working hard to dismantle over the last year and a half.
But to do any of that, we have to win in November. Will you chip in to our campaign before Wednesday night? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/morrison-em-26]

Fellow Patriot,

After the sudden death of my brother, Lindsey Graham, I was appointed by Governor Henry McMaster to represent South Carolina in the United States Senate.

**President Trump encouraged me to consider running in the Special Election by saying, "Run, Darline, Run!" Now, with the President's _"Complete and Total Endorsement," I'm running to represent South Carolina for a full term in the United States Senate._**

I've spent a lot of time talking and praying with my family. This was not a decision I made lightly. I know it will be difficult, _**but I am ready.**_

I know what Lindsey cared about, and we shared the same conservative values. He cared deeply about the people of South Carolina. With what I learned from Lindsey and my nearly 30 years of helping people of the state find dignity through work, I am ready to take on this next challenge.

It's time for me to step up for South Carolina, just like Lindsey stepped up for me when our parents died. I've learned God often calls on ordinary people to do extraordinary things in the most challenging of times.

I am not Lindsey. I have my own way of doing things. But we were raised with the same values: work hard each day, trust in the Lord, remember your roots, and never forget who you work for.

I did not seek this moment, Fellow Patriot.

But after many prayers and speaking with my family, I know I am making the right decision to run for this seat. **[However, I cannot do this alone.](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=3271e2bcaac84dffa0d90c57e9ff5a3a&_e=ou0i0zgWhr-_bF50Zm86xRTuUNiNTrHpQaJ8mQgxbhFNu2abM44WFfCbXXWW_jAvkDvVSa8LyAjnA9ArLYhGDExr2h77F9KtM82Ta1Kv0Gab4L5sairiaG9JpuNY8r7ZfrseHYwep75BZuLJCFS4Z3aU_te4y0aXvQvJ3XsJxYym3-_vaT1waEyX_sd_mrdI1PvFtodC_YmLO3DkKXLru02_4s9AvFf6GcQmRvfHkFbrgSPK1AOYOBBZRlJNe0oe0MwwLPvjC99X4x4xyOVtZPBDFiAGVyvAsn6P2wVysbWB1J7gUnmPxqsAm02IxjDsyfwYjZFFshDuzXksI3j4OdUC6bSeaNy6hnovhG0DajV1qHrDFT7C1IdlYxl-6_zTmd24BDMUgANr4LVhPgNW0aDR7PYrEzsAF2tq_p78hnQZhPfz8bkMSTZs-LDoo7f0xiDNbyWQOPItOydinlieKYpKJyQ5FwPcD7hUNC_nwk0lgSNdZtMLTvPR2unxdkI40KtYOsZeEuMWtKaf_Aq-QsJdMhgXkbKBnVk9-5gIp9pKf_mG3z0tGpECkU4cMoBxVOX6CnGxdYWphJGpLSgRRMKjP0DZE0j9tqnqg9wWWljuSGhIgjrU_BTeaoa8-h7PvkBxTYpqeg2ZZBEQ_A7KtHQxYMMMxPVDED4MdU2Gdphu4k7vpbPok8UpPjxNqrUmaN0dt2hrt-zlpR9Uy7Uh0jtMdo_gXpHMCytvrXXJdD0xPsBi4DToGcSJTd43IOFn)**

clean_body: I'm ready for the fight ahead, and I'm all in to run for the United States Senate. | Fellow Patriot, After the sudden death of my brother, Lindsey Graham, I was appointed by Governor Henry McMaster to represent South Carolina in the United States Senate. President Trump encouraged me to consider running in the Special Election by saying, "Run, Darline, Run!" Now, with the President's "Complete and Total Endorsement," I'm running to represent South Carolina for a full term in the United States Senate. I've spent a lot of time talking and praying with my family. This was not a decision I made lightly. I know it will be difficult, but I am ready. I know what Lindsey cared about, and we shared the same conservative values. He cared deeply about the people of South Carolina. With what I learned from Lindsey and my nearly 30 years of helping people of the state find dignity through work, I am ready to take on this next challenge. It's time for me to step up for South Carolina, just like Lindsey stepped up for me when our parents died. I've learned God often calls on ordinary people to do extraordinary things in the most challenging of times. I am not Lindsey. I have my own way of doing things. But we were raised with the same values: work hard each day, trust in the Lord, remember your roots, and never forget who you work for. I did not seek this moment, Fellow Patriot. But after many prayers and speaking with my family, I know I am making the right decision to run for this seat. I'll be straight with you - I am behind financially. My opponents are self-funding millionaires or have spent years building up their campaign war chests, but I'm new to politics. We have less than 3 weeks to run against people who have been at this for years. Since you were there for Lindsey, Thank you for everything you did for Lindsey over the years. I know that having people like you in his corner meant everything to him. God bless, Darline Graham P.S. It's been a difficult week. [1]Justice Democrats

We have two weeks, Peter.

In 14 days, we can deliver another blow to the establishment, send
democratic socialist Donavan McKinney to fight for MI-13 in Congress, and
retire multimillionaire Rep. Shri Thanedar — another Do-Nothing Democrat
who’s spent more time protecting the status quo than fighting for the
people who elected him.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260721-1-dm.h_7uYS&refcode=em20260721-38060&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=1002&akid=38060%2E1203867%2E6rqdP3 ]If that’s all you need to hear, rush $10 to Donavan’s
campaign and Justice Democrats right now to help get him over the finish
line on August 4th >>

Since he was first elected to Congress, Shri has received nearly $2.5
million in funding from AIPAC. So when given the chance to side with the
majority of his voting base who support cutting $3.3 billion in U.S.
military funding to Israel, he unsurprisingly failed to step up.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260721-1-dm.h_7uYS&refcode=em20260721-38060&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=1003&akid=38060%2E1203867%2E6rqdP3 ]Tweet from @DonavanMI13: "Once again, Shri Thanedar proved he'd rather
spend $ dropping bombs on families overseas than help our families here at
home. It's unacceptable. Detroit, we deserve better. We deserve someone
who knows our struggles & needs, and who will always fight to put us first
in Congress."

It’s exactly what we’ve come to expect from fake progressive politicians
funded by corrupt special interests. They’ll tell you they’re fighting for
working people — until the pro-Israel lobby and corporate super PACs
bankrolling their campaigns expect otherwise.

Detroit deserves better than another one of AIPAC’s stooges who protects a
broken system instead of fighting for the will of the people he’s meant to
serve.

Detroit deserves a working-class leader like Donavan who will actually
fight for them and knows what working families are up against, because
he’s lived the struggles himself.

Unlike Shri — a multimillionaire who’s self-funding his campaign and
receiving nearly a million in Super PAC support from corporate interests
like Crypto — Donavan won’t chase corporate checks, protect the status quo
failing us, or sell out the people who sent him to Washington.

Instead, he’s ready to fight for the change people are desperate for:
Medicare for All, a Green New Deal, abolishing ICE, ending the genocide in
Palestine, getting big money out of politics, and finally making
billionaires pay their fair share.

Like all Justice Democrats, Donavan’s refusing corporate PAC money and
counting on grassroots supporters to get him across the finish line. And
with just two weeks left until the primary, every ounce of support
counts, Peter.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260721-1-dm.h_7uYS&refcode=em20260721-38060&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=1004&akid=38060%2E1203867%2E6rqdP3 ]We have another chance to show the establishment that when working
people organize, we win. split $10 to Donavan’s campaign and
Justice Democrats now to help secure another win for our progressive
movement.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260721-1-dm.h_7uYS&refcode=em20260721-38060&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=1023&akid=38060%2E1203867%2E6rqdP3 ]Contribute $10

name: Autism Health
subject: Join Our Webinar this Saturday on Gut Health!
body:
Join Our July Monthly Webinar

We invite you to join us this Saturday, July 25th at 9:00 AM PST / 12:00 PM EST for an engaging and educational webinar featuring Dr. Basima Williams on Understanding the Impact of the Gut Microbiome on the Immune System.

The gut microbiome plays a vital role in overall health, influencing immune function, inflammation, digestion, and neurological well being. During this presentation, Dr. Williams will explore the powerful relationship between the gut and the immune system, discuss emerging research, and explain why optimizing gut health is an important consideration for individuals with autism and other complex health conditions.

Whether you are a parent, caregiver, healthcare professional, or advocate, this webinar offers valuable information that can help you better understand one of the most important systems affecting overall health.

Advance registration is required. Please register using the Zoom link below to reserve your spot.

We look forward to seeing you online!
REGISTER HERE (https://us06web.zoom.us/webinar/register/WN_CcSG3osHTduoYUHC-bG0lQ?mc_cid=07c3bb6ca7&mc_eid=UNIQID#/registration)

** Join Our Cocktails for A Cause Fundraiser
------------------------------------------------------------

We are excited to invite you to our upcoming Cocktails for A Cause fundraiser benefiting Autism Health on Wednesday, August 5, 2026, from 6:00 PM to 8:00 PM at The Park Club in Costa Mesa, CA. Registration starts at 5:30 PM.

This special evening will bring together supporters, families, professionals, and community leaders for a night of connection, purpose, and giving back. Guests will enjoy cocktails, networking, an inspiring presentation from Dr. Dayan Goodenowe, and both a live auction and silent auction filled with exciting items and experiences.

Tickets are $85 per person and proceeds from the evening will help support Autism Health’s ongoing mission to provide education, resources, support programs, and outreach for families impacted by autism and neurological conditions.

We hope you will join us for this meaningful evening as we come together to make a difference in the lives of so many families.
BUY TICKETS HERE (https://givebutter.com/cocktails-4-a-cause?gbtid=364872ca-6248-4fff-badb-efb5ca682c2c&mc_cid=07c3bb6ca7&mc_eid=UNIQID)

** Don't Miss Out on this Spectacular Savings!
------------------------------------------------------------

Save 50% on the 2027 Autism Health Summit This July!

There has never been a better time to reserve your seat for the 2027 Autism Health Summit! Throughout the month of July only, receive 50% OFF your in person admission with promo code AHS50.

Join us April 29 - May 1, 2027 at the beautiful Legacy Center Resort & Spa in San Diego, California, for three inspiring days of education, collaboration, and community. The Autism Health Summit brings together leading physicians, researchers, practitioners, advocates, and families from around the world to explore the latest advances in autism research, integrative medicine, and whole person health. This exclusive offer ends July 31st and will not be available again, so reserve your seat today.

As part of our mission to make education accessible to everyone, Autism Health proudly offers scholarships for low income families who may not otherwise be able to attend. We believe every family deserves access to trusted education, resources, and a supportive community, regardless of financial circumstances. You can access the application on our website.

Register today and learn more using the links below.
REGISTER HERE (https://ahsconference.com/pricing-table/?mc_cid=07c3bb6ca7&mc_eid=UNIQID)
Are you interested in partnering with Autism Health? During the month of July, organizations can receive 10% OFF all 2027 sponsorship packages by using promo code Sponsor10. This is the perfect opportunity to showcase your organization while supporting one of the nation's premier autism education conferences.
REGISTER HERE (https://ahsconference.com/sponsors/?mc_cid=07c3bb6ca7&mc_eid=UNIQID)

** Summer Movie Fundraiser!
------------------------------------------------------------

Looking for a fun way to support Autism Health this summer? We are excited to partner with GroupRaise and Regal Cinemas for a special fundraising campaign that allows you to enjoy a night at the movies while supporting a great cause.

For just $30 per order, you'll receive a Regal Movie Ticket Bundle that includes two Standard 2D Movie Tickets, redeemable at any Regal theater location nationwide. Best of all, 20% of every purchase will be donated to Autism Health Inc. to help support our educational programs, support groups, webinars, scholarships, and research initiatives.

Did you know that many Regal Cinemas locations also offer Sensory Friendly Screenings? These special screenings are designed to create a more comfortable movie-going experience for individuals with autism and sensory sensitivities, making this fundraiser even more meaningful for our community.

Whether you're planning a family outing, date night, or looking for a unique gift, your purchase helps advance our mission of serving individuals and families impacted by autism and related neurological conditions.

Campaign Ends: Monday, August 17, 2026

Thank you for supporting Autism Health Inc. Every ticket bundle purchased helps us continue making a difference in the lives of families around the world.
BUY TICKETS HERE (https://www.groupraise.com/offer-campaigns/78957-autism-health-inc-regal-fundraising-campaigns?mc_cid=07c3bb6ca7&mc_eid=UNIQID)

About Autism Health Inc.
Autism Health is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization dedicated to educating individuals, families, and communities about autism spectrum disorder (ASD). Autism Health provides educational programs, workshops, events, research, and resources tailored to meet the diverse needs of those impacted by autism and other neurological disorders.
DONATE HERE (https://autismhealth.com/donations/?mc_cid=07c3bb6ca7&mc_eid=UNIQID)
Autism Health Inc. depends on generous donations from our community. Large or small, every donation gets us closer to achieving our goals. We are grateful for your assistance! For more information about Autism Health, visit www.AutismHealth.com

subject: We need an equally coordinated response.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Sara Jacobs for Congress
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?amount=25 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?amount=25]
Friends, I want to talk to you about Democrats’ strategy in the House — and exactly why I’ve been pushing so hard these last 18 months to introduce meaningful legislation, listen to my constituents, and put in the work to win big in November.
One question I get a lot these days is: Why try? With Democrats in the triple minority, what’s the point?
I get it, but I have a very important answer:
The Heritage Foundation — the group behind Project 2025 — has been bragging about how Donald Trump and Republicans have already implemented 53% of Project 2025.
Project 2025 was their blueprint for remaking America into their dystopian, right-wing vision — and they didn’t do it by waiting around for their chance to get into power.
They laid the groundwork early, and the moment Donald Trump returned to office, they used that blueprint to start dismantling our democracy, checking off the destruction as they went. And now they are more than halfway there.
The fact is that we need an equally coordinated response and proactive plan for OUR vision for the future — and critically, that means doing the work right now, not waiting until we’re back in the majority.
So given that, here’s what I’ve been focused on these last 18 months:
Introducing meaningful legislation. Just because our party is in the minority doesn’t mean Democrats can abandon our responsibility to introduce, sponsor, and champion legislation that would help our constituents and people all across the country. Over the last 18 months, I’ve introduced the LEGACY Act , the My Body, My Data Act , the Delete DOGE Act , the Protect U.S. National Security Act, and the Sectoral AI Governance Act , among others. We have to walk and chew gum at the same time — fighting back against Trump and Republicans’ worst actions while also laying out a proactive, positive vision for our future.
Getting Republicans on the record. The legislation I’m working on serves a dual purpose: on top of just being worthwhile, it can expose Republican hypocrisy in real time. Bills like the Protect U.S. National Security Act and the My Body, My Data Act should absolutely have bipartisan support! When Republicans refuse to vote for them, their claims of supporting foreign assistance or data privacy go up in smoke.
Focusing on what we want, not just what we don’t. Trump is awful, and his administration is doing awful things — fighting back is non-negotiable. And at the same time, being anti-Trump is not a platform. It’s on Democratic leaders to think creatively about the issues we’re facing, come up with solutions and draft the legislation, and work to get true buy-in from our colleagues, constituents, and advocates. We can do this work now so that we’ll be ready to hit the ground running as soon as we regain the majority in November.
Supporting fighters, thinkers, and doers. This November we have a chance to elect a Democratic majority full of leaders who will jump into action to reverse the damage this administration has wrought — and who will fight back with a real, proactive strategy of our own.
All of that together is my strategy for reversing the harm Trump and his enablers are creating, flipping the House in November, and getting things done for every American that will make life easier, better, and more affordable.
If this strategy sounds like something you can get behind, will you join me? There are so many ways to help, but right now I’m working towards my July fundraising goal, and reaching it will help us execute all our plans on the ground.
Will you chip in to support this work today? Our average email donation this month is $33. Plenty give less, some give more — but any amount you can contribute will make a difference. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?amount=33]

They laid the groundwork early, and the moment Donald Trump returned to office, they used that blueprint to start dismantling our democracy, checking off the destruction as they went. And now they are more than halfway there. The fact is that we need an equally coordinated response and proactive plan for OUR vision for the future — and critically, that means doing the work right now, not waiting until we’re back in the majority. So given that, here’s what I’ve been focused on these last 18 months: Introducing meaningful legislation. Just because our party is in the minority doesn’t mean Democrats can abandon our responsibility to introduce, sponsor, and champion legislation that would help our constituents and people all across the country. Over the last 18 months, I’ve introduced the LEGACY Act , the My Body, My Data Act , the Delete DOGE Act , the Protect U.S. National Security Act, and the Sectoral AI Governance Act , among others. We have to walk and chew gum at the same time — fighting back against Trump and Republicans’ worst actions while also laying out a proactive, positive vision for our future. Getting Republicans on the record. The legislation I’m working on serves a dual purpose: on top of just being worthwhile, it can expose Republican hypocrisy in real time. Bills like the Protect U.S. National Security Act and the My Body, My Data Act should absolutely have bipartisan support! When Republicans refuse to vote for them, their claims of supporting foreign assistance or data privacy go up in smoke. Focusing on what we want, not just what we don’t. Trump is awful, and his administration is doing awful things — fighting back is non-negotiable. And at the same time, being anti-Trump is not a platform. It’s on Democratic leaders to think creatively about the issues we’re facing, come up with solutions and draft the legislation, and work to get true buy-in from our colleagues, constituents, and advocates. We can do this work now so that we’ll be ready to hit the ground running as soon as we regain the majority in November. Supporting fighters, thinkers, and doers. This November we have a chance to elect a Democratic majority full of leaders who will jump into action to reverse the damage this administration has wrought — and who will fight back with a real, proactive strategy of our own. All of that together is my strategy for reversing the harm Trump and his enablers are creating, flipping the House in November, and getting things done for every American that will make life easier, better, and more affordable. If this strategy sounds like something you can get behind, will you join me? There are so many ways to help, but right now I’m working towards my July fundraising goal, and reaching it will help us execute all our plans on the ground. How much do you know about the Electoral College?

It's an important topic, and one vital to our nation's future.

You see, a movement is growing, led by progressives but supported by many well-meaning Americans, to change the way we elect our president.

**Their goal: to get rid of the Electoral College altogether, and "move beyond" the Constitution and Declaration. **

To counter this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, **reaching and teaching millions** of Americans in all 50 states.

When you take the **National Quiz on Presidential Selection** , you'll gain a clearer understanding of how the Electoral College upholds liberty--and you'll have the opportunity to **share this** information with your fellow Americans.

Hillsdale College

Hey folks,
[Katie Phang](https://open.substack.com/users/21818709-katie-phang?utm_source=mentions) joined me for another episode of _Breaking Bread_ , and this one went everywhere. We laughed harder than we probably should have, but we also dug into some genuinely disturbing questions about accountability, power, and why so many people in positions of authority seem determined to avoid both. If you've been trying to make sense of the latest chaos, this conversation is one you don't want to miss.
**Here 's what we got into:**
* **00:01:07** -- We kick things off with some absurd humor before asking a serious question: when does political dysfunction stop being funny and start becoming alarming?
* **00:08:10** -- Katie lays out why Democrats should force transparency around Mitch McConnell's disappearance and why accountability can't depend on partisan convenience.
* **00:19:22** -- We shift to the Tate brothers, their latest legal troubles, and why real accountability for powerful abusers matters--no matter who they're connected to.
* **00:27:24** -- We dive into toxic masculinity, MAGA influencers, and why cruelty has become such a defining feature of today's political culture.
* **00:34:26** -- We wrap with the Epstein investigation, questions about government transparency, and why it's always patriotic to ask hard questions when those in power refuse to give straight answers.

This conversation covers everything from congressional accountability and media hypocrisy to the Tate brothers, the Epstein investigation, and the growing culture of performative outrage that keeps distracting us from the truth. We also spend time talking about what real leadership actually looks like--and why integrity matters more than performative strength. If you're looking for an honest conversation that doesn't pull punches but still finds moments to laugh, this one's for you. If you value honest conversations like this, help me keep them going.

# Tuesday, July 21, 2026
---
**Dear Flyover Reader,** Today's partner is [Insurify](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyskL2O4yAUhZ8Gd4nggjEuKFaK0mXbLS3CvY6RsLHgbn7efuSp5gGm-6Rzzlecf7fpFlJO2-NvWMnzey4TEqYYmHDa6NUyMVOdXssnVGplDdsHa3pSbe0_Im0TSLAnOZxA_ViqDv1d4qg68mpwxvaDBNMt3rlxjniXxhL0GEdjUKE0ZGcHI8x9l_whlAMo5aQ2-gwhShpBgTUagw3CSMLEpZ55IaZ3aHP-lCfVcyxrl_3CvDeh_wi4CrjutTBFJiw7p7K1o3Qk-hqEvijjegE2HugcHNyU0JeuetxfKefU7CCMfKwh5W8__-ZHTw9fAQAA__-tcH7T), and honestly, this is one of those things that just makes sense to check. Car insurance rates have gone up a lot recently, and it only takes a few minutes to compare quotes and see if you could save money. The process is simple, and there's really no downside to seeing what other options are out there. -Cole, CEO
* * *
[](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyskL2O4yAUhZ8Gd4nggjEuKFaK0mXbLS3CvY6RsLHgbn7efuSp5gGm-6Rzzlecf7fpFlJO2-NvWMnzey4TEqYYmHDa6NUyMVOdXssnVGplDdsHa3pSbe0_Im0TSLAnOZxA_ViqDv1d4qg68mpwxvaDBNMt3rlxjniXxhL0GEdjUKE0ZGcHI8x9l_whlAMo5aQ2-gwhShpBgTUagw3CSMLEpZ55IaZ3aHP-lCfVcyxrl_3CvDeh_wi4CrjutTBFJiw7p7K1o3Qk-hqEvijjegE2HugcHNyU0JeuetxfKefU7CCMfKwh5W8__-ZHTw9fAQAA__-tcH7T) **A lot of people have had the same experience lately.** Your car insurance renews, you glance at the number, and somehow it's jumped again. Maybe by $20 a month. Maybe by $50. Maybe more. And yet nothing really changed. No accidents. No tickets. Same car. Same driving habits. It's happening all over the country right now. [Insurance companies have been raising rates aggressively](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyskL2O4yAUhZ8Gd4nggjEuKFaK0mXbLS3CvY6RsLHgbn7efuSp5gGm-6Rzzlecf7fpFlJO2-NvWMnzey4TEqYYmHDa6NUyMVOdXssnVGplDdsHa3pSbe0_Im0TSLAnOZxA_ViqDv1d4qg68mpwxvaDBNMt3rlxjniXxhL0GEdjUKE0ZGcHI8x9l_whlAMo5aQ2-gwhShpBgTUagw3CSMLEpZ55IaZ3aHP-lCfVcyxrl_3CvDeh_wi4CrjutTBFJiw7p7K1o3Qk-hqEvijjegE2HugcHNyU0JeuetxfKefU7CCMfKwh5W8__-ZHTw9fAQAA__-tcH7T) over the last few years, and many drivers are simply absorbing the increases because shopping for insurance feels like a hassle. Most people assume comparing rates means filling out endless forms, sitting through sales calls, or spending an entire afternoon jumping between websites. **ICYMI: “NRCC Targets Ohio Rep. Landsman In Fight for U.S. House”** _OH-01 is a top pick up opportunity, and Greg Landsman is one of the most vulnerable Democrats in America_**CINCINNATI, OH** — In case you missed it, the National Republican Congressional Committee has officially added Ohio’s First Congressional District to its national target list, putting Greg Landsman on notice that the full weight of the House Republican campaign apparatus is coming to Southwest Ohio.The move confirms what voters across the district already know: Landsman is a career politician defending a liberal record on new, more Republican turf, and Eric Conroy, a former Air Force intelligence officer and former CIA case officer is the strongest challenger he has ever faced.**The momentum keeps building.** The target-list designation comes on the heels of President Trump’s endorsement, Eric’s addition to the NRCC’s MAGA Majority program, and a record-breaking second fundraising quarter that outraised the entire 2024 Republican campaign in this district.**The contrast couldn’t be clearer.** Eric Conroy spent his career serving his country. Greg Landsman has spent his serving himself, enriching himself trading stocks while cutting police funding on Cincinnati City Council and voting in lockstep with the far left in Washington. Now he’s running in Republican territory, and Washington Republicans have made clear they intend to finish the job in November.Read the full story from State Affairs Pro [**HERE**](https://us.list-manage.com/BF8DVr9WWov?e=3f87e575ad&c2id=83ae238fa0f76420f201b2501cd8e566).###

name: Team Garrity
subject: Who is Josh Shapiro really fighting for?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Garrity for PA * 4075 Linglestown Rd PMB 119 * Harrisburg, PA 17112-1020 * USA
body:
More and more Pennsylvanians are asking the same question.

| | | | | [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/DnisuzD1Pgw?e=63ab67bb25&c2id=8377c90e3583a614e646f5b9492ea9fd)
| | | | | | Hi Peter,
For years, Josh Shapiro has carefully cultivated an image as a governor who can appeal to everyone.
But after nearly four years in office, one question keeps getting harder to answer:
**Who is Josh Shapiro actually fighting for?**

A [**piece published last week**](https://us.list-manage.com/B29XwnBGt5_?e=63ab67bb25&c2id=8377c90e3583a614e646f5b9492ea9fd) in RealClearPennsylvania argues that despite all the attention surrounding Josh Shapiro, he has failed to build a lasting constituency because his positions often change depending on the audience. The piece argues that while his political ambitions continue to grow, his record has left many Pennsylvanians wondering what he truly stands for.
Think about it.
He promised parents more educational opportunities, then walked away from school choice.
He talks about supporting Pennsylvania’s energy workers while pushing policies that create uncertainty for one of our most important industries.
He claims to be focused on Pennsylvania, yet seems far more interested in building a national political brand than solving the challenges facing families here at home.
**Pennsylvania doesn’t need another politician focused on the next office.**
**Pennsylvania needs a governor focused on this one.**

That's why Stacy Garrity has spent this campaign meeting directly with farmers worried about losing their land, veterans who deserve better care, parents who want more opportunities for their children, law enforcement officers keeping our communities safe, and families struggling with the rising cost of living.
While Josh Shapiro focuses on headlines, Stacy Garrity is focused on Pennsylvanians.
That's the difference this election is all about.
Thank you for standing with us.
\- Team Garrity

Team -- the SAVE America Act would eviscerate our fundamental right to vote. So, of course, Donald Trump is pushing for this zombie legislation again, months after we thought it was dead.
The MAGA movement knows that this bill -- from the original SAVE Act to all the various clones -- is the easiest way to deny our right to vote and preserve their power. That's why Trump continues to call for its passage, trying to add it to multiple other bills.
Voter registration is the quickest response to voter suppression legislation. Opponents of voting rights have seen how pro-democracy groups like ours have mobilized new voters in the face of suppression, so they're now targeting the work of pro-voting groups to stop our ability to register new voters .
We're kicking our efforts to register voters ahead of the midterms into high gear. The math is simple:
➜ It costs us around $3 to register a new voter
➜ That means for every $30,000 we raise, we could register 10,000 new voters
➜ Polls show a major shift going on, and this work can truly impact 2026's elections
Not to mention that the more people who vote, the more our government looks like us and not the privileged powerful .
Will you chip in $36 or more today to help register 12 new voters? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=072126_1&amount=36]

There's so much on the line in these midterms , with just months to go before Election Day. Registering more new voters this year could make the difference between opponents of voting rights staying in charge to codify voter suppression for the next decade or having the votes we need to pass sweeping new voting rights laws.

Peter,
For decades, AIPAC has spent millions of dollars flying members of Congress to Israel to present a carefully managed narrative about the Middle East.
I did it differently.
I just returned from an extensive Palestinian-led tour of the occupied West Bank. I didn't go to see a carefully curated version of reality. I went to see what Palestinians experience every day.
What I witnessed was deeply disturbing.
My delegation was surrounded and held for more than an hour by armed settlers carrying American-made M4 rifles. When the Israeli military arrived, they didn't protect us—they stood alongside the settlers.
I saw apartheid, torment, and violence that millions of Palestinians face every day, largely outside the view of the American public.
That's exactly why AIPAC and other special interests keep attacking me. They don't want independent voices in Congress asking difficult questions or telling Americans what their tax dollars are helping fund.

clean_body: [] Peter, For decades, AIPAC has spent millions of dollars flying members of Congress to Israel to present a carefully managed narrative about the Middle East. I did it differently. I saw apartheid, torment, and violence that millions of Palestinians face every day, largely outside the view of the American public. That's exactly why AIPAC and other special interests keep attacking me. # [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)

Hi Peter, it’s Wendy Davis.
Let me tell you a bit about why Gina’s campaign is so important to me.
But before I do, **[will you please make a $5 contribution to my friend Gina’s campaign?](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260721_2_wendy.lrACpr&refcode=em20260721-1625&amount=5&t=2&akid=1625%2E299639%2EBxBb-S)**
I grew up in Texas. I’ve raised my children, built a career, and made a life here.
Early on, I learned that Texas was special. That no matter where you started, you had a chance — that hard work and determination could carry you forward. That belief is what has shaped my life and everything I’ve fought for in public service.
**I’m proud to be a Texan.** But to be honest, the state I love has become harder to recognize after more than a decade of Governor Abbott’s disastrous leadership.
Communities are being left behind because Abbott is doing the bidding of his billionaire donors, rather than working to improve the lives and the opportunities of the people he was elected to serve.
Not only does Texas deserve better, but we also can do better. We can elect Gina this year. And I know it’s possible because she’s already within 3 points of Abbott in the polls — far closer than Beto or I ever came.
**I know Gina. I’ve watched her lead._And I’ve seen exactly what she’s made of._**
When her community’s schools were threatened, she didn’t wait — she stepped up and fought back to keep schools open. When Abbott pushed the agenda of the big corporations, she stood her ground and beat him again and again. And Peter, that kind of leadership really matters.
**Gina is the person we want leading Texas. And together, we can make it happen.**
Gina doesn’t need to match Abbott’s $67 million war chest to win, but she does need all of us standing with her and giving this our everything.
**[If you’re ready to defeat Abbott and chart a brighter future for Texas, pitch in $5 or whatever makes sense for you.](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260721_2_wendy.lrACpr&refcode=em20260721-1625&amount=5&t=3&akid=1625%2E299639%2EBxBb-S)**

Much love,
\- Wendy

| | | Hi team, Mark Kelly here.

As you might know, I've served our country as a combat pilot and traveled into orbit as an astronaut at NASA. I'm a proud husband, father, and grandfather. And now, I'm a senator for Arizona and a Vice Chair for the DSCC.

I've been through a lot – and I've also learned a lot. **The biggest takeaway of all is this:_Be prepared._**

[**Which brings me to why I'm reaching out: Will you chip in $7 to the DSCC to make sure we have every resource on hand as we fight to flip the Senate blue?**](https://go.dscc.org/go/23346?amount=7&t=5&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&ask=7&amounts=7%2C14%2C28%2C70&code=DPE-FD-20260721-MarkKelly-KellyPreparingForTheMissionFR-Pros-sl1&refcode=DPE-FD-20260721-MarkKelly-KellyPreparingForTheMissionFR-Pros-sl1&akid=24658%2E9716520%2EGAvfw0)

I'm not standing on the sidelines

| |
