Peter,

Lately, it feels like so many people have lost faith in our politics.

It's easy to understand why.

Too often, we see division instead of solutions. Politicians are looking for the next headline instead of the next opportunity to help working families. Powerful interests are looking out for themselves while everyday people are left behind.

That's not why I chose public service.

I ran for Congress because I believed families like mine, the daughter of Mexican immigrants who worked hard to build a better life, deserved a voice in Washington. And that's exactly what has guided me every day since.

I know we won't agree on every issue, but I believe we should always put the interests of our communities ahead of powerful special interests.

That's the kind of leadership I've tried to bring to Congress, and it's the kind of leadership I'll continue fighting for every single day. But I can't do it alone.

Errol Bush, Cori’s dad

# _Our Service Members Deserved Better_
---
| |
**As a new week begins, two American service members will not be coming home.**
**Over the weekend, 1st Lt. Tyler James Feehan, 25, and Pvt. Isabella Gonzales, 19, were killed in Jordan while serving our country. Long after the headlines have faded, two families are beginning the unimaginable task of grieving a family member who answered the call to serve. Before we debate politics or military strategy, we must first recognize what has been lost.**
**My prayers are with their families, their friends, every soldier, and loved one carrying the weight of this tragedy. Somewhere this morning, parents are waking up to a world forever changed. A spouse is facing a future they never imagined. Children will grow up knowing their parent through stories instead of memories. These are not statistics or talking points. They are Americans who raised their right hand, accepted extraordinary risks, and made the ultimate sacrifice in service to our nation.**
**As a veteran, these moments are deeply personal. I know what it means to prepare for deployment and trust that the leaders making decisions in Washington have done everything possible to ensure your mission is necessary, achievable, and worthy of the sacrifices being asked of you. Every service member understands that military service comes with danger. What none of us should ever accept is unnecessary danger created by failed leadership, poor planning, or decisions made without a clear strategic purpose.**
**My service as a Tank Commander taught me that strength is not measured by how quickly a president orders military action or how forcefully politicians speak from behind a podium. Real leadership is measured by discipline, restraint, and the wisdom to know when force is truly necessary. Every order signed in Washington is ultimately carried out by young Americans in uniform. Every strategic failure is paid for by someone else's son or daughter. That reality should humble every elected official entrusted with the responsibility of sending our troops into harm's way.**
**Supporting our troops means far more than offering prayers after tragedy strikes or thanking them for their service at campaign rallies. It means ensuring that when military force is required, our troops have a clear mission, achievable objectives, and leaders who have carefully weighed every alternative before asking Americans to risk their lives. It also means honoring the Constitution by ensuring Congress fulfills its responsibility to debate and authorize military action instead of allowing decisions of war and peace to become routine or politically convenient.**
**Our nation deserves leaders who understand these responsibilities firsthand. That's why I'm running for Congress - not to score political points, but to ensure that decisions of war and peace are made with the gravity they demand. We need leaders who believe that accountability is patriotic, that constitutional leadership matters, and that preserving peace whenever possible is not a sign of weakness but of wisdom.**
**As we reflect on the lives lost this weekend, we owe those two Americans more than our gratitude. We owe them the kind of leadership that treats every decision to send our troops into harm's way with the seriousness it deserves.**
**For the families grieving this week, know this: your loved ones mattered. Their service mattered. Their sacrifice will not be forgotten.**
**-Elizabeth**

body:
Last week, a federal commission packed with Trump appointees voted 8 to 1 to advance the Arc de Trump
#
Peter, I need to tell you where the fight to stop Trump’s arch stands, because it’s getting worse.
Two weeks ago, a federal commission packed with Trump appointees voted 8 to 1 to advance the Arc de Trump — 250 feet tall, sitting on Memorial Circle, at the entrance to Arlington National Cemetery.
They heard nearly three hours of public opposition first. Veterans. Families. People who understand what that place means to this country. The commission listened, then voted to advance the arch anyway.
This isn't final. But it's closer than it's ever been.
The sightline between the Lincoln Memorial and Arlington was designed on purpose — a quiet symbol of a reunited country — and Trump wants to put a monument to himself in the middle of it.
I've spent enough of my life on the grounds of Arlington National Cemetery to know its gravity. My father, killed in action during the Vietnam War, is buried there. Men who I trained, who served under me, are buried there. It is not the backdrop for some draft-dodging coward’s vanity.
So we're asking for $5. That's it.
$5 because Trump’s commission could force this through before most people even hear what’s happened.
$5 because we're up against a President who's made this one of the top priorities of his administration.
But really, $5 or anything you can afford. Because whatever you can give, right now, matters more than the amount itself.

body:

| | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/135724019/635134185/-463234460?refcode=emailheader&refcode2=51c0b38b-4485-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&ms=260721_kh_rnc&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjEvMS8xMTA5NjQiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNTFjMGIzOGItNDQ4NS1mMTExLWIzMzctMDAwZDNhMTU1OGNlIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=6jKSukvbKz5J-gUOFX3Mk1HwkfMbdIMwdQ_lF0AQjSY=)
---
Friend, I recently sat down with The Contrarian for an interview about why I'm running, and the RNC heard me: [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/135724020/635134186/2103672261?refcode=260721_kh_rnc_img&ms=260721_kh_rnc&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjEvMS8xMTA5NjQiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNTFjMGIzOGItNDQ4NS1mMTExLWIzMzctMDAwZDNhMTU1OGNlIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=6jKSukvbKz5J-gUOFX3Mk1HwkfMbdIMwdQ_lF0AQjSY=) I called out Governor Abbott's voucher scam for what it is: **a scheme that siphons public money away from Texas public schools, underfunding what the majority of our kids actually attend, all in service of a Christian nationalist agenda that has no business shaping our classrooms.** If the RNC is combing through my interviews looking for soundbites to weaponize, it's because they see something real building here in TX-21. _**by David Shuster**_
There is no office in Texas government more remarkable than the one Dan Patrick appears to have created for himself: Lieutenant Governor, President of the Senate, and Acting Registrar of the Kingdom of Heaven.
At the recent Texas Republican convention, Patrick informed the faithful that democratic Senate candidate James Talarico is guilty of blasphemy and is bound for hell. One imagines St. Peter learning of this arrangement and being more than a bit surprised. For two millennia the Church has debated salvation with great care; Patrick settled the matter in between GOP applause lines.
It was an astonishing performance for a man who professes devotion to a book that contains a rather memorable warning from its central figure: "Judge not, that ye be not judged."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/00612def-7cd1-4573-bc8c-8341456659b8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Jesus did not add the customary modern political exception: "...unless the other fellow is running as a Democrat and doesn't wear a black jacket and mock turtleneck."
That omission seems to have escaped the Lieutenant Governor. Common sense also escaped Patrick. He accused James Talarico of being "Low-T" as in low testosterone. Never mind that testosterone is not a problem for young men, though it's a huge problem for elderly men like Patrick, whose sartorial choices and receding gray hair only seemed to underscore the GOP elder's projection.
James Talarico presents a vexing problem for the Texas Republican establishment.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/00612def-7cd1-4573-bc8c-8341456659b8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
He is not a secular progressive dismissing Christianity from public discourse. He teaches Sunday school. He reads Scripture closely. He quotes the Gospels with enough familiarity to make people who merely wave them around extremely uncomfortable. He has the habit of asking what Jesus actually said about the poor, the stranger, mercy, forgiveness, humility, and the corrupting influence of wealth and power.
That is not blasphemy.
It is simply awkward for politicians whose preferred Bible passages never interfere with tax policy or campaign talking points.
Modern Texas Republicans have perfected an extraordinary theological innovation. Christianity is now only measured by partisan affiliation. The Beatitudes have become optional; party orthodoxy is mandatory. The Sermon on the Mount is treated not as divine instruction but rather as a draft that should have gone through a round of GOP editing.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/00612def-7cd1-4573-bc8c-8341456659b8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
But it gets even wilder. Republican Senate candidate Ken Paxton has added to the hypocrisy by declaring that James Talarico lacks "Texas values."

The receipts are worse. | | and | Jul 21| | | ∙| | Preview ---|---|--- | | | ---|---|--- | | | | | | | | | | | | | ---|---|--- by David Shuster There is no office in Texas government more remarkable than the one Dan Patrick appears to have created for himself: Lieutenant Governor, President of the Senate, and Acting Registrar of the Kingdom of Heaven. At the recent Texas Republican convention, Patrick informed the faithful that democratic Senate candidate James Talarico is guilty of blasphemy and is bound for hell. One imagines St. Peter learning of this arrangement and being more than a bit surprised. For two millennia the Church has debated salvation with great care; Patrick settled the matter in between GOP applause lines. It was an astonishing performance for a man who professes devotion to a book that contains a rather memorable warning from its central figure: "Judge not, that ye be not judged." | | ---|---|--- Jesus did not add the customary modern political exception: "...unless the other fellow is running as a Democrat and doesn't wear a black jacket and mock turtleneck." That omission seems to have escaped the Lieutenant Governor. Common sense also escaped Patrick. He accused James Talarico of being "Low-T" as in low testosterone. Never mind that testosterone is not a problem for young men, though it's a huge problem for elderly men like Patrick, whose sartorial choices and receding gray hair only seemed to underscore the GOP elder's projection. James Talarico presents a vexing problem for the Texas Republican establishment. | | ---|---|--- He is not a secular progressive dismissing Christianity from public discourse. He teaches Sunday school. He reads Scripture closely. He quotes the Gospels with enough familiarity to make people who merely wave them around extremely uncomfortable. He has the habit of asking what Jesus actually said about the poor, the stranger, mercy, forgiveness, humility, and the corrupting influence of wealth and power. That is not blasphemy. It is simply awkward for politicians whose preferred Bible passages never interfere with tax policy or campaign talking points. Modern Texas Republicans have perfected an extraordinary theological innovation. Christianity is now only measured by partisan affiliation. The Beatitudes have become optional; party orthodoxy is mandatory. The Sermon on the Mount is treated not as divine instruction but rather as a draft that should have gone through a round of GOP editing. | | ---|---|--- But it gets even wilder. Republican Senate candidate Ken Paxton has added to the hypocrisy by declaring that James Talarico lacks "Texas values." This is rich. Fellow American,

Everywhere I go in this district, people tell me a version of the same thing.

At the grocery store, after church, at the gas pump, they lower their voice a little and say some form of the same sentence: **_“Please don't let them take it all back.”_**

I hear that concern, and I carry it with me every day I am in Washington. It is exactly why I refuse to slow down, even in the dead quiet of July.

name: Voto Latino
subject: Turning out voters in Texas to finally elect a new Governor
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Voto Latino
body:
Texans deserve a leader who’s going to work and fight for them — not the Trump administration.
#
Peter,
This November, we have a chance to finally vote Greg Abbott out and elect a new governor of Texas.
**Gina Hinojosa, a state legislator and civil rights and union lawyer, is running against Abbott, and she has exactly what it takes to beat Abbott.**
The reality is Texans are tired of politicians who put money and politics over everyday families. We saw the proof in primary turnout across the state, where people proved they are ready for real leadership. **Yet for years, Texan voters have been blocked from having real representation because Republicans have totally rigged their political maps.**
**Right now, Gina Hinojosa is polling within _3 points_ of Greg Abbott — the closest anyone has ever gotten — and we’re determined to help close the gap by registering and mobilizing voters in Texas before November.**
[**Peter, will you rush a $3 donation to help us reach, register, and mobilize voters in communities across Texas and elect Gina Hinojosa as the next governor of Texas?**](https://act.votolatino.org/go/57?c0=em-ms-voto-20260721-1.y01-Ta&amount=3&refcode=em20260721-402&t=1&akid=402%2E1366028%2EaxVM3u)
The stakes of this race are a lot higher than you think, Peter.
After key voting protections were weakened and congressional maps in Texas were redrawn, Greg Abbott made it clear he will use every tool he has to lock in control and silence communities of color.
This isn't just about Texas, Peter — _this impacts the entire country._ Because Texas is growing so fast, the state is projected to gain up to five new congressional seats after the next census.
And if Republicans stay in power, they will lock in extreme maps through the end of the decade, making it harder for working families to be heard in D.C.
**So, by electing Gina Hinojosa, we put a leader in office who will veto rigged maps and Republicans will have no choice but to play fair. The way it _should_ be.**
Our community has the power to elect Gina and completely flip Texas, but only if we register every single eligible voter and ensure they show up at the ballot box this November.
**[Peter, will you pitch in $3 right now to help Voto Latino end corruption and bring fair representation to Texas?](https://act.votolatino.org/go/57?c0=em-ms-voto-20260721-1.y01-Ta&amount=3&refcode=em20260721-402&t=2&akid=402%2E1366028%2EaxVM3u)**
**[Donate $3 ››](https://act.votolatino.org/go/57?c0=em-ms-voto-20260721-1.y01-Ta&amount=3&refcode=20260721-402&t=21&akid=402%2E1366028%2EaxVM3u)**
Thank you,
Voto Latino

The fight over it has brought Congress to a standstill -- other legislation blocked outright to force the Senate's hand. The House is going again before the August recess. That is the window. If it does not become law, the 2026 election runs under the same rules we have right now. That is the whole fight. -- The 2026 Victory Team P.S. The Senate stalled it once already. clean_body: With you as a member of this team, we will be able to face our toughest challenges, implement our 2026 strategy, and defeat our Republican opponents. | | | | | ---|--- Here are three reasons why you should become a 2026 DLCC Down Ballot Defender. 1. There are just 105 days until Election Day. , you can fund year-round resources that will help elect state Democrats this November and beyond. 2. The DLCC wins more elections in more places than any other committee – by becoming a member today, you can own a piece of every win in the states and make a real impact in communities like yours. 3. Fellow Patriot,

After the sudden death of my brother, Lindsey Graham, I was appointed by Governor Henry McMaster to represent South Carolina in the United States Senate.

**President Trump encouraged me to consider running in the Special Election by saying, "Run, Darline, Run!" Now, with the President's _"Complete and Total Endorsement," I'm running to represent South Carolina for a full term in the United States Senate._**

I've spent a lot of time talking and praying with my family. This was not a decision I made lightly. I know it will be difficult, _**but I am ready.**_

I know what Lindsey cared about, and we shared the same conservative values. He cared deeply about the people of South Carolina. With what I learned from Lindsey and my nearly 30 years of helping people of the state find dignity through work, I am ready to take on this next challenge.

It's time for me to step up for South Carolina, just like Lindsey stepped up for me when our parents died. I've learned God often calls on ordinary people to do extraordinary things in the most challenging of times.

I am not Lindsey. I have my own way of doing things. But we were raised with the same values: work hard each day, trust in the Lord, remember your roots, and never forget who you work for.

I did not seek this moment, Fellow Patriot.

But after many prayers and speaking with my family, I know I am making the right decision to run for this seat. **[However, I cannot do this alone.](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=6ca2e6b39eec49eb93f8b6d22b49bfec&_e=Dzb4HZFWbRGMacUC71Jg1lX7MKFPtOM9wW3zxPQfZKEf-RDSAJWmteM34W1KP-ZTcoUqp5DoKlCmP6q3WSuVVRytC3_kkZnSFloQOOrMfYKdEf-RTcFWySfai2J5QEflfuTtVKeaRpVGu6vIDkao3qp3NqXhDZWGrdE8NlAptQkLoIJEnYj5yS4RmEj3iteLBEb7XKfRp-T5gfymXT6e8tNEFcRMopyG8_TvzdW7PQhemDN7IqDjGE1ieGZ_ktwlewSRBlp6SBonaqCGpjxRL7ZKc37kOlf0QJXH7B9mdcNfrl7hujtILquSIi0cA6-oGPPr1D6eguoQE8Aqog8hNo_LDna1xothsmL-100j4FEGfAsjl51soUE4Vks2E7BUKdxaE0w1rB5VaSvHmP212gnMXMSFc0Di9HypMtlVSv_oRDD8cD701wchomFt63kUBUfWa5fUacbt1cBww8SF53qm9XNrfgRLi1zdcXylQ3gIuDwPo8zG2YnrQ4ry6N_xOK7V7kj4IWUvpS8XLB3g7MpoAnYophIM3WjIC3faz_J8g4cm4_wAJmQRKLH1RtBjqUizA2zOOYfXC9ob-3RlW19mId8LLuxgFOgHHUS97eFN5uQI-YfO9uNxmo0keLHznaAib3xETaiCWGgzhsWIBMv8rEYr-1XNV5z6G510ZbvXL0mZji8DuJTlfocCr5krWuhjaAjjpu3gqOmjwpgzC879ES6xreVPXNnlsWMVyUM%3D)**

body:
If we’re going to elect candidates who will bring down prices this fall, we have to make sure our fundraising keeps pace.
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/9?t=1&akid=41515%2E3422442%2EVmbmFF)
Peter,
Right now, we’re in the middle of the “summer slowdown”—that period in July and August when political fundraising traditionally stalls.
I get it. People are outside enjoying the weather, and families like mine are busy before kids go back to school in a few weeks.
**But threats to our democracy don’t take a summer vacation.**
This administration is still working to rip away our fundamental freedoms, and corporate PACs are still spending huge amounts every day to buy our elections. The struggles working families face won’t wait for a slowdown to end, so neither can we.
If we’re going to elect candidates who will bring down prices this fall, we have to make sure our fundraising keeps pace. I’m relying on supporters like you to step up and make sure we have the resources to keep fighting.
**[Can you chip in $5 or more to Truth to Power to help us overcome the summer slowdown?](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21531?c0=em_ms_ttp_20260721_1_ak.TYj0ru&refcode=em20260721-41515&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=41515%2E3422442%2EVmbmFF)**

Katie Porter

Peter, Keith Self cannot stop attacking the Constitution, and he is doing it one amendment at a time. He went after the 19th Amendment and a woman's right to vote when he backed the SAVE Act, which threatens to knock millions of married women off the rolls. He spits on the First Amendment every time he fires up his bigoted "anti-Sharia Law caucus"and paints our Muslim neighbors as a threat. He came for the 14th Amendment and birthright citizenship, one of the oldest promises this country ever made. **Now he is leading the charge to repeal the 17th Amendment and take away your right to elect your own United States senator.**

At the rate he is picking off amendments, it is only a matter of time before Keith Self comes right out and says we should throw the whole Constitution in the trash.
[Help us send someone to Congress who actually swore an oath to that document and meant it.](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqs6gc2C5hUDUAX_oNaSPVDobFeqfVfzIW2x4J26hzyt8z1AKuEWhLMp6xAxfPT6CfQ6gF5-i85ChiRDOQFf4bxYAdpxg7RzhhnD7gllUDJdM6j4w-Zv3NUK2ihKK1xCTkt4OTfnUW8yatWM_jiL0B7J9yBI96qy0zZpZCS9GEKkSDY9ctT2cwhBCmlXyIO8jt_vu-fe1G3lNWWF7FUtRhaxcvCy3aQhoAH9fIHyUv8hu_JZbr3fXczG0d6Kb5IJdkyUwD5YC4de4cPm-vGdy-6N9EW0ytJ_4Dbtq8IDyReOA4XN8RUAsA006_iMRFU-XX-AYZ0vi0i-GSflRb80HvPoZDgVQqGBju4Ga3ms7ssNZw/4si/098qfnelS1qWK6-crA2O0A/h2/h001.UNceKCkaO4LpMns0662SgTzUKTmzDljknieJLwTquuc)
The 17th Amendment matters more than most people realize.
Before it passed, senators were handpicked by state legislatures, and during the Gilded Age that meant the richest men in the country could bribe a few politicians and simply buy themselves a Senate seat.
Americans got so disgusted watching millionaires purchase power that they amended the Constitution to hand that decision to the people.
Keith Self wants to drag us right back into that smoke-filled room.
He is not doing this because he loves the founders.
He is doing it because his party is terrified that Ken Paxton is going to lose to James Talarico.
Rather than try to win the election, they would rather end elections.
They know their extremist nominee is sinking, so they cooked up a Tammany Hall backroom scheme to make sure your vote never counts again.
It is the move of a coward who cannot win a fair fight and knows it.
The people of Texas do not need Keith Self deciding which of our rights we get to keep.
[Help us flip this seat and send him home in November.](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqs6gc2C5hUDUAX_oNaSPVDobFeqfVfzIW2x4J26hzyt8z1AKuEWhLMp6xAxfPT6CfQbw0xAWvo8ARc4ned9OxlsFoo2M2xU8Piyj1_V1fEEX5SjzT2u2UIw4Kmul-Ue8VCfnwFjxDyTiyHTrSh6jKncVwo6LB0LsxYkcg5KALMBi2Xqie-zTTfpjUqkDyh1WQxG0QVS_oKhDAGFeGTghq2UAGNmMG0BTmHaa3RK4ALG1EzpxS2mSqSNV7ZwPnUBj-2cXtV7SFaCM3BD3NbKp5RisUgoFkAezUrDHnujvxTRrgtewyNM7aOJkwHgljf0h-Qd_0DPbtWxUpmSHNzdWYU52TGvKUw_npT6UnIdOKfg-g/4si/098qfnelS1qWK6-crA2O0A/h3/h001.sPKcZY5KlmehaimGztLw3zmPvJagbSh6cLEKWiMD11s)

clean_body: | | Peter, Keith Self cannot stop attacking the Constitution, and he is doing it one amendment at a time. He went after the 19th Amendment and a woman's right to vote when he backed the SAVE Act, which threatens to knock millions of married women off the rolls. He spits on the First Amendment every time he fires up his bigoted "anti-Sharia Law caucus"and paints our Muslim neighbors as a threat. He came for the 14th Amendment and birthright citizenship, one of the oldest promises this country ever made. Now he is leading the charge to repeal the 17th Amendment and take away your right to elect your own United States senator. | At the rate he is picking off amendments, it is only a matter of time before Keith Self comes right out and says we should throw the whole Constitution in the trash. The 17th Amendment matters more than most people realize. Before it passed, senators were handpicked by state legislatures, and during the Gilded Age that meant the richest men in the country could bribe a few politicians and simply buy themselves a Senate seat. Americans got so disgusted watching millionaires purchase power that they amended the Constitution to hand that decision to the people. Keith Self wants to drag us right back into that smoke-filled room. He is not doing this because he loves the founders. He is doing it because his party is terrified that Ken Paxton is going to lose to James Talarico. Rather than try to win the election, they would rather end elections. They know their extremist nominee is sinking, so they cooked up a Tammany Hall backroom scheme to make sure your vote never counts again. It is the move of a coward who cannot win a fair fight and knows it. The people of Texas do not need Keith Self deciding which of our rights we get to keep. Hello Peter,
Earlier this week, I was honored to throw the first pitch at the Sanford Spinners baseball game in Sanford. It’s been quite a while since I threw a pitch of any kind ... so once I heard about this gig, I knew I had to practice. Practice was what I did ... in my backyard ... throwing a baseball and trying to hit a tree.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP62/1/118244/images/1.png] [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP62/1/118244/images/2.png] [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP62/1/118244/images/3.png]
Anyway,when I got to the field, there were so many community members, specifically some younger folks, eager to help me make sure that I could get the ball across home plate. I got some good advice, especially from an avid 5 year old who had a lot to say. With his help, I sent the ball right into the strike zone. (What he told me afterward was pretty classic too: “Hey, that wasn’t even all that bad!”)
I am taking the same approach here as I did to throwing that first strike of the game. Listening to those around me, in the community, and figuring out the best approach to get across the finish line this November, so we can have representation that actually fights for us in Washington.
I definitely won't be quitting my day job anytime soon, but I am running for a new one as your representative for NC-13. Can I count on your donation to help us hit the home run we need right now? Every donation gets us one base closer to a win this November.

name: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez
subject: There are just a few days before Abdul’s primary election on August 4th.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
#
Last weekend, I was in Michigan at rallies to support Abdul El-Sayed’s campaign for Senate.
There are just a few days before Abdul’s primary election on August 4th. We have a chance to send Abdul to the Senate — but first his campaign needs the resources to reach voters all throughout Michigan.
[ If you’re all-in for Abdul, please join me in supporting him by rushing a donation to his campaign as his team works to knock on as many doors as possible.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20260721-aes.GmREPk&refcode=em20260721-11973-P_FND_EGR_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=11973%2E2526796%2EIP7Kqa)
[](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20260721-aes.GmREPk&refcode=em20260721-11973-P_FND_EGR_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=11973%2E2526796%2EIP7Kqa)
**[Contribute $5](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20260721-aes.GmREPk&refcode=em20260721-11973-P_FND_EGR_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=23&akid=11973%2E2526796%2EIP7Kqa)**
**Abdul is a man of integrity and discipline. Make no mistake about it.**
This moment is bigger than ideology or party. It is one of country. I want to tell you what they're whispering about Michiganders out in Washington.
They're saying a state like Michigan can't elect an American like Abdul.
I believe that Michigan wants to establish health care as a right for every person in the state. Michigan wants to strengthen our unions. Michigan wants to establish a government that is finally no longer for sale.
**And those are all what Abdul believes. But he can't win this fight all on his own.**
The clock is ticking and every single donation Abdul receives today will help his team reach the voters who will decide the upcoming primary election.
[ Will you chip in a $5 contribution to Abdul's campaign? Let’s send a brawler for the working class and progress to the Senate.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20260721-aes.GmREPk&refcode=em20260721-11973-P_FND_EGR_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=24&akid=11973%2E2526796%2EIP7Kqa)

In solidarity,
Alexandria

And today, so does my sister-in-service Cori Bush. | | | [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.X6XUC7u8ppFLNtMO_55SZlNseb7gEYIOhm_EWnhzEOZKmTtnV3k2h4V2x_O3H7rdW2az5rgktBwzxQ8Ml9Wgkmv85qW-UsBonL4KRa0bcNqdICU6T3NBDdNIZG7w7wEWinKCnw4FNuAl72Su15aawTI8pkXweY_8q6kZF4a7fZTvn5hdPxrP2JCk7ucJjaeEUF1wfIcoWOo_wxkoMnBw2IzYLdK0L00Q2-HLkYXCYQ43L1QO1A6uQl_HjJ4eJW5ETzi8YxS1Rw1Q2zBmgqIR0piDpfOBYE9YP5Y0TM6M_H4O2voOoylBnnHeFypGwygZegCcNC-Xc3FcH9tU0W-jkQ/4si/eiebGjB7RRCzijM18ZyVGA/h0/h001.Vm506nJoam0TLzN_4eUgBPj9KgyMn8GDVf4nfyiw0zg)

Friend, In a few days, I’m turning 50. And today,**my sister-in-service Cori Bush** just turned 50. She’s**one of the boldest and closest allies I’ve had in Congress**. Cori is running for Congress again after AIPAC spent $9 million to buy her seat. This year, AIPAC has already spent more than $1 million against her. We’ve got to get Cori back into Congress fighting for the people and against genocide, fascism, and billionaires’ influence in politics. **To raise the money we need to overcome attacks and reach voters in the final few weeks before our primary elections,** **Cori Bush and I are holding a 50th Birthday Roast on Thursday, July 23th at 8 pm ET.** It’s a virtual fundraiser for Sisters Saving Lives, our joint fundraising committee that splits donations evenly between our re-election campaigns. [**Please RSVP here and donate to join me and Cori Bush at our 50th Birthday Roast: A Virtual Fundraiser.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqv_MUt4Jx7s7cS9rDjjf_Z9Kw3e3HBjPGnyIaSDL8_MjCw_h7u7HLVon8FhbjShQ3kIcpRvJGqk6BLdidK5BglAhva433NbdF2kGSac3S_EWwpbV_gmjNbCm7jFXvtrxYSCHZFpNwrWnwAkK5C4FBD9ja5R1fpmqef4tuwZAwOYZT6Pjo06ZzFvyygZLub4sB3gFYvsnohgn3QNo3_aketoa45PFM7H1nQKcYNV9wZTk-goGS1O_Vg2oQiOl01WURUbFgICUe4fbks1dfdM0lAGGpPeNBaDQNukC8A9t3OfIw4qq_wF7o-eg0vA7Nnerb9ZmGzCYngo9ALZKHMJ8KWyJD-SiVifZ6_k48R8qXbSgg/4si/eiebGjB7RRCzijM18ZyVGA/h1/h001.PCihjQjarO5arQuxTMAiZ66LaaWj_VhlO1lTjJKIz1w) [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqv_MUt4Jx7s7cS9rDjjf_Z9Kw3e3HBjPGnyIaSDL8_MjIACXwf5gdkqmkFlu5ABANVtvIJDZFwVdE-b-tBPlztbBgPHdvwZzztNuV2Btc0qEFNV1O_z00CXkt2OJb8HYPbU7kGvZ8TvPZoETvSQ1wUKIpTJA0u6yjnzgFl4mPbtthKuEUlpe_tcrHY-rmMrZbZrPTHaoCgh8QfiESf20hX4Y0YoBQO9XV0Jpd0DOb3e7DueqrcSH3X3apnhFz5EIa3-qLorbj4CnV-Cn2iiEcJb0hjGs0whcn2o7OUozPX8O3y392pZHrpHxXdULxZKntMAHMTxZlrbg-2HI9LLmDM6j85rYT5UOfnmB6dGMZk3-w/4si/eiebGjB7RRCzijM18ZyVGA/h2/h001.pR8ZjkBWaFv7n-zFWxz2-6b2i8hEuBBFZwYyiD64aoE) | [CLICK HERE TO RSVP](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqv_MUt4Jx7s7cS9rDjjf_Z9Kw3e3HBjPGnyIaSDL8_MjLTWeBUYVujwrtmHFhPgMLYa3QLBI7Gtqd5cmQK_VD7jpvYngK1xs9BfDXFq_pEfPds6P984YWjba27qNMb8ibgeHnHTtEb84pqoIKY22XhvVzo1QVd2p9JAER7GWyBefpQ_QIuj2fJeCDrrvZ78iVJcbNHUneG6nPpV68G9wC6xiKWt-fR3gTfPXtfhUnA2npHnV9IMv-pFfNcip4wumIAafLWaR9YWghAZW1iYHFKfnYq-Pj1uI_JkRJ8P0Q17d-8ycw-LXj-Vh3KDYl9xySaXmHYNiY7CqxOpBLRUhehQSAmNrfEoRR-20YXXnJ5JFg/4si/eiebGjB7RRCzijM18ZyVGA/h3/h001.89K63UIfZkjbXu5bxsrJDgI8UQsFQI_bJUchGSiXIOA)

_Please make sure your email address is correct, because after you RSVP, the link to join the virtual fundraiser will be sent out 24 hours prior to the event._
We’ll have guest speakers join us to roast us, and we’ll talk about what we’re both fighting for in Congress.
Cori is a fierce champion for our rights, including the right to protest. She served as a street medic and community organizer during the Ferguson Uprising.
As the first activist in the Movement for Black Lives to serve in Congress, Cori Bush is leading efforts to stop police brutality and repression. She defends our rights and saves lives at home and abroad, including pushing for Black and Palestinian liberation.
Her experience of being unhoused drives her sense of urgency and her push for legislation like the Unhoused Bill of Rights, which I’ve been proud to support — along with her leadership for reproductive justice, reparations for Black Americans, alternatives to policing, and a national public safety system that centers care rather than punishment.
Both Cori and I are fighting for a government that invests in our communities’ urgent needs — such as housing, healthcare, and utilities for all — rather than spending our tax dollars on state violence.
[**Please send me and Cori Bush back to Congress: RSVP today for our virtual 50th Birthday Roast and fundraiser on Thursday, July 23rd at 8 pm ET.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqv_MUt4Jx7s7cS9rDjjf_Z9Kw3e3HBjPGnyIaSDL8_MjKatUJ5m90ZZjGBZp1bJVOGuGPOAnOVj9rR1EK7Oo2vJT_g8JVt16tYSSXeBZjEQVnlF53lHth7Ydskk9wII8Te_HWIPoXcEIkIuFrhO1AKWaVg5aHLmc8FHu6qQjpsLn3fZpFL7HiAeD2kBd-visFVRLgnIs3o7uoj37x8t4dgeTLmczlYUO9MoERUGnDU1-8xn79APw8M7Tvv82WuIaTUCX1n6St2CF1bMnbQ1sFrgyGa7mvbDWA71GgP2wOGhhUjMCZsNHLlhWWNue1boE4B5aVP-MGf7C96mlfaC0-oyf08Bq33EY2RFhbcTytUM0A/4si/eiebGjB7RRCzijM18ZyVGA/h4/h001.j3Mxz2_F6j7OOYZ1beu85MbTXbzxqb2jhDFCqmiHwUo)

Thank you. Cori and I will never back down in the fight against oppression and inequity. I recently went to St. Louis to help knock doors with her:
[](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqv_MUt4Jx7s7cS9rDjjf_Z9Kw3e3HBjPGnyIaSDL8_MjPlxYLNlFnbhLA_NXvVCgwWBGHr9PlGyLv8kSrdPMF3Eo7U0dljm9fc1semd2K0w7qI9XlLkJovzAgO7m33wAe3ns3pUlV4Bu-abak_9rRqBTmT_k_H-hhNYOzDZTU6m-6dtcHd8dm-B2DjcFL-ED0nF_10kYBRIBaPID4iAeQhOsS0g1sxUOTiYHQoBFJixsy5UXjufl3Q09yDoy7ut0mDJ11MBS5Rfc1aGbaNgIJsytq79_b9xKa93TsUdjeqU3bn0hMnPTQ-KXhMdpH6SHjz_HcIGR6NP6fE6YNvyMU10K9vY8qOojmudMASlgCyzDQ/4si/eiebGjB7RRCzijM18ZyVGA/h6/h001.JL_v78Eqn2iXYycFy7M3aKkXHDD-TCaUq1cd_Iz3Xug)
Both Cori Bush and I got our start in social movements, and we will never stop fighting alongside you for the multiracial democracy that all of us deserve, where everyone can thrive.
With you in the fight for better,

clean_body: In a few days, I’m turning 50. And today, so does my sister-in-service Cori Bush. | | | Friend, In a few days, I’m turning 50. And today,my sister-in-service Cori Bush just turned 50. She’sone of the boldest and closest allies I’ve had in Congress. Cori is running for Congress again after AIPAC spent $9 million to buy her seat. This year, AIPAC has already spent more than $1 million against her. We’ve got to get Cori back into Congress fighting for the people and against genocide, fascism, and billionaires’ influence in politics. To raise the money we need to overcome attacks and reach voters in the final few weeks before our primary elections, Cori Bush and I are holding a 50th Birthday Roast on Thursday, July 23th at 8 pm ET. It’s a virtual fundraiser for Sisters Saving Lives, our joint fundraising committee that splits donations evenly between our re-election campaigns. | Please make sure your email address is correct, because after you RSVP, the link to join the virtual fundraiser will be sent out 24 hours prior to the event. We’ll have guest speakers join us to roast us, and we’ll talk about what we’re both fighting for in Congress. Cori is a fierce champion for our rights, including the right to protest. She served as a street medic and community organizer during the Ferguson Uprising. As the first activist in the Movement for Black Lives to serve in Congress, Cori Bush is leading efforts to stop police brutality and repression. She defends our rights and saves lives at home and abroad, including pushing for Black and Palestinian liberation. Her experience of being unhoused drives her sense of urgency and her push for legislation like the Unhoused Bill of Rights, which I’ve been proud to support — along with her leadership for reproductive justice, reparations for Black Americans, alternatives to policing, and a national public safety system that centers care rather than punishment. Both Cori and I are fighting for a government that invests in our communities’ urgent needs — such as housing, healthcare, and utilities for all — rather than spending our tax dollars on state violence. Thank you. Cori and I will never back down in the fight against oppression and inequity. I recently went to St. Louis to help knock doors with her: Both Cori Bush and I got our start in social movements, and we will never stop fighting alongside you for the multiracial democracy that all of us deserve, where everyone can thrive. clean_body: Becca has been putting in the work for Vermont. | = Peter, I have to tell you what Becca is doing today because, frankly, this is the kind of day that reminds our entire team EXACTLY why Vermont sent her to Congress. In the span of just one day, Becca: Held ICE accountable for the violence, fear, and deadly consequences of its unchecked power. Introduced new legislation to protect small businesses from being crushed by corporations like Amazon and Walmart. Joined Senator Elizabeth Warren and a bipartisan group of lawmakers to take on corporate consolidation that is driving up the price of firetrucks and leaving communities waiting years for lifesaving equipment. Yes. All of that is happening TODAY. = = These may sound like three completely different issues, but Becca sees the connection. It's what happens when powerful institutions believe they can make decisions that destroy people’s lives without explanation, accountability, or consequences. In the Judiciary Committee today, Becca forced Republicans to confront what their blank check for ICE has unleashed in our communities: “We got people with masks. We got people who are not identified. You got people chasing after you in unmarked cars. Of course, you’re going to be scared. Of course, you’re not going to know exactly what to do.” And that kind of unchecked power does not stop with government agencies. It also shows up when a corporate giant can freeze someone’s earnings, bury their products, or wipe out years of hard work without even having to explain why. That is why Becca also introduced the Online Sellers Bill of Rights today, legislation that would stop massive online marketplaces from destroying a small business with the click of a button. Right now, Amazon or Walmart can suspend a seller, freeze their inventory, withhold the money they have earned, or bury their products in search results with almost no warning and virtually no way to fight back. For a small Vermont business operating on razor-thin margins, one unexplained algorithm change could erase years of hard work overnight. Becca’s bill would require these corporations to provide actual evidence, real explanations, and a meaningful opportunity to appeal before cutting off someone’s livelihood. And she still was not finished. THERE’S MORE! = Becca also joined Senator Elizabeth Warren and a bipartisan group of lawmakers demanding an FTC investigation into consolidation in the firetruck manufacturing industry. Fire departments are being forced to pay staggering prices and wait years for equipment they need to keep firefighters and families safe. Small towns should not have to blow apart their budgets because a handful of corporations cornered the market on lifesaving equipment. This is Becca at her best. She is standing up to abuses of government power. She is protecting small businesses from corporate gatekeepers. She is fighting monopolies that squeeze taxpayers and jeopardize public safety. And she is doing it all in a single day. This is the kind of determined, hands-on representation Vermonters deserve. Becca walks into every room ready to ask the hard questions, take on the biggest players, and make sure the people back home are never an afterthought. There is a reason Vermont sent Becca Balint to Congress. Today, she is showing us exactly why. name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: Do you want Elon Musk to be able to tell companies whether you’re depressed or pregnant?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
Your most sensitive information is now sitting inside a system built by a private company.

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2966%2E4032634%2E_fKsL0)
---
Imagine you wake up with a headache. Or sore lower back. Or blurry vision. Maybe it could be a symptom of something worse, and you don't know yet. You might do what so many patients typically do: Google your symptoms. Or find yourself down a WebMD rabbit hole. Or maybe, lately, you talk to ChatGPT or Claude about what’s going on. With AI, these resources can promise to analyze your symptoms, break down a previous lab result, or read an MRI scan in seconds. It might feel private, helpful, and easy. It feels like you're getting answers. But behind the scenes, your most sensitive information is now sitting inside a system built by a private company — who could be gearing up to sell it. They can store the private health data you share: Your symptoms and lab results, the medications and conditions you mention, your mental health struggles, questions about pregnancy, fertility, or reproductive care. And they can sell that information to data brokers for a high price — who can also rake in giant profits from selling sensitive information to other companies and advertisers to target you based on your health concerns. [**So I’ve just re-introduced my Health and Location Data Protection Act to ban AI companies from selling your private health information to data brokers. If you agree that this disgraceful practice should be banned, add your name to say you support this legislation.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-AI-health/?source=EW_EMZ32L_HEL_ENG_20260721_F&t=8&akid=2966%2E4032634%2E_fKsL0) | [**ADD YOUR NAME**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-AI-health/?source=EW_EMZ32L_HEL_ENG_20260721_F&t=9&akid=2966%2E4032634%2E_fKsL0)
---
Look, these AI companies are actively soliciting users to share health information with them right now.
Take Elon Musk for example, who was encouraging Twitter users to share MRI images with Grok.
Now, do you want Elon Musk to know your symptoms and lab results, the medications you take, your mental health struggles, or if you’re pregnant, and then hand that information over to data brokers to use for who knows what?
I don’t think so.
Let’s be clear: This is a symptom of a greater issue that is the broken American health care system.
Many Americans are turning to AI for health answers because going to the doctor means a copay they can’t swing. Or they can’t take off work for a routine visit to the clinic. Or their nearest doctor is hours away. Or because they don’t have insurance at all.
We must keep fighting for Medicare for All so that people don’t feel like they have to outsource sensitive, private health conversations to AI. At the same time, we must do everything we can to prevent AI companies from exploiting patients and cashing in on America's unaffordable health care system.
**My Health and Location Data Protection Act would ban companies from selling Americans' health and location data — including the data you type into an AI system — and close the loopholes that let sensitive data flow to data brokers. And it would give the FTC, state attorneys general, and individuals real power to enforce real penalties.**
[**Add your name if you support my Health and Location Data Protection Act and you agree that AI companies should not be able to profit off of selling Americans’ private, personal health data.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-AI-health/?source=EW_EMZ32L_HEL_ENG_20260721_F&t=10&akid=2966%2E4032634%2E_fKsL0)
Thanks for being a part of this,
Elizabeth

Peter, The 2026 congressional map is finally set — and it’s a national disgrace that it took so long to get here. In most election cycles, we know what the congressional map will look like by the time the ball drops in Times Square, if not earlier. But all of that changed when Republicans orchestrated an unprecedented, shameless, and deeply undemocratic power grab that forced redraws in state after state. It’s led us to an intensely gerrymandered map where millions of people’s voices — especially Black and brown voters — simply have less power than they did before. Since the beginning, the National Democratic Redistricting Committee has been on the front lines of the effort to fight back, and it’s clearer than ever that this work is just getting underway. clean_body: Your support today is critical | Peter, The 2026 congressional map is finally set — and it’s a national disgrace that it took so long to get here. In most election cycles, we know what the congressional map will look like by the time the ball drops in Times Square, if not earlier. But all of that changed when Republicans orchestrated an unprecedented, shameless, and deeply undemocratic power grab that forced redraws in state after state. It’s led us to an intensely gerrymandered map where millions of people’s voices — especially Black and brown voters — simply have less power than they did before. Since the beginning, the National Democratic Redistricting Committee has been on the front lines of the effort to fight back, and it’s clearer than ever that this work is just getting underway. These midterm elections and the months that follow will decide a ton about what future maps look like — and we need your help. = | If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: = | = = | = = | = It’s sad to think that, just four years ago, the fair maps movement helped shape what the New York Times described as the “fairest House map of the last 40 years.” That’s been wiped away by Donald Trump and his MAGA allies, who are terrified of facing voters in an election fought on a level playing field. Worse, this won’t stop there. Republicans have already laid out plans to go even further in 2028. They have their sights set on states like Georgia, Mississippi, and South Carolina. We have a plan, too. The NDRC has a rigorous, multi-front strategy to defeat future gerrymanders, empower voters to pass counter-measures, and win elections this fall and beyond. That’s how we’ll pass reforms and throw a wrench into GOP plans to try to rig elections for years to come. Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw
Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. body:
[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/43706?t=1001&akid=240966%2E444211%2EHGIgXy ]Powered by People[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/43706?t=1002&akid=240966%2E444211%2EHGIgXy ]Powered by People

This
weekend the Powered by People team worked three different events in
Houston.

Our volunteers showed up to help voters at James Talarico’s rally in
southwest Houston, Harris County Judge nominee Leticia Plummer’s campaign
relaunch, and a community protest for Lorenzo Salgado, a Houston resident
killed by ICE earlier this month.

At every stop, our approach was the same: meet people where they are, and
make sure they're ready to vote.

We are turning energy and emotion – excitement for candidates, anger at
injustice – into action that will produce change. We did our best to meet
everyone at each event, confirming registrations, updating voter data for
those who’d moved, and registering brand new first time voters.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20260721.laoTkl&refcode=ema20260721-240966&t=1004&akid=240966%2E444211%2EHGIgXy ]Group of Powered by People volunteers standing in front of a stage with
the Texas flag in the background. James Talarico stands in the center of
group in the back row. Two volunteers are holding signs that say "TALARICO
FOR CONGRESS" and one volunteer is holding a sign that says "LOVE THY
NEIGHBOR."

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20260721.laoTkl&refcode=ema20260721-240966&t=1005&akid=240966%2E444211%2EHGIgXy ]A Powered by People volunteer wearing a gray PXP shirt and lanyard
(left) helping someone writing on a clipboard (right) get registered to
vote.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20260721.laoTkl&refcode=ema20260721-240966&t=1006&akid=240966%2E444211%2EHGIgXy ]Two Powered by People volunteers standing at a table with a black table
cover that says "POWERED BY PEOPLE" on it. On the table there are
stickers, a bowl of snacks, brochures, pens, a fan, and clipboards with
voter registration papers attached to them.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20260721.laoTkl&refcode=ema20260721-240966&t=1007&akid=240966%2E444211%2EHGIgXy ]Group of Powered by People volunteers smiling at the camera standing
outside. The volunteer in the center is holding a sign that says "Dr.
Letitia Plummer Democrat for 2026 Harris County Judge"

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20260721.laoTkl&refcode=ema20260721-240966&t=1008&akid=240966%2E444211%2EHGIgXy ]Two people filling out their voter registration forms on clipboards at
a Powered by People table

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20260721.laoTkl&refcode=ema20260721-240966&t=1009&akid=240966%2E444211%2EHGIgXy ]A Powered by People volunteer wearing a gray PxP tee shirt holding a
clipboard with their phone resting on top of it (left), smiling towards
something off camera; another person in the photo is wearing a black tee
shirt that says "I'M A TALAFREAKO" (right)

By the end of the day our 57 Powered by People volunteers had added 325
new voters to our relational organizing network, a mix of new and updated
registrants.

Each voter added is the result of a personal conversation held
face-to-face, in the physical, real world. And our volunteers personally
stay in touch with each of these voters all the way through Election Day,
answering their questions, following up around key deadlines, and
encouraging them to vote until we can confirm they’ve cast their ballot.

Winning in November starts with work like this. In order to keep reaching
voters across Texas, we rely on grassroots supporters like you to power
this program.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20260721.laoTkl&refcode=ema20260721-240966&t=1010&akid=240966%2E444211%2EHGIgXy ]Houston was one day, three events, and 57 volunteers. There will be
dozens more days like it between now and November. Will you chip in
$3 or whatever you can to get us to the next one and keep
up this work?

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20260721.laoTkl&refcode=ema20260721-240966&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1029&akid=240966%2E444211%2EHGIgXy ]Donate $3

Thank you,

Powered by People

body:
[ stdin# ]Jocelyn Benson for Governor
Can I be honest with you?

My goals as your future governor are really quite simple. Yes, I have
comprehensive plans — as anyone asking for your trust and vote should —
but at the end of the day, I’m fighting to...

* Drive down costs. From the grocery store to the gas pump, from the
doctor’s office to the mortgage bill, far too many hard-working
families across Michigan are struggling to make ends meet.
* Help Michigan families build wealth and get well-paying jobs in the
state. That means a Michigan where teachers can afford to live in the
communities they teach in, and nurses are paid well and taken care of
in the workplace.
* Prepare Michigan to defend our rights, our freedoms, and our
democracy. As Michigan’s Secretary of State, I’ve spent years standing
up to attacks on our democracy and defending our elections. As
governor, I’ll continue fighting for our democracy and never back
down, regardless of who’s in the White House.

Throughout this campaign, I’ve traveled across Michigan, talking directly
with hard-working families about the challenges they’re facing, their
hopes for the future, and one thing is clear: Michiganders need a governor
who cares about making their lives better.

That’s the kind of leadership that can only be elected by running a
campaign powered by the people. A campaign like the one we’re building,
together. One that’s ready to fight tooth and nail to make real change for
Michigan families.

But first, we have to win in November. A movement capable of taking on the
National GOP and an opponent backed by the DeVos family is only built by
everyone pitching in whatever they can, whenever they can.

Josh Shapiro “totally overrated” and said he “does not have what it takes.”** What’s worse? | | **_Meet Rob:_** Born and raised in Kingston, PA, Rob Bresnahan is currently serving his first term as PA-08’s homegrown Congressman. He’s a fifth-generation Northeastern Pennsylvanian, and the only representative in Congress who is part of the National Electrical Contractors Association. A product of the American Dream, Rob learned the true meaning of hard work by getting his hands dirty early and often. He wired junction boxes, ran heavy equipment, drove trucks, and learned the value of an honest day’s work in the process. His family instilled the values of hard work, discipline, and perseverance in him at a young age – and Rob has stayed true to these foundational values all his life. At just 19 years old, Rob joined his family’s business as the CFO for Kuharchik Construction. He became the CEO of the company in 2013. Rob spent over a decade working and connecting with blue-collar Americans across the country before running for Congress in 2024. He was outspent 2:1 in his race against a 12-year Democrat that year, but the people of Northeastern Pennsylvania demanded change when they sent Rob to be their fighter in Washington. Through his experience as an electrical contractor, Rob saw the real world struggles facing America’s blue-collar workers first hand. Wages are not keeping up with the skyrocketing cost of living, and Americans who wake up every day and pay their dues are being left out to dry by their elected officials. But Rob’s voting record in Congress tells a different story. He’s stood up for hardworking Americans at every opportunity, regardless of partisan politics. Simply put, Rob Bresnahan brings both insight and candid concern for blue-collar America to Congress that your run-of-the-mill representatives don’t. Every day that he steps foot on Capitol Hill, Rob is 100% devoted to restoring America’s energy independence, deregulating the economy, and bringing well-paying jobs back to the great commonwealth of Pennsylvania. While he’s still serving his freshman term in Congress, Rob has already introduced key legislation to re-invest in American trades and pave avenues to success for young people who forgo a traditional college education. Now running for re-election in one of the most pivotal battleground races in the country, Rob is stepping up to the plate once again to deliver for the people of PA-08 and preserve our Republican House majority for the remainder of President Trump’s second term.

I’ll be honest,

calls. Nope, running for office isn’t just about grand speeches and
meeting supporters for 12 hours a day, every day.

Hi, Peter — We’ve heard a lot lately about education transformation. Well, what I’m focused on is the fact that _education is transformational._ Under Gov. Scott’s tenure, the education conversation is tearing communities apart. There is no clear vision for what all of this proposed change is driving toward from an educational perspective, and no data to support the claim that forced school consolidation — which I oppose — will reduce education spending. We’ve lost the plot. It’s time for a new conversation; one that truly engages our communities in creating a vision for the education system our children deserve. **Put simply: We owe every student in Vermont the highest-quality education possible, because education has the power to transform lives** —** and public education is the foundation of our democracy.** | [**READ MY PLATFORM**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/135728351/635148656/-750528621?refcode=ea.ab99aab5-5685-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&ms=ea.ab99aab5-5685-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjMvMS8xMjQ5NTciLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYWI5OWFhYjUtNTY4NS1mMTExLWIzMzctMDAwZDNhMTU1OGNlIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=dCEb5JUpDPG_nyd7Gs3sL_PRxQsmeiuuDZ_CkwsLfds=&emci=c4223732-0a85-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&emdi=ab99aab5-5685-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&ceid=1745378)

And we won’t stop at preK-12 education. We’ll make Vermont a state for lifelong learning, starting with a new education and workforce initiative I’m excited to announce today.
**When I’m governor, every person in Vermont — from recent high school graduates to people making mid-career changes and older Vermonters looking to gain new skills and employment options —**** will be eligible for free community college.** This opportunity will open up pathways to degrees and certificates that lead to fulfilling, well-paying jobs.
Right now, too many of our young people are disengaging from their education, some before high school graduation, and many more immediately after. And when young people disengage, the consequences can be devastating. I’ve seen this in my own community — at Oxbow High School, where we’ve lost far too many friends to overdose and suicide.
This isn’t only personal, it’s also urgent for our economy. Every part of my platform, from housing, to health care, to energy independence, relies on Vermont having enough skilled workers to make it real. We owe it to our young people — and to the future of this state we love — to get it right.
Let’s build a highly-skilled Vermont together.
— Aly

clean_body: Here's my plan to make Vermont a state for lifelong learning | Democrat Aly Richards is running for Governor to make Vermont a state where everyone can thrive. We hope to have you on our team, but if you want to opt out from future emails, you can . Hi, Peter — We’ve heard a lot lately about education transformation. Well, what I’m focused on is the fact that education is transformational. Under Gov. Scott’s tenure, the education conversation is tearing communities apart. There is no clear vision for what all of this proposed change is driving toward from an educational perspective, and no data to support the claim that forced school consolidation — which I oppose — will reduce education spending. We’ve lost the plot. It’s time for a new conversation; one that truly engages our communities in creating a vision for the education system our children deserve. Put simply: We owe every student in Vermont the highest-quality education possible, because education has the power to transform lives — and public education is the foundation of our democracy. | As governor, I will ensure that the Agency of Education functions as a service organization providing accurate, relevant data and assistance so that school districts and communities can make informed decisions about what’s best for their kids. And we won’t stop at preK-12 education. We’ll make Vermont a state for lifelong learning, starting with a new education and workforce initiative I’m excited to announce today. When I’m governor, every person in Vermont — from recent high school graduates to people making mid-career changes and older Vermonters looking to gain new skills and employment options — will be eligible for free community college. This opportunity will open up pathways to degrees and certificates that lead to fulfilling, well-paying jobs. Right now, too many of our young people are disengaging from their education, some before high school graduation, and many more immediately after. And when young people disengage, the consequences can be devastating. I’ve seen this in my own community — at Oxbow High School, where we’ve lost far too many friends to overdose and suicide. This isn’t only personal, it’s also urgent for our economy. Every part of my platform, from housing, to health care, to energy independence, relies on Vermont having enough skilled workers to make it real. We owe it to our young people — and to the future of this state we love — to get it right. Let’s build a highly-skilled Vermont together. — Aly | | Aly is running for governor because she knows Vermonters are hungry for change — not more of the same. Together, we will fix our broken health care system, build housing Vermonters can actually afford, protect our communities from the dysfunction in Washington, and create an economy that works for all of us. | = = Follow along: | | | ---|---|---|--- Aly for Vermont P.O. | | Volunteering for a campaign is challenging. Even more so when you are donating your time. We haven’t seen many large donations come in and I cannot afford to pay for expensive campaign management groups.
We need volunteers for the following roles:
* Communications Director
* Social Media Manager
* Field Organizer
* Handler

We also need volunteers to accompany us for events and town halls, and canvassers to phone bank and door knock. This is an **ALL HANDS ON DECK** request!
---
| |
# Parades & Interviews
---
| | We had an amazing two weeks. We were the only 4th congressional district candidate to show up for Nephi at The Stampede Parade on July 11th.[https://youtube.com/shorts/BGeQbqHDISQ?feature=share](https://us.list-manage.com/ckRGG7MLCT_?e=c29ddb867a&c2id=ae2ec488ed0a92b1bb8171b838f89423&m=Dzo5UdI2wsZZDe1po-jrRinH-d_2IlCYhSMAR7SlNhaDaRWHkZ3wY0QSctId)
We interviewed with Sons of Liberty and The Knitting Cult Lady.[Sons of Liberty Stream](https://us.list-manage.com/A_TKIfcqyx5?e=c29ddb867a&c2id=ae2ec488ed0a92b1bb8171b838f89423&m=gTo1qZYOPCtJHbdO8FPMO0Idoa7dj_VeeSKb67LX49ahQ9NdBFNpMmSxPkIf)
[Daniella hosts, Watch Power: Knitting Cult Lady](https://us.list-manage.com/xIfaVNs5Nvu?e=c29ddb867a&c2id=ae2ec488ed0a92b1bb8171b838f89423&m=l08Dlt5FP9TiEQ04zAALlLciKuS7L2gF93O8wBrWlasUFdOsbsDvq46ua3f8)
---
| |
# Public Lands
---
| | _**Over 80% of Utahns**_ wanted Bears Ears and Grand Staircase left alone and protected from development. Our entire congressional delegation ignored you. The only way change happens is when we vote. Get one of our yard signs and make sure everyone knows there is a better option in town. Find us at one of our events or contact our volunteer team at [volunteer@jonnyutah4congress.com](mailto:volunteer@jonnyutah4congress.com?subject=I%20need%20a%20yard%20sign&body=**EDIT***%20PLEASE%20TELL%20US%20WHO%20YOU%20ARE%2C%20WHERE%20YOU%20ARE%20AND%20HOW%20MANY%20SIGNS%20YOU%20ARE%20LOOKING%20TO%20GET.) and consider donating. # If you ever wanted to defend and save Maryland, now is the time.
[](https://us.list-manage.com/K7g27iHQzCA?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b) Dear Dan Cox for Governor, I'm a lifelong Marylander. I was born in the city and spent my early life in Takoma Park. My parents moved us to the country in Frederick County when I was turning five. As the oldest of a big family, I didn't know we grew up somewhat poor because my mom and dad made sure through hard work on the farm and in my father's business and later state-wide education ministry that we had everything a kid could want. We worked hard on our farm raising chickens, beef, and livestock. I helped many a summer milking cows on Maryland dairy farms, in between staying in Baltimore's Monkton with my grandparents for summer trips, enjoying the cold waters of the Gunpowder River and the Rails to Trails, traveling with my grandmother to Baltimore City for her volunteering at the Baltimore Rescue Mission outreach. Traveling with my dad to Annapolis to advocate and testify for education opportunity for all Marylanders.

I worked long summer hours throwing hay at $3/hour, filling all the area farmers' barns and hay mows in sometimes 100F degree plus weather. Then, we would cool off in the summer breeze of the evening with cold sodas and ice creams, and sometimes a swim.

Then there were Oriole's games at the old Memorial Stadium where the comeback of the century arguably occurred. In 1988 they had one of the worst losing streaks of 21 games and last place, only to come back under the WHY NOT? slogan the following year to one of the best seasons and nearly first place.

Because of opportunity here before it was so hard to obtain building permits, my wife and I built two houses. We went to law school where I graduated and began my law firm right here in Maryland. And it is where we have birthed our children and served the people in elected office.

That is the Maryland I know. And it is the Maryland of common sense, hard work and opportunity for all.

We see it under direct attack by Wes Moore who is traveling the nation while leaving us behind. Highest electric bills in the nation. Second worst economy in the nation according to CNBC just this week. Hundreds of millions of your tax money missing in the budget and a budget nearly $4 billion structurally in the red. Schools that do not prioritize teachers and students with some of the worst performance tests in the nation, down from where we used to rank near the top. Silencing Maryland voices with gerrymandering. ***And no Key Bridge.*** There is fading opportunity for our kids and retirees to live, work great jobs, save good money, have great schools and retire here.

But it doesn't have to be bleak. You can choose to help us win. Wes Moore is under water, meaning less than 50% of Marylanders believe he is doing a good job for us. That shows the need and genuine interest in new leadership, now. So now is the time for your help. We need to buy the air time, the billboards, the direct mail, the voter contact and outreach and the get out the voter effort. It is a monumental task but with your help together we can accomplish a sweet victory together.

Thank you for joining the effort with any amount. Maryland's [400 program at $2500](https://us.list-manage.com/dJQXMO1bbvY?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b). Our top tier finance team help at [$1000](https://us.list-manage.com/hWSxIZ6jZ2G?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b). And our [Every Voice Matters at any amount $5, $10, $25, $50, $75, $100, $150, $200, $250, $350](https://us.list-manage.com/3xARFpvGz6U?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b).

If [everyone donates](https://us.list-manage.com/HQgJtcHT3PO?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b) who opens this email and gets one family member or friend to also donate, we will raise an immediate powerful amount which I have (in the primary) and will again personally matched with my own funds.

Please help us get our message out. That Maryland is worth saving.

Thank you and God bless. And together let's save the Maryland, beautiful Maryland that we know and cherish.

For Maryland,

Dan Cox
Governor Nominee for Maryland

# RECORD FUNDRAISING, ENDORSEMENTS, LILY IN THE NEWS
&
ASK ME ANYTHING TOWN HALL

**Record Fundraising**
Highest since NH-02 Republican Representative Charlie Bass in 2014!

I can’t thank enough my _individual_ donors across the country. After raising $230K this past 2nd quarter, we have total raised over $1.1 million with $664K cash on hand. I look forward to winning the NHGOP primary nomination on Sept. 8th so I can have a REMATCH with Congresswoman Maggie Goodlander this November.

**National Endorsements**
I am deeply honored to receive endorsements from _Gun Owners of America_ , _Republican Women’s Caucus Fund_ and _Republican Liberty Caucus_.

_“Lily escaped Communist China in pursuit of the American Dream and has dedicated her life to defending freedom, the Constitution, and the liberties that make America exceptional,”_ said Congresswoman Kat Cammack, Republican Women’s Caucus Fund Chair. _“The RWCF is proud to endorse her.”_

**Lily In the News**
[Mao Survivor Lily Tang Williams Sounds the Alarm on Socialism](https://us.list-manage.com/cFPhNfmbCyo?e=c338950e03&c2id=adf8b61e01be85c238f26a96cfd7c41c)
[Lily Tang Williams Warns of China's Growing Influence in America](https://us.list-manage.com/Se_zaGFImBM?e=c338950e03&c2id=adf8b61e01be85c238f26a96cfd7c41c)

**ASK ME ANYTHING TOWN HALL SERIES**
My campaign is rolling out "Ask Me Anything" Town Hall Series, an ongoing series of open, unscripted public forums where every Granite Stater in NH-02 is invited to ask any question, raise any issue, and engage in a candid conversation about the future of New Hampshire and the country.

Unlike carefully managed political events, there will be no pre-screened questions. The events are open to the public and the media. The town halls are intended to restore the New Hampshire tradition of accessible, accountable leadership.

This is the first of my ASK ME ANYTHING TOWN HALL series on July 30th in Windham. For more events, please check out EVENTS on my website: lily4congress.com
If you are in NH-02, would like to request for a town hall at a venue that can seat 50-100 people, please reach out and we would love to hear your suggestions.

**Going Viral **
I made this video last June after Mamdani’s win. It is time to warn Americans again after socialists winning primaries for Congress. [https://www.facebook.com/share/r/1arxP2aP36/](https://us.list-manage.com/uYvBfYg2ziF?e=c338950e03&c2id=adf8b61e01be85c238f26a96cfd7c41c)
There are plenty of them in Congress, enough already! My lived experience and perspectives are badly needed in U.S. House to counter them.
I will always defend American and NH Live Free or Die values in Congress. Please help me win.

[DONATE](https://us.list-manage.com/US0yKAP5no4?e=c338950e03&c2id=adf8b61e01be85c238f26a96cfd7c41c)

| Let’s take back what belongs to us.
---
[](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/7929?t=6&amount=10&refcode=aschiff_email_072126_banners&akid=10006%2E5257348%2E8x4o21)
Derek, Last month, investigators in my office uncovered the contracts behind the banners of Donald Trump's face now hanging on federal buildings across Washington — the largest of them eight stories tall at the Department of Health and Human Services, with "America First" printed beside it: [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/7929?t=14&amount=10&refcode=aschiff_email_072126_banners&akid=10006%2E5257348%2E8x4o21) | | [DONATE TO FIGHT BACK→](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/7929?t=15&amount=10&refcode=aschiff_email_072126_banners&akid=10006%2E5257348%2E8x4o21)
---
Here’s what we uncovered:
The American people paid for every inch of it, and we have the receipts. $114,000 from the FAA. $39,000 from Interior. A third check from the Labor Department.
The list goes on and on.
**Congress long ago outlawed spending taxpayer dollars on propaganda and self-aggrandizement, and an eight-story-high Donald Trump head certainly qualifies.**
Because I spent years as a federal prosecutor, I know a pattern of intent when I see one. In every country where democracy gave way to one man, the faces went up on the government buildings first. Not as decoration, and not even as vanity — but to teach the people who paid for those buildings a simple lesson: _all of this belongs to him now._
And yet not one of those buildings belongs to Donald Trump. They belong to the American people, to the taxpayers who funded them. We were never asked, and we do not have to accept it.
There is one check on this president that he cannot fire and cannot intimidate: a Democratic Senate, with the gavels and subpoena power to hold him to account.

# [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/135733325/635156798/938567526?refcode=header&noskip=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTcxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzODkyOTMxMy01YTg1LWYxMTEtYjMzNy0wMDBkM2ExNTU4Y2UiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=D6A6NxWMp7t0H3AGBNtXWG9gP7BPmjrNkC7Gq4aZXR4=)
I recently released an Oversight report with a simple message: **Donald Trump’s so-called “Department of Government Efficiency” is a scam.**
**It was never about efficiency, saving money, or reform. It was always about making billionaires richer while working families foot the bill.**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/135733326/635156799/789508428?refcode=260721_RG_doge-rs-b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTcxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzODkyOTMxMy01YTg1LWYxMTEtYjMzNy0wMDBkM2ExNTU4Y2UiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=D6A6NxWMp7t0H3AGBNtXWG9gP7BPmjrNkC7Gq4aZXR4=)
Since DOGE was created, the Trump Administration has cost taxpayers billions in damage, waste, and chaos — while quietly funneling at least $81 million into DOGE operations with virtually zero transparency or accountability.
That’s your money. And what did Americans get in return?
❌ Public services disrupted.
❌ Federal workers pushed out.
❌ Sensitive data put at risk.
❌ Billionaire insiders cashing in.
They slapped a shiny name on it and called it “efficiency.” But let’s be honest — this is a reckless takeover of our government by corrupt elites who see public service as a business opportunity.
**I’m the the top Democrat on Oversight. I take that job seriously. And I am not going to sit quietly while Trump dismantles critical public services and hands the keys to his billionaire friends.**

body:
# [](https://act.electjon.com/go/4629?t=1&akid=2554%2E5691347%2EV6BorA)

🌤️ To all of Jon Ossoff’s supporters: Please don’t click away from this important message before Trump visits Georgia tomorrow. 🇺🇸
This isn’t the first time we’re emailing about Trump’s visit so we’ll get right to the point: **There is no winning back the Senate without reelecting Jon Ossoff.**

Trump knows that, which is why he’s coming to Georgia to support Mike Collins and why he’s already attacking and insulting Jon.
This trip will be the next of many because Trump knows he needs to keep his supporters consistently motivated between now and November. Every time he visits, he gets more media attention and MAGA energy — both things notorious bigot and antisemite Mike Collins is desperate for in his campaign.
